hints.plot: Set during the Age of Exploration from the 15th to 19th centuries, the campaign follows three generations of the Black family — a dynasty of explorers and soldiers tied to a secret society called the Circle of Ossus — as they quest for the mythical Fountain of Youth hidden in the Americas. Beyond the campaign, players select one of eight European colonial powers and compete in real-time strategy battles to establish settlements, develop trade routes to a Home City, and field armies drawn from the age of muskets, cavalry, and artillery across the New World.

Following the events of the first game, the Dark Wanderer — a warrior who absorbed the soulstone containing the Lord of Terror — travels east across the world of Sanctuary, leaving destruction in his wake as Diablo seeks to free his brothers Mephisto and Baal from their own prisons. A new hero — chosen from five distinct character classes including an Amazon, Necromancer, and Barbarian — pursues the Wanderer through four acts spanning desert cities, jungle temples, and the burning hells themselves, racing to prevent the Prime Evils from reuniting and plunging the mortal realm into eternal darkness.

In 2023, a young agent named Joanna Dark — codenamed Perfect Dark for her flawless training record — works for the Carrington Institute, a research organisation secretly competing against the powerful and sinister dataDyne corporation for control of alien technology. When a dataDyne scientist defects with knowledge of an extraterrestrial conspiracy linking both corporations to a hostile alien race, Joanna is drawn into a conflict that spans from corporate skyscrapers and Area 51 to an alien spacecraft, as the fate of Earth's sovereignty hangs in the balance.

A young kung fu student watches their father — the master of a martial arts school — murdered by a group of five former students who have since vanished into the criminal underworld. Armed with a magical talisman that resurrects them after each death at the cost of accelerating their age, the student hunts each assassin across five locations in a fictional Chinese city — from drug dens and nightclubs to a museum and corporate tower — growing older with every defeat until time itself becomes the most dangerous enemy they face.

There is no traditional narrative — the game transports Mii avatars to the sun-soaked Wuhu Island resort, where twelve sports and activities are available across its beaches, skies, and surrounding waters. Powered by the Wii MotionPlus accessory bundled with the game, each activity — from swordfighting and archery to wakeboarding and air sports — uses one-to-one motion tracking to translate the player's physical gestures directly into the game, offering a significantly more precise and immersive experience than the original Wii Sports controls allowed.

Rogue ninja Kasumi has escaped her clan after defying their laws and is hunted across the world by her own sister Ayane and former ally Ryu Hayabusa, while being drawn into a second Dead or Alive tournament organised by the shadowy DOATEC corporation. Behind the spectacle of high-speed martial arts competition — featuring fighters from across the globe including a wrestling champion, a military operative, and a French opera singer with ties to DOATEC's founder — the corporation pursues a sinister agenda involving illegal human experimentation and the creation of an unstoppable clone soldier.

A lone adventurer arrives in the port city of Baldur's Gate and is immediately robbed and left for dead in an alley by a local thieves' guild. Rescued by a tavern keeper, the hero begins investigating the city's growing criminal underworld and discovers that a dark cult called the Onyx Tower is orchestrating a far-reaching conspiracy — one that stretches from the slums beneath Baldur's Gate to an ancient dungeon complex harbouring a power capable of destroying the city itself.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

hints.plot: Centuries after a great evil was sealed away by the gods who flooded an ancient kingdom beneath a vast ocean, a young boy living on a remote island sets sail across the Great Sea after his sister is kidnapped by a monstrous bird and taken to a fortress. Guided by a mysterious talking boat called the King of Red Lions and aided by a pirate captain named Tetra, he discovers that the ancient evil has awakened once more and is searching the seas for the scattered pieces of a sacred relic — forcing the boy to claim a legendary hero's mantle and confront the darkness threatening to consume the world beneath the waves.

A wannabe rock star named Chai volunteers for a cybernetic enhancement procedure at the megacorporation Vandelay Technologies, but the operation goes wrong when his music player is accidentally fused into his chest — allowing him to sense and sync with the rhythm of the world around him. Branded a defect and hunted by Vandelay's executives, Chai teams up with a ragtag group of rebels and fights his way through the corporation's facilities in rhythm-synced combat, determined to expose the company's illegal experiments and take down its corrupt leadership one boss at a time.

There is no traditional narrative — the game presents five sports simulations designed to showcase the Wii Remote's motion controls: tennis, baseball, bowling, golf, and boxing. Using physical gestures to swing, throw, punch, and putt, players control Mii avatars — customisable representations of themselves — in simplified but immediately intuitive versions of each sport, with a fitness assessment mode that tracks performance over time and assigns players a Wii Fitness Age based on their results.

In Yokosuka, Japan in 1986, a teenage martial artist named Ryo Hazuki witnesses his father — a renowned master — being murdered in their own dojo by a mysterious Chinese man named Lan Di, who seizes a relic called the Phoenix Mirror before vanishing. Driven by the need to understand his father's death and avenge it, Ryo begins investigating Lan Di's identity and connection to an ancient Chinese conflict, questioning sailors, local gangs, and shopkeepers across his neighbourhood as he slowly unravels a conspiracy stretching from suburban Japan all the way to Hong Kong.

title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II - The Sith Lords

hints.plot: Five years after the defeat of the Sith, a former Jedi Knight known only as the Exile — stripped of their connection to the Force and exiled from the Jedi Order for fighting in the Mandalorian Wars — is drawn back into a galaxy where the Sith have hunted the Jedi to near extinction. Accompanied by a morally ambiguous mentor named Kreia and a shifting group of companions, the Exile must relearn the Force, rebuild their strength across seven worlds, and confront the question of whether the Force itself is a wound upon the galaxy — as two powerful Sith Lords close in to finish what the Jedi purge began.

A spirited young boy named Justin lives in a port town, dreaming of adventure and following in the footsteps of his late father — a legendary adventurer who spent his life searching for the ruins of the ancient Angelou civilisation. When Justin discovers a fragment of a magical stone his father left behind that reacts to a mysterious wall of ruins at the edge of the known world, he embarks on a journey across continents with a group of companions, racing against a militaristic organisation called the Garlyle Forces to unlock the secrets of the Angelou before their power can be weaponised.

On a neglected plot of land on Piñata Island, the player is tasked with restoring an overgrown garden to attract and house wild piñata creatures — colourful paper animals that arrive, take up residence, and can be bred into rarer variants as the garden improves. Using gardening tools to cultivate plants, dig ponds, and reshape the terrain, the player must balance the competing needs and territorial conflicts of over sixty piñata species while fending off sour piñatas and human troublemakers who seek to disrupt the garden's flourishing ecosystem.

Thousands of years after an advanced civilisation destroyed itself through wars fought with genetically engineered bio-weapons, a hunter named Keil Fluge stumbles upon a dying man who entrusts him with a mission: ride a powerful armoured dragon and pursue a rogue black dragon carrying a rider of malevolent intent toward a dormant Ancient Age ruin. Flying across seven stages of a ravaged, monster-inhabited world, Keil must intercept the black dragon before it can awaken the ruin's catastrophic weapons and unleash destruction upon what remains of humanity.

Set years after the events of a previous alien conflict, legendary soldier Bill Rizer has been imprisoned and held responsible for the deaths of hundreds of millions of people and the murder of his former partner. Released from captivity to combat a new terrorist organisation called Blood Falcon that has seized alien technology to threaten Earth, Bill and a new partner named Lucia must fight through seven stages of relentless side-scrolling combat — with the full truth of Bill's guilt or innocence slowly emerging through the course of the mission.

When the Emperor of Tamriel is assassinated and his heirs killed, the gates of Oblivion — portals to a hellish dimension ruled by the Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon — begin tearing open across the province of Cyrodiil. A prisoner freed from the Imperial dungeons by the dying Emperor is charged with finding his illegitimate heir and lighting the Dragonfires of the Temple of the One before Dagon's forces overwhelm the mortal world, setting off an open-ended adventure across a vast landscape of cities, dungeons, and guilds.

When a mysterious water creature called Chaos begins terrorising Station Square under the command of Doctor Robotnik — who seeks to harness the power of the seven Chaos Emeralds to transform the creature into its ultimate form and destroy the city — six characters with interconnected stories are drawn into the conflict. Each protagonist follows their own narrative thread: a hedgehog racing to stop the doctor, a two-tailed fox proving his courage, an echidna recovering shattered emerald shards, and others whose paths gradually converge toward a cataclysmic ancient reckoning between Chaos, the echidna tribe, and the Chao they once protected.

Set on a near-future Earth where a cataclysmic event called First Light has granted certain individuals supernatural abilities, two factions of gifted operatives — known as Agents — face off in covert tactical operations across global locations. Each five-player team alternates between planting and defusing a spike device across a series of rounds, with players choosing from a diverse cast of Agents whose unique abilities can shift the momentum of a round — but where precise gunplay remains the decisive factor in every engagement.

There is no traditional narrative — the player chooses from a selection of high-performance cars and races against computer-controlled opponents across a single looping course, with a reverse layout unlocked upon completion. The driving experience centres on a drifting mechanic inspired by Japanese mountain road racing culture, rewarding players who can maintain speed through corners by initiating controlled slides rather than braking — a handling model that would define the arcade racing genre for years to come.

In the high fantasy world of Endiness, a young warrior named Dart returns to his village only to find it razed and his childhood friend captured by the forces of the militaristic Sandoran Empire. Rescuing her with the help of a mysterious woman named Rose, Dart discovers an ancient power — the ability to transform into a Dragoon, a legendary warrior who merges with the spirit of a dragon — and learns that his own dark past is bound to a cataclysmic conflict between humans and a winged species called the Winglies that occurred ten thousand years ago.

In 16th-century Bavaria, a journeyman artist named Andreas Maler is completing his masterwork at the Kiersau Abbey scriptorium when a prominent monk is found murdered and an innocent man is accused. Choosing to investigate, Andreas becomes enmeshed in the lives of the abbey's monks and the people of the nearby village of Tassing — navigating religious upheaval, political intrigue, and class conflict across three acts spanning twenty-five years, with each decision shaping not only the outcome of the murders but the fates of characters and the community for generations.

On the war-torn continent of Valandis, three warring kingdoms have spent generations locked in bloody conflict, and a group of warriors from opposing sides find themselves unexpectedly united by fate after a devastating magical catastrophe. Travelling across a vast world of sunken cities, wind-blasted plateaus, and forgotten dungeons — aboard giant mechanical suits as well as on foot — they uncover a web of political betrayal and ancient secrets that reaches far deeper than any single kingdom's ambitions, forcing them to confront whether peace is truly possible when the powerful have so much to gain from war.

A group of survivors find themselves infected with mind flayer tadpoles — parasites that should transform them into tentacled monsters called illithids — but discover they are somehow immune to the process. Stranded in a dangerous region of Faerûn called the Sword Coast, they must find a cure before the parasite completes its transformation, navigating a vast world of warring factions, ancient gods, and forgotten conspiracies while confronting an emerging threat that could plunge the continent into darkness — and discovering that the power the parasite grants may be the only weapon capable of stopping it.

Set on a near-future Earth recovering from a global crisis, a disbanded international peacekeeping organisation called Overwatch has left the world without its heroes. Players choose from a diverse roster of soldiers, scientists, fighters, and outlaws — each with unique abilities — and compete in team-based objective matches across iconic real-world locations, with the broader lore delivered not through the game itself but through animated shorts, comics, and other external media that flesh out the rivalries and histories behind the characters on both sides of every battle.

Doctor Eggman discovers a mysterious gemstone called the Phantom Ruby and uses its power to create a squad of robotic enforcers called the Hard-Boiled Heavies, who teleport Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles across time and space to a series of classic and new zones warped by the ruby's reality-distorting energy. Racing to recover the Phantom Ruby before Eggman can harness its full power, the heroes fight through remixed environments drawn from the franchise's history, confronting the rogue Heavies who have developed their own ambitions beyond their creator's control.

A brooding, drug-dependent assassin known only as Zero is dispatched on a series of contract killings across a rain-soaked neo-noir city, manipulating time to rewind failed attempts and execute his targets flawlessly. Between missions, he meets with a mysterious psychiatrist who provides him with doses of a time-manipulation drug called Chronos — but as Zero begins questioning his orders and fragmentary visions of his past bleed through, the line between mission and memory begins to collapse, pulling him toward a truth about his identity that powerful people want buried.

Set in 1603 in the rugged, snow-blanketed lands of Ezo in northern Japan, a haunted mercenary named Atsu returns to the region where her family was slaughtered sixteen years earlier by a gang of six outlaws known as the Yōtei Six. Driven by vengeance, she travels across the wilderness surrounding the volcanic peak of Mount Yōtei — encountering the indigenous Ainu people and warring factions including the Matsumae clan — and discovers that her journey for revenge will force her to confront not only her enemies but the person she has become in the years since her family's death.

The peaceful nation of Orange Star comes under attack from three rival nations — Blue Moon, Yellow Comet, and Green Earth — who have been mysteriously provoked into war against it. A young Commanding Officer named Andy is deployed to lead Orange Star's forces across multiple fronts, working alongside fellow COs as they battle through dozens of tactical maps to uncover the true instigator behind the conflict threatening to engulf the entire continent of Macro Land.

In the sprawling fictional city of Los Santos, three criminals with intertwined fates navigate a world of heists, betrayals, and escalating federal pressure: a retired bank robber trying to hold his fractured family together, a street hustler desperate to escape the gang life that defines him, and a volatile, unhinged mercenary with a talent for violence and a deteriorating grip on reality. Pulled together by a series of increasingly audacious jobs, the three men find themselves caught between the FBI, the CIA, and ruthless billionaires — forced to collaborate in order to survive.

After his plane crashes in a forest, a greedy anti-hero stumbles upon a mysterious music box and is sucked inside, finding himself in a miniature world within. A hidden figure claiming to be a god promises to return him home and let him keep all the treasure he finds — if he recovers five magical music boxes scattered across the world — but the inhabitants of the world attack him at every turn, and the true nature of the entity he is helping is far more sinister than it first appears.

Six months after the destruction of the first Death Star, a young farm boy turned starfighter ace assembles an elite squadron of the Rebel Alliance's finest pilots to strike back against the Galactic Empire. Across sixteen missions spanning frozen wastes, desert canyons, and forest moons, the squadron carries out dogfights, bombing runs, rescues, and reconnaissance in X-wings, Y-wings, A-wings and snowspeeders. The Rebellion's survival hangs on their ability to outfly the Empire's overwhelming forces.

A hunter joins the Fifth Fleet of the Research Commission, a vast organisation tasked with investigating a newly discovered continent called the New World, where colossal Elder Dragons periodically migrate for unknown reasons. Tracking the ancient behemoth Zorah Magdaros across living ecosystems that react dynamically to the presence of its creatures, the hunter uncovers the true nature of the New World's ecosystem — an interconnected web of predators and prey shaped by the energy of a mysterious organism that draws the Elder Dragons across the sea.

A former mercenary named Byleth is appointed professor at the prestigious Officer's Academy of Garreg Mach Monastery, home to students from three rival nations — the Adrestian Empire, the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus, and the Leicester Alliance. After choosing one of the three noble houses to lead, Byleth guides their students through classroom life and tactical battles, before a timeskip tears the continent apart into full-scale war and forces them to confront the true history of Fódlan — and a mysterious goddess whose voice has guided Byleth since birth.

At the Black Mesa Research Facility in New Mexico, a routine experiment with an alien crystal sample goes catastrophically wrong, tearing open a dimensional rift that floods the complex with hostile extraterrestrial creatures. Theoretical physicist Gordon Freeman — equipped only with a hazard suit and whatever weapons he can scavenge — must fight his way through alien enemies and a government military clean-up team sent to silence all witnesses, navigating deep underground laboratories, surface military zones, and ultimately a portal to the alien homeworld to end the invasion.

In the magical Glade of Dreams, a mysterious villain called Mr. Dark steals the Great Protoon — the source of harmony and balance for the world — and imprisons the tiny Electoon creatures who orbited it inside cages scattered across six fantastical worlds. A limbless hero named Rayman, aided by a fairy named Betilla who gradually grants him new abilities, must travel through jungles, musical landscapes, and caverns to free all the captive Electoons and confront Mr. Dark to restore peace to his world.

A young soldier and his noble best friend Jowy are drawn into a devastating war between the City-States of Jowston and the Kingdom of Highland, ruled by the sadistic Prince Luca Blight — one of gaming's most reviled villains. Each bearing one half of the mystical Rune of the Beginning, the two friends find themselves on opposing sides of the conflict, and the protagonist must rally the 108 Stars of Destiny to build an army capable of ending the war while navigating betrayal, political intrigue, and an impossible friendship torn apart by fate.

A fictional Bolivia in 2019 has fallen under the control of the Santa Blanca drug cartel, which has corrupted the government and transformed the country into the world's largest cocaine producer. A four-person U.S. Special Forces unit called the Ghosts is deployed covertly to dismantle the cartel from within by eliminating its leaders one by one across a vast open-world environment spanning mountains, jungles, deserts, and salt flats.

After a mysterious video transmission shows an X Parasite — a species believed to be extinct — still alive on the remote planet ZDR, bounty hunter Samus Aran is dispatched to investigate, only to find the planet overrun by hostile lifeforms and seven near-indestructible EMMI robots hunting her relentlessly. Stripped of her abilities and forced to rebuild her arsenal as she explores ZDR's interconnected environments, Samus uncovers the origin of the transmission and faces a threat that challenges everything she thought she knew about her own nature.

The five crew members of a cargo spaceship called the Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space following a mysterious crash, with supplies dwindling and no hope of rescue. The captain — alive but catastrophically injured, unable to speak or move — is blamed by the crew for deliberately causing the collision, while the game's non-linear narrative unfolds across disjointed scenes both before and after the crash, slowly revealing the disturbing truth of what happened aboard the ship.

A thousand years after a cataclysmic conflict called the War of the Magi rendered magic extinct, the world has rebuilt itself through technology and iron — but the militaristic Gestahlian Empire has rediscovered magical creatures called Espers and begun weaponising their power to conquer the world. A young woman named Terra, the only human born with innate magical ability, escapes the Empire's control and joins a rebel group called the Returners, triggering a chain of events that eventually brings the world to ruin under the gleeful malevolence of Kefka Palazzo — a deranged former general who ascends to godhood and forces the survivors to find meaning in a shattered world.

Presented without a traditional narrative, the game invites players into an encyclopaedic celebration of automotive history through GT Simulation Mode — a series of café-guided menus that assign car collections and events to educate players on the stories behind different manufacturers, eras, and racing disciplines. Starting with modest road cars and progressing through licences, championships, circuit experiences, and special events, players build a garage of hundreds of meticulously modelled vehicles from over 60 manufacturers — each rendered with obsessive attention to detail across circuits drawn from both real-world motorsport venues and the series' own legendary fictional tracks.

A tiny alien astronaut named Captain Olimar is on an interstellar vacation when a meteorite destroys his ship, sending him crash-landing on an unknown Earth-like planet where the oxygen-rich atmosphere is toxic to his species. With only 30 days of life support remaining before his suit fails, Olimar must enlist the help of native plant-animal creatures he dubs Pikmin — growing and commanding armies of them across the planet's varied environments to recover the 30 scattered parts of his ship before time runs out.

When the ruthless hunter Kraven the Hunter arrives in New York City and transforms it into a massive open-air hunting ground for super-powered individuals, both Peter Parker and Miles Morales must balance their lives as Spider-Men against new personal crises. The situation grows more dangerous when an alien symbiote bonds with Peter, gradually corrupting his personality and threatening to destroy his relationships — forcing Miles to step up and ultimately confront whether Peter can be saved before the symbiote's influence becomes permanent.

On a group of islands southeast of Australia, a mad scientist named Doctor Neo Cortex and his assistant have been experimenting on local marsupials with a genetic evolution ray and a mind-control device called the Cortex Vortex, building an army of mutated animals to dominate the world. When the procedure fails on a bandicoot named Crash — leaving him uncontrollable — Cortex jettisons him from his castle, but Crash resolves to fight back across the islands to rescue his captured girlfriend Tawna and confront the scientist responsible for his creation.

An orphan raised within the fortress library of Candlekeep watches their foster father Gorion die at the hands of a mysterious armoured figure, and is forced to flee into the dangerous Sword Coast wilderness. Gathering a party of companions and uncovering a conspiracy involving a tainted iron supply that is destabilising the region, the young protagonist gradually discovers a dark truth about their own heritage — that they carry the divine blood of Bhaal, the dead god of murder — and must confront a half-sibling who seeks to harness that bloodline to ascend to godhood.

Two years after winning the first King of Iron Fist Tournament and seizing control of the Mishima Zaibatsu, Kazuya Mishima announces a second tournament — using it as cover to consolidate his global power while secretly conducting dark genetic experiments. His father Heihachi, who survived being thrown from a cliff, enters the tournament to reclaim what was taken from him, alongside a cast of fighters with their own grievances against Kazuya's empire, each pursuing a personal reckoning with the new ruler of the Zaibatsu.

A player character accepts a getaway package from Nook Inc. — the enterprise of a cheerful tanuki named Tom Nook — and moves to a remote deserted island with only a tent, basic tools, and two animal neighbours. Without any fixed objectives, the player is free to gather resources, craft furniture and tools, attract new animal residents, customise their island's landscape and buildings, and participate in seasonal events and real-time celebrations tied to the Nintendo Switch's internal clock — gradually transforming a bare island into a thriving personalised community.

A young boy named Ness awakens in the middle of the night to find a meteorite has crashed near his house, and discovers a message from the future warning that an alien force of pure evil called Giygas will destroy all life. Guided by this prophecy, Ness travels across a quirky, satirical version of suburban America — visiting cities named Onett, Twoson, and Fourside — gathering three companions and collecting eight melodies from sacred sanctuaries to gain the power needed to confront the cosmic horror threatening all existence.

Set in a fictionalised recreation of Great Britain encompassing Edinburgh, the Scottish Highlands, the Lake District, and the Cotswolds, players compete in the Horizon Festival — an open-world automotive celebration featuring hundreds of licensed cars across racing, off-road, and stunt disciplines. The world changes dynamically each week through a real-time seasonal cycle of spring, summer, autumn, and winter, with each season altering the landscape, weather, and available events in a shared online world populated by other players and their Drivatars.

Set one year after the events of Halo 5, the Master Chief is recovered adrift in space following a catastrophic defeat at the hands of the Banished — a mercenary alien army that has seized control of the Forerunner ringworld Zeta Halo. Deployed back onto the ring with a new AI companion called The Weapon, the Chief must fight across an open landscape to dismantle the Banished leadership, uncover the fate of his former AI partner Cortana, and prevent the Banished from activating the ring's destructive power.

Players step into a cosy kitchen under the tutelage of an enthusiastic and expressive maternal figure known simply as Mama, who guides them through the preparation of 76 real-world dishes ranging from fried eggs to cabbage meat rolls. Using the Nintendo DS stylus across more than 200 touch-based minigames, players chop, slice, knead, fry, grate, and plate their way through increasingly complex recipes — with Mama reacting warmly to success and with theatrical dismay to mistakes.

Doctor Robotnik has discovered a new source of power in the seven Chaos Emeralds buried beneath West Side Island, and launches a full-scale invasion to enslave its animals and convert them into robots for his army. Sonic the Hedgehog, joined for the first time by a young two-tailed fox named Miles Prower, races through eleven zones to dismantle Robotnik's forces and prevent him from launching the deadly Death Egg space station into orbit.

Set within the timeframe of the original Star Wars trilogy, players are dropped into iconic large-scale battles across planets including Hoth, Endor, Tatooine, and Sullust, fighting as either Rebel Alliance or Galactic Empire forces. With no traditional campaign, the experience centres entirely on multiplayer skirmishes involving infantry, vehicles, and playable heroes from the films — from Darth Vader and Boba Fett to Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia — in a cinematic recreation of Star Wars ground and aerial combat.

Prince Chrom of the Halidom of Ylisse leads a band of shepherds tasked with protecting the realm, joined by a mysterious amnesiac tactician found unconscious in a field with no memory of their past. As a war with the neighbouring nation of Plegia escalates and an army of the undead called the Risen spreads across the land, Chrom and his companions discover that a far darker threat — a fell dragon of apocalyptic power — is stirring, and that the tactician's forgotten past may be inextricably tied to the fate of the entire world.

An unknown skateboarder from New Jersey dreams of turning pro alongside his best friend, a talented but egotistical local skater named Eric Sparrow. After catching the attention of touring pros and earning a shot at the big time in New Jersey, Tampa, and eventually New York, the protagonist follows Eric to Hawaii and then Moscow, gradually uncovering Eric's true self-serving nature — as his former friend steals credit, sabotages his career, and escalates from friendly rival to genuine antagonist in a story far more character-driven than anything the series had previously attempted.

In an alternate Victorian era where a catastrophic volcanic winter has plunged the world into a deep freeze, survivors gather around a massive coal-powered generator — the last source of heat on Earth — and struggle to build a functioning city in its shadow. As the city's leader, the player must manage resources, issue laws, and make increasingly desperate moral choices — balancing the survival of the population against the cost to their humanity — as temperatures continue to drop and the generator's limits are pushed beyond what its designers ever intended.

There is no traditional narrative — the player creates and controls virtual people called Sims, guiding them through daily life in a suburban neighbourhood by managing their needs, relationships, careers, and homes. Without direction, Sims will pursue autonomous routines, but their happiness, ambitions, and social lives flourish or decay entirely based on the player's choices, making every household a unique story shaped by whoever is playing.

In 1349 France, amid the Black Death and the brutal campaign of the Inquisition, a noblewoman named Amicia is forced to flee her family's estate with her young brother Hugo after soldiers slaughter their father. Hugo suffers from a mysterious illness that draws both the Inquisition and supernatural swarms of plague-carrying rats toward him, and as Amicia struggles to protect him across a ravaged countryside, she begins to uncover the terrifying truth behind his condition and the ancient force connected to it.

British secret agent James Bond is sent to investigate a weapons control centre in the Soviet Union, where his fellow agent Alec Trevelyan is apparently killed during the mission. Years later, a criminal syndicate wielding control of the deadly GoldenEye satellite weapon threatens to trigger a global financial catastrophe, and Bond is tasked with dismantling the network — only to discover that Trevelyan survived, and is now the enemy orchestrating the entire conspiracy.

On the dying desert world of Filgaia, a spirited young Drifter named Virginia Maxwell foils an attempted train robbery and crosses paths with three other wanderers — a stoic gunfighter, a rogue sorcerer, and a mysterious lone wolf — each searching for their own answers. United by fate, the four form an unlikely team whose investigation into a series of catastrophic events gradually reveals an ancient conspiracy threatening to accelerate Filgaia's extinction, forcing them to confront both the world's dark past and each other's hidden secrets.

Specter and his army of Pipo Helmet-wearing monkeys launch a global takeover by hijacking every television broadcast on the planet, beaming mind-numbing programming that renders the world's population too dazed to resist. A boy named Kei and his sister Yumi are the only two unaffected, and must travel through TV studios themed around different genres — from action films to soap operas to sporting events — to capture the mischievous primates and reclaim control of the airwaves.

The fourth World Fighting Tournament is announced, drawing a roster of martial artists from around the globe to compete in one-on-one combat. Returning fighters are joined by two new combatants — a Chinese martial artist specialising in a fluid, deceptive Shaolin style, and a deadly female mercenary trained in multiple disciplines — while the shadowy organisation J6 continues to manipulate events behind the scenes, pursuing its own agenda through the violence of the tournament.

On the war-ravaged planet Hillys, a young photojournalist named Jade runs an orphanage for children displaced by an endless alien conflict, living under the supposed protection of a government defence force called the Alpha Sections. When a rebel organisation called the IRIS Network recruits her to investigate rumours that the Alpha Sections are secretly in league with the alien enemy, Jade uses her camera and combat skills to infiltrate increasingly dangerous facilities and expose a planet-wide conspiracy that goes all the way to the top of the government she once trusted.

A convicted murderer named Torque arrives at a maximum-security prison on Carnate Island, Maryland, sentenced to death for allegedly killing his ex-wife and two children — a crime he has no memory of committing. On the night of his arrival, a catastrophic earthquake tears the prison apart and releases monstrous creatures onto the island, each embodying a different form of execution historically used on the island's condemned. Fighting to survive and escape, Torque is haunted by visions of his past that may hold the key to both his innocence and the island's dark history.

In a world devastated by catastrophic volcanic eruptions that have poisoned the air and destroyed natural resources, two rival nations — the prosperous Asylia and the impoverished Mokai — wage a brutal war for survival using armies of trained battle dragons. A veteran Asylian sky guard named Rohn begins to question his loyalty after witnessing the cruelty of his own nation, eventually defecting to the Mokai cause and turning his dragon against those he once served.

A young spirit guide named Kena travels to a long-abandoned mountain village, seeking the sacred Mountain Shrine at its heart. To reach it, she must help the spirits of the deceased move on from the physical world — uncovering the traumatic events that bound them to the land and collecting a growing army of tiny spirit companions called the Rot, whose abilities become central to both exploration and combat as Kena unravels the village's dark history.

An elite psi-operative named Nick Scryer wakes strapped to a chair with his memory erased, planted inside a terrorist organisation called The Movement as a sleeper agent. As his psychic abilities — including telekinesis, mind control, pyrokinesis, and remote viewing — slowly return, he begins reconstructing his past and unravelling the conspiracy behind Mindgate, the secret programme that created him, racing to stop The Movement's plot to seize control of a devastating psychic weapon.

In a near-future world where governments have outsourced all military operations to private corporations, a soldier enlists with the powerful Mantel Global Industries, whose troops are chemically enhanced by a performance drug called Nectar that suppresses fear, boosts strength, and filters out the ugliness of war. When the drug begins to wear off and the sanitised battlefield reveals its true horror, the soldier defects to the rebel faction he was sent to destroy — and discovers the sinister truth behind Nectar and the corporation profiting from endless conflict.

title: Jak and Daxter: The Lost Frontier

hints.plot: Jak and his companions travel to the edge of the world — a vast region called the Brink — in search of ancient Precursor technology that may explain why eco, the life force powering their civilisation, is rapidly disappearing. After crash-landing in uncharted territory, they become entangled in a conflict with sky pirates and a ruthless militaristic empire, while Jak wrestles with a dangerous surge of dark eco threatening to consume him from within.

A hulking warrior named Rau, accompanied by his small bird companion Kuzo who scouts ahead and marks enemies for battle, is drawn into a shadowy conspiracy when a chance encounter in a tavern reveals that a powerful dark magic is being resurrected by a mysterious cult. Travelling across jungle villages, ancient temples, and coastal fortresses, Rau must confront wave after wave of enemies using a fluid combat system that lets him simultaneously engage multiple opponents, while uncovering the sinister meaning behind the mark that has been left upon him.

Set in the year 2160, the F9000 Anti-Gravity Racing League represents the pinnacle of futuristic motorsport — a high-stakes competition in which pilots from rival teams push illegally engineered craft to their absolute limits across circuits that twist through corkscrew tunnels, massive loops, and barrel rolls. As each team vies for supremacy, pilots must master both the raw speed of their vehicles and the strategic use of weapons and shield systems to survive a championship where the crashes are as spectacular as the victories.

Treasure hunter Chloe Frazer enlists the aid of mercenary Nadine Ross to recover the Tusk of Ganesh — a priceless ancient Indian artefact — from a ruthless insurgent leader named Asav, who is using the region's civil war as cover to locate the relic for his own destructive ends. Venturing deep into India's Western Ghats mountain range, the two women must overcome their mutual distrust and confront the personal history driving each of them, before Asav can use the tusk to plunge the country into catastrophe.

In the world of ModNation, custom-built Mod racers compete in high-octane kart racing events across a variety of wild tracks. A rookie racer named Tag, accompanied by his mechanic MBK, rises through the ranks of the ModNation circuit to challenge the reigning champion AF — uncovering a conspiracy by a ruthless sponsor to manipulate the championship — in a story that serves primarily as a colourful backdrop for the game's deep player-creation and track-building tools.

A bullied teenager named Ash discovers a magical paintbrush that brings his artwork to life, and uses it to explore his once-vibrant hometown of Denska — now polluted and abandoned. As he paints living creatures and luminous landscapes across the town's darkened walls, he must also face the bullies who torment him and uncover a creeping supernatural darkness threatening everything. Through creativity and courage, Ash alone has the power to restore light and life to his forgotten home.

A small paper messenger named Iota — or Atoi, depending on the player's choice — embarks on a quest across a world made entirely of paper and craft materials to deliver a single message to the only person who exists outside this world: you, the player. Along the way the messenger must contend with Scraps, malevolent creatures made of torn paper who have invaded through a hole in the sky where your face appears, while the world itself reacts and transforms in response to the player's direct physical interaction through the Vita's touch screens and camera.

Treasure hunter Nathan Drake and his mentor Victor Sullivan are drawn into a conspiracy surrounding the legendary lost city of Iram of the Pillars — the so-called Atlantis of the Sands — hidden somewhere in the Arabian Desert. Their pursuit brings them into conflict with a secretive British organisation led by the ruthless Katherine Marlowe, who has manipulated Sullivan into her service, forcing Drake to question everything he thought he knew about his mentor and his own past.

A scientist creates a small but remarkable creature named Knack — built from ancient relics that give him the ability to absorb additional pieces and grow from a tiny three-foot figure into a colossal wrecking machine. When a goblin army launches an attack on human civilisation by raiding armories and weaponising ancient technology, Knack is deployed as humanity's unlikely champion, though a betrayal within the doctor's inner circle threatens to turn the crisis into something far more dangerous.

Thirty years after the destruction of the Helghast home planet, a fragile peace holds on the colonised world of Vekta, where surviving Helghast and native Vektans live side by side separated by an enormous security wall. A young Shadow Marshal is drawn into a conspiracy that threatens to collapse the uneasy coexistence into all-out war, forced to operate in moral grey areas between both factions as a powerful Helghast leader pursues a plan of catastrophic retaliation.

Set in the weeks following the Chimera's invasion of Britain, a British Royal Marine is forced to kill his own brother inside a Chimeran conversion centre to spare him a fate worse than death — an act that drives him to embark on a solo vendetta against every conversion centre across Europe. Recruited by the Maquis resistance after his rampage proves futile against the Chimera's evolving methods, he joins Operation Overstrike in a desperate campaign to liberate the European continent from alien occupation.

A reserved and emotionally detached mercenary named Squall, trained at an elite military academy, is drawn into a world-spanning conflict after being tasked with supporting a resistance group against an expansionist military nation. When a powerful sorceress from a distant future begins reaching back through time to seize control of all eras simultaneously, Squall and his companions must confront both the enemy and their own pasts — as strange dreams begin revealing a shared history none of them can quite explain.

A long-haul trucker passing through a fog-shrouded mountain town on a detour rescues a young girl from a burning house — only for her to vanish before an ambulance arrives, pulling him deeper into the nightmare that has consumed the town. As he searches for answers about the girl and the fire, he begins reliving repressed childhood memories tied to a psychiatric institution, uncovering the traumatic origins of the evil that has made the town a place of damnation.

An NYPD rookie officer witnesses a horrific event at Carnegie Hall on Christmas Eve when the audience and performers spontaneously combust — all except herself and a captivating soprano named Eve, who claims to be awakening the true power of mitochondria within all living cells. As Eve begins transforming humans and animals into monstrous creatures while pursuing a catastrophic biological agenda, the officer must pursue her across a devastated New York City, unlocking her own mysterious mitochondrial abilities along the way.

In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by dangerous creatures called Shades, a young man dedicates himself to finding a cure for his younger sister Yonah, who is afflicted with a deadly and incurable illness known as the Black Scrawl. Accompanied by a foul-mouthed, cursed warrior named Kainé, a boy who has been transformed into a living weapon, and a sarcastic magical tome named Grimoire Weiss, he travels a dying world in search of the Sealed Verses needed to break the Shadowlord's power — unaware of the devastating truth behind his sister's disease and humanity's fate.

Three years after surviving the horrors of Beacon Mental Hospital, a broken detective living in self-imposed exile is approached by a shadowy organisation with a revelation: his daughter, believed dead in a house fire years ago, is alive — and trapped inside a new STEM simulation built around an idyllic small town. Descending once more into the collapsing nightmare world, he must hunt for his daughter before the simulation tears itself apart, navigating twisted enemies, a rogue photographer who turns his victims into art, and a fanatical priest building his own paradise from the inside.

In the magical land of Albion, a young boy's village is razed by bandits, killing his family and setting him on a path to join the Heroes' Guild — an order of legendary warriors, mages, and rogues for hire. As he grows from child to adult, every action he takes shapes not only his skills but his very body and reputation, culminating in a confrontation with a masked sorcerer whose pursuit of an ancient, all-powerful sword threatens to plunge Albion into darkness.

While on a well-earned vacation, a heroic duo encounter a young girl writing a school report on legendary heroes — only for her to be abducted by mysterious robots shortly after. Investigating her disappearance leads the pair to uncover the Technomites, a long-dismissed race of tiny genius inventors who have been working in secret throughout history, and whose bitter leader has hatched a scheme using the hero's own DNA to create the ultimate army of cloned soldiers.

Set in 1974, a legendary mercenary commander known as Big Boss is approached in Costa Rica by a Nicaraguan revolutionary and her professor, who seek his private military company's help in dealing with a mysterious armed force that has occupied their country. Investigating the occupation leads Big Boss to confront the legacy of his fallen mentor, the spectre of nuclear deterrence, and the construction of a bipedal nuclear-armed weapon that will force him to decide what it truly means to build a nation outside the bounds of any government.

Presented without a conventional narrative, the game invites players into an obsessively detailed simulation of real-world motorsport, progressing through a series of licence tests, regional championships, and manufacturer-specific events to become the ultimate driver. Beginning with modest street cars and working toward high-performance prototypes and racing machines, players earn prize money to purchase, upgrade, and tune vehicles from over 150 real manufacturers — each modelled and handled with meticulous attention to authenticity.

During the long war between the ISA and the Helghast Empire, a former soldier turned mercenary is hired to carry out operations too sensitive for regular military personnel — bouncing between both factions as the highest bidder demands. When a mission to extract a Vektan ambassador's family uncovers a biological weapon capable of wiping out an entire planet, the mercenary is forced to question his loyalty to profit and decide whether some outcomes are worth fighting for regardless of pay.

When the pages of the legendary Cooper Clan's ancient book of thieving techniques begin mysteriously vanishing, a master thief and his gang of misfit partners reunite after years apart to investigate. Using a time machine, they travel through five distinct historical eras — from feudal Japan to ancient Arabia — to track down a villainous time traveller who is erasing the Cooper family legacy from history itself.

Three years after the cursed sword Soul Edge was shattered, its fragments have scattered across the world, each radiating malevolent energy and drawing warriors from every corner of history to seek them out. Some pursue the shards to claim Soul Edge's power for themselves, others to destroy the evil sword once and for all, while a resurrected champion of darkness moves quietly to reunite the pieces and unleash catastrophe upon the world.

During the Chimera invasion of the American east coast in 1951, a New York City firefighter is swept into the conflict while desperately searching for his wife and daughter amid the chaos. Armed with conventional weapons and salvaged Chimeran technology, he joins a Minutemen resistance cell and battles through overrun cities and military installations, uncovering a secret that could alter the course of the war.

The fifth World Fighting Tournament has been announced, drawing a roster of martial artists from across the globe to compete in one-on-one combat. Among the returning fighters and two new entrants — a young Chinese girl trained in Monkey Kung Fu and a Lucha Libre champion from Mexico — each competitor carries personal ambitions and unresolved rivalries, all converging on a tournament controlled by the shadowy Judgment 6 organisation.

Set decades before the events of earlier entries in the series, the game depicts the earliest years of anti-gravity racing in a near-future megalopolis known as Nova State City. As the sport rises from illegal street circuits to sanctioned championship events, pilots compete across rain-slicked urban tracks and elevated highways in increasingly powerful craft, battling rival teams with both speed and weapons to establish dominance in the first Anti-Gravity Racing Championships.

Trying to impress a woman at a bar, Zeke Dunbar spins an elaborate tall tale set during a gothic festival in New Marais, in which his best friend is bitten and turned by an ancient vampire queen named Bloody Mary. Newly transformed and under Bloody Mary's growing influence, the hero must race against the clock — with only a single night before sunrise — to hunt down and destroy the vampire queen before he loses his humanity forever and becomes her eternal servant.

When a bumbling young boy accidentally delivers a batch of mind-enhancing Pipo Helmets to the primates of Monkey Park instead of just their trousers, the villainous white ape Specter seizes the opportunity to build a new army of super-intelligent monkeys bent on world domination. Armed with an arsenal of gadgets and accompanied by a friendly baby monkey named Pipotchi, the boy must travel across dozens of themed stages to recapture the rogue primates — including a sinister elite squad empowered by strength-enhancing Vita-Z bananas.

title: God of War: Ghost of Sparta

hints.plot: Still tormented by visions of his mortal past, the God of War travels to Atlantis in search of answers about his origins, where he discovers that his brother Deimos — believed dead since childhood — is still alive and imprisoned in the Domain of Death by the God Thanatos. Driven by guilt and rage, he descends into the realm of the dead to rescue his brother, confronting the dark truth about a prophecy that has haunted the gods of Olympus since both brothers were children.

Just six weeks after Emergence Day — the catastrophic moment the Locust Horde first broke through the surface of Sera — Lieutenant Damon Baird and his Kilo Squad stand before a military tribunal, accused of disobeying orders and the unauthorized use of a Lightmass Missile. As the trial unfolds through flashbacks, Kilo Squad relives their desperate battle to save the coastal city of Halvo Bay from a terrifying Locust general, and the chain of decisions that led them to be branded criminals for choices they believed were necessary to survive.

In the fictional dystopian city of Midtown, a mysterious figure called Calypso recruits a cast of deranged and broken souls — plucked from a crumbling mental asylum — to compete in a brutal vehicular combat tournament. Each contestant fights for the chance to have a single wish granted, but behind every desperate desire lies a dark and twisted backstory that unfolds as the carnage escalates.

After falling into a century-long slumber, a limbless hero and his companions awaken to find the Glade of Dreams overrun by nightmares — the result of a corrupted Magician who has fractured into five dark entities called the Dark Teensies. Together with a new barbarian ally and a helpful creature named Murfy, the heroes must travel through enchanted worlds trapped inside mysterious paintings to rescue hundreds of imprisoned Teensies and defeat the darkness threatening their realm.

In a lawless frontier of space, a hired gun who was partially exposed to a volatile energy source called Rift Energy — leaving him half-mutated — is summoned back to the mining colony he once called home. Caught between the human Rifters who exploit the resource and the fully mutated Outcasts who worship it, he must confront his corrupted brother, who now leads the Outcast warband threatening to destroy everything that remains of his past life.

After their home city is attacked by Emperor Tachyon — a tyrannical ruler of an ancient insectoid race with a vendetta against the last of the Lombax species — a mechanic and his robot companion steal the emperor's warship and flee to a distant galaxy. As they unravel the mystery of the Lombaxes and the secret weapon Tachyon seeks, the mechanic begins to discover the truth about his own origins and the fate of his people.

In the aftermath of a brutal confrontation between three generations of the Mishima bloodline, a mysterious army of Jack robots attacks the family compound and seemingly kills the patriarch. With the Mishima Zaibatsu seized by an unknown successor, a new King of Iron Fist Tournament is announced — drawing fighters from across the world to compete, while Jin Kazama pursues his own answers about his cursed lineage and the demonic power within him.

Following the assassination of the Helghast Emperor, ISA soldiers Sev and Rico find themselves stranded deep behind enemy lines on the hostile planet of Helghan, outmanned and fighting for survival. With two ruthless Helghast commanders vying to fill the power vacuum left by their fallen leader, the ISA must battle through arctic wastelands, alien jungles, and orbital space stations in a desperate bid to escape the planet before it tears itself apart.

CIA operative Alex Mason sits strapped to a chair under interrogation, unable to recall key memories that may reveal the location of a devastating numbers station targeting the United States with a chemical weapons sleeper network. As his captors force him to relive missions across Cuba, Vietnam, Laos, and the Soviet Union, Mason struggles to untangle which memories are real — and why a dead man's voice keeps echoing through them.

In a far-future Earth repopulated by evolved marine life, a young Inkling — a humanoid creature capable of transforming into a squid — discovers that a mysterious force has stolen the Great Zapfish powering their city of Inkopolis. Venturing into an underground facility built by the rival Octarian race, the hero must battle through enemy territory to reclaim the stolen electricity source and stop the Octarians from invading the surface world.

After the ruins of a villainous scientist's space station crash-land on Earth, they release a powerful ancient evil — a dark spirit who joins forces with the scientist and a time-obsessed doctor to use a massive time machine to scatter powerful crystals across history. Crash and his sister Coco must travel through time — from ancient Egypt to medieval Europe to the far future — to collect the crystals first and prevent the trio from enslaving the world.

Two of Outworld's most powerful sorcerers — Quan Chi and Shang Tsung — forge a secret pact, swiftly eliminating both the Emperor of Outworld and Earthrealm's greatest champion before retreating to resurrect an ancient, undefeatable army. With Earthrealm's usual protectors scrambling to respond, Raiden rallies a group of warriors to confront the alliance before the undead army can be fully revived and all realms fall under the sorcerers' control.

An Agency Agent — a genetically enhanced supersoldier — is deployed to the crime-ridden Pacific City, where three powerful criminal organisations have carved the metropolis into their own territories. As the Agent eliminates bosses and their lieutenants, he grows stronger, faster, and more capable, eventually uncovering a far darker truth about the Agency that sent him.

A new warrior chosen by the Lazarus Concordance is summoned to the Lost Land to confront a powerful imprisoned alien entity known as the Primagen, who seeks to destroy the universe rather than allow himself to remain captive. Venturing through six massive environments — from jungle ports to subterranean caverns — the hero must complete objectives, protect sacred energy totems, and ultimately prevent the Primagen from merging his Lightship with the fabric of existence.

In an alternate-history Victorian London, an ancient order of knights descended from the legends of the Round Table battles a centuries-old war against half-breeds — humans who have evolved supernatural, bestial traits. When a senior knight begins uncovering links between rebel insurgents and the half-breed threat, he sets in motion a conspiracy that reaches to the very heart of the Order itself.

A samurai responds to a distress call from his cousin, Princess Yuki, whose castle has been overrun by demonic forces following the death of warlord Nobunaga Oda in battle. Equipped with a mystical gauntlet granted by the Oni clan, he fights through the demon-infested fortress to rescue her, uncovering a supernatural conspiracy to resurrect Nobunaga using dark power.

Engineer Isaac Clarke travels to the frozen, hostile planet of Tau Volantis alongside soldier John Carver to uncover the origins of the Necromorph threat and find a way to stop it permanently. Battling through blizzards, ancient alien ruins, and a fanatical human cult called the Unitologists, the two must confront the truth behind the mysterious Markers before the universe is consumed.

hints.metacritic_note: Score based on Japanese import reviews; the JP version lacked online multiplayer at launch.
hints.plot: Competitors from around the world descend on the brutal terrain of Monument Valley for the MotorStorm Festival — an anarchic, no-rules off-road racing event. Drivers select from seven vehicle classes, from nimble dirt bikes to monstrous big rigs, and tear across deforming mud tracks, each vying to win by any means necessary.

A mysterious inter-dimensional vacuum cleaner called the Negativitron descends upon Craftworld and begins consuming its inhabitants and worlds. A small fabric creature joins a secret organisation led by the eccentric inventor Larry Da Vinci, teaming up with a colourful cast of Creator Curators across six worlds to push back the Negativitron and save Craftworld from total destruction.

Following a desperate defence of Europe against an alien-like invasion, a soldier infected with the Chimeran virus travels to the United States as the enemy launches a full-scale assault on both coasts. Now part of an elite squad of similarly infected fighters, he must battle the invaders across the country while struggling to contain the virus raging inside him before it consumes him entirely.

title: The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay

hints.plot: The notorious fugitive Riddick is captured by a bounty hunter and delivered to Butcher Bay, a triple-maximum security prison on a remote planet — a facility from which no one has ever escaped. Using stealth, brutal hand-to-hand combat, and his extraordinary ability to see in total darkness, he must fight through guards, criminals, and the prison's darkest secrets to find a way out.

A globe-trotting archaeologist searches for fragments of a mythical sword connected to the disappearance of her mother years earlier, racing across Bolivia, Peru, Japan, Ghana, Kazakhstan, England, and Nepal against her former friend — now a dangerous adversary — who seeks the same artefact for her own mysterious ends.

Six months after being tricked by the God of War into slaughtering his own wife and daughter, a Spartan warrior breaks his blood oath and is imprisoned and tortured by the three Furies — ancient mythological enforcers of sacred bonds. With the help of a conflicted oath keeper, he fights to escape his chains, confront the Furies, and take his first steps on the long road to vengeance.

Two years after a failed Helghast invasion of the human colony Vekta, the ISA launches a retaliatory assault on the enemy's toxic home world of Helghan. A battle-hardened special forces soldier fights through the ruins of the Helghast capital alongside his squad, with orders to capture the charismatic and ruthless Emperor Visari and bring the Helghast war machine to its knees.

A prisoner escapes their cell aboard a crashed spacecraft on the surface of an alien world called Na Pali, only to find the planet's peaceful native inhabitants enslaved by a ruthless warrior race. Armed with a translator to decode alien messages and a growing arsenal of exotic weaponry, the lone survivor must fight through ancient temples, mountain villages, and alien installations to find a way off the planet.

Players race high-speed cars through busy US roads and highways, earning boost by taking extreme risks such as driving into oncoming traffic, drifting corners, and catching air. A dedicated Crash mode challenges drivers to cause the most spectacular and costly pile-ups possible at busy junctions, while a Pursuit mode puts players behind the wheel of a police cruiser tasked with wrecking a fleeing criminal's car.

Fifty years after the events of its predecessor, the industrialised kingdom of Albion is ruled by a tyrannical king who is the player character's own brother. A prince or princess must rally allies, spark a revolution, and seize the throne — only to discover that ruling is far harder than rebelling when a devastating threat from beyond Albion demands impossible sacrifices.

A group of new Vault Hunters arrive on the hostile planet of Pandora, only to be ambushed and left for dead by the planet's charismatic and sadistic corporate dictator. Rescued by a lone robot, they join a ragtag resistance movement to hunt down the tyrant, uncover the secret of a second Vault, and stop him from unleashing a devastating ancient evil upon the galaxy.

title: Ratchet and Clank: A Crack in Time

hints.plot: After his robot companion is abducted by the Zoni and handed over to the villainous Dr. Nefarious, a Lombax mechanic races across the galaxy to stage a rescue. Meanwhile, the robot awakens inside a colossal structure at the centre of the universe designed to maintain time itself, slowly uncovering the truth about his origins as Nefarious schemes to seize control of time for his own ends.

Falsely blamed for the destruction of Haven City, a young hero and his wisecracking companion are exiled into a vast, deadly desert wasteland by a scheming count. Rescued by the ruler of a desert city, they must prove their worth while uncovering a conspiracy involving ancient precursor technology, a three-way war back in Haven City, and the origins of the hero's mysterious dark and light powers.

A roster of larger-than-life snowboarders compete across outrageous mountain courses set in locations around the world, from a neon-lit Tokyo pinball machine to the frozen wilds of Alaska. Players race and perform increasingly absurd tricks to fill a boost meter, unlocking devastating Uber moves that defy the laws of physics and propel riders to victory.

A test subject wakes inside a vast scientific research facility and is guided through a series of increasingly dangerous puzzle chambers by a passive-aggressive artificial intelligence. Armed with a device capable of creating linked portals on flat surfaces, she must use spatial reasoning and momentum to escape — all while her unseen overseer promises cake as a reward.

A bike courier survives a massive explosion that devastates several city blocks of a quarantined metropolis, emerging with extraordinary electricity-based superpowers. Trapped in a city overrun by criminal factions, he must decide whether to use his abilities for heroism or self-interest, all while uncovering the dark truth behind the explosion and the mysterious figure who engineered it.

Mario and Luigi take a vacation to Dinosaur Land, only to find Princess Peach has been kidnapped by Bowser and the Koopalings. Joining forces with a young dinosaur named Yoshi, Mario sets off across seven worlds to defeat Bowser's children and rescue the princess.

With the last human city destroyed and survivors scattered, a soldier learns his scientist father is still alive and being held captive. He leads his squad across a war-torn planet to find him, facing both the Locust Horde and a new, more dangerous mutant threat in a desperate bid to save what remains of humanity.

title: Call of Duty: World at War

hints.plot: Fighting across two brutal theaters of World War II, you experience war from dual perspectives: as American Marine Private C. Miller battling through the unforgiving Pacific jungles of Makin, Peleliu, and Okinawa against the fanatical Japanese Imperial Army with Banzai charges, Kamikaze attacks, and ambushes; and as Soviet Red Army soldier Private Dimitri Petrenko pushing into Nazi Germany alongside the ruthless Sergeant Viktor Reznov, witnessing the horrors of the Eastern Front from Stalingrad to the apocalyptic Battle of Berlin. From flamethrower assaults on Japanese bunkers to planting the Soviet flag atop the Reichstag, you fight through the bloodiest battles that brought the Axis powers to their knees while uncovering the true cost of total war.

Competing as one of thirteen professional skateboarders including Tony Hawk, Rodney Mullen, and Bob Burnquist, you travel across iconic locations from Philadelphia's Love Park to Marseilles, France to earn sponsorships and achieve legendary pro status. Each skatepark presents goals like collecting S-K-A-T-E letters, achieving high scores, finding hidden tapes, and pulling off specific trick combos within two-minute runs. As you earn cash from completing objectives and nailing massive trick chains using the revolutionary manual technique to link combos, you invest in stat upgrades and unlock new boards. Between competitions and free skate sessions, you customize your own skater's appearance and create custom skateparks to share, grinding and flipping your way to skateboarding immortality.

Master thief Garrett returns to his life of larceny in the metropolis known only as the City, where the fanatical Mechanist sect has emerged with advanced steam-powered technology and robotic servants. When newly appointed Sheriff Gorman Truart places a price on Garrett's head, the master burglar must navigate a conspiracy involving the Mechanists, corrupt officials, and an ancient prophecy called the Metal Age. Moving through sprawling urban environments from nobles' mansions to mechanized facilities, Garrett employs stealth and cunning to complete heists, gather intelligence, and uncover the truth about the Mechanists' zealous leader Karras and his plan to cleanse the city with a deadly technological plague while staying one step ahead of authorities determined to see him captured or dead.

Several years after the Order of the Sword incident, demon hunter Nero loses his demonic Devil Bringer arm to a mysterious cloaked figure and heads to Red Grave City where a massive demon tree has taken root, spreading a devastating invasion. Equipped with mechanical Devil Breaker arms crafted by partner Nico and joined by legendary demon hunter Dante and the enigmatic poet V, Nero discovers the invasion is led by Urizen—a supremely powerful demon king seeking to consume the Qliphoth tree's fruit to gain ultimate power. As the three demon hunters battle through hordes of demons with their distinct combat styles, they uncover shocking truths about Urizen's identity, V's true nature, and a family conflict that will determine humanity's survival.

Tear through global cities including Los Angeles, Detroit, and Rome as an aggressive street racer seeking revenge against rivals who've wronged you on the road. Master traffic checking—ramming same-way vehicles into opponents for devastating Traffic Takedowns—while competing in events ranging from circuit races and Road Rage battles to Crash mode junctions where causing maximum destruction earns Crash Dollars. Build your Revenge meter by dominating rivals, then unleash payback when they least expect it through Vertical Takedowns from above or explosive Crashbreakers that detonate your wrecked car to take enemies down with you in a blaze of twisted metal.

Two years after defeating Clockwerk, master thief Sly Cooper and his gang discover that Interpol has excavated the mechanical owl's parts—and they've been stolen by the international Klaww Gang. To prevent Clockwerk from being reassembled and ensure the villain stays dead, Sly teams with tech expert Bentley and muscle Murray to execute heists across the globe. From nightclubs in Paris to palaces in India, gothic castles in Prague, and lumber camps in Canada, the trio must steal back each Clockwerk part while staying ahead of Inspector Carmelita Fox and uncovering a conspiracy involving a traitorous Interpol agent, hypnotic prisons, and a plot to use the parts' power for world domination.

One year after the devastating Los Angeles tournament, the mysterious Calypso expands his deadly vehicular combat contest to a global scale, selecting fourteen of the world's most dangerous drivers to compete across international battlegrounds. From the ruins of Los Angeles to the streets of Paris, the rooftops of Hong Kong, frozen Antarctica, and beyond, contestants must destroy all opponents using an arsenal of missiles, machine guns, and special weapons unique to their modified vehicles. The last driver standing earns an audience with Calypso, who promises to grant any wish regardless of size, price, or even reality—though his twisted interpretations often transform winners' dreams into nightmares.

title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

hints.plot: After the events in Nibel, guardian spirit Ori lives peacefully with adoptive mother Naru, friend Gumo, and a young owlet named Ku whom they raise together as family. When a violent storm separates Ori from Ku during her first flight and crash-lands them in the exotic land of Niwen, Ori must navigate this vast new world to rescue Ku and discover what threatens its dying Spirit Willow. Armed with new combat abilities including the Spirit Edge sword and Spirit Arc bow, Ori encounters memorable allies offering quests and aid while battling towering bosses and exploring corrupted biomes. As Ori uncovers the ancient connection between Niwen and Nibel, painful truths emerge about sacrifice, destiny, and what it truly means to heal a broken land.

title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots

hints.plot: Five years after the Big Shell incident, a prematurely aged Solid Snake—now known as Old Snake—emerges from retirement for one final mission in a world where war has become big business controlled by private military companies. Equipped with his OctoCamo suit that mimics his surroundings, Snake must stop Liquid Ocelot from seizing control of the Sons of the Patriots AI system that commands the world's PMCs. Traveling from Middle Eastern warzones to South American battlefields and finally to Shadow Moses Island where his legend began, Old Snake confronts his past while racing to prevent Liquid Ocelot's insurrection and resolve the mysteries woven throughout decades of conflict involving Big Boss, The Patriots, and the true meaning of being a soldier.

title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past

hints.plot: When the evil wizard Agahnim seizes control of Hyrule Castle and begins kidnapping the descendants of the Seven Sages to break the seal imprisoning Ganon in the Dark World, young Link awakens to Princess Zelda's telepathic plea for help. After Agahnim defeats Link and banishes him to the corrupted parallel dimension, Link must travel between the Light World and Dark World using the Moon Pearl, rescue the seven maidens, obtain the Master Sword, and ultimately defeat both Agahnim and the demon king Ganon to claim the Triforce and restore peace to Hyrule.

Freelance photojournalist Frank West charters a helicopter to the small town of Willamette, Colorado, investigating rumors of a riot. Landing on the rooftop of the Willamette Parkview Mall, he discovers the town overrun by zombies and barricades himself inside the shopping complex. With 72 in-game hours until his helicopter pilot returns, Frank must survive endless waves of undead using any makeshift weapons he can find throughout the mall's stores, rescue trapped survivors and escort them to the safe room, battle deranged psychopaths who have succumbed to the chaos, and uncover the truth behind the zombie outbreak while capturing evidence with his camera for the scoop of a lifetime.

After a terrorist attack on Andersen Air Force Base in Guam, President Patricia Caldwell disbands Third Echelon and creates Fourth Echelon—a clandestine unit answering solely to her with Sam Fisher as its commander. A terrorist group called The Engineers initiates the Blacklist, a deadly countdown of escalating attacks on U.S. interests worldwide, demanding America withdraw all military forces from foreign soil. Operating from their mobile command center, the Paladin aircraft, Fisher and his team—including pilot Charlie Cole, hacker Briggs, technical expert Grim, and CIA liaison Kobin—must hunt down the Engineers across the globe. With the freedom to defend American laws by breaking them, Fisher employs three combat styles while racing against time to prevent the final devastating attack before the Blacklist countdown reaches zero.

In the year 1286, charlatan knight Sir Daniel Fortesque was struck down by the first arrow fired in battle against evil sorcerer Zarok, but King Peregrin declared him a hero who sacrificed himself to defeat the wizard. One hundred years later in 1386, Zarok returns to Gallowmere, casting a spell to raise an army of undead and unwittingly resurrecting the skeletal Dan in the process. Given an unexpected second chance at heroism, the bumbling knight must battle through graveyards, ghost ships, and enchanted forests to stop Zarok's conquest, redeem his fraudulent legacy, and finally earn his place in the Hall of Heroes alongside true warriors.

Set in the 26th century in the distant Koprulu Sector of the Milky Way, humanity's exiled Terran colonists encounter two powerful alien species: the psychic Protoss warriors seeking to eradicate corruption, and the insectoid Zerg driven to assimilate all life. As mysterious Zerg infestations ravage Terran colonies, all three races become entangled in a brutal struggle for survival and dominance. Through three interconnected campaigns, you command each faction—guiding colonists against invasion, directing Zerg cerebrates to consume planets, and leading Protoss executors to contain the threat—uncovering ancient conspiracies, betrayals, and the terrible truth about the Zerg's origins and their hunger to evolve through conquest.

In 2027, energy drink corporation FizzCo launches Overcharge Delirium XT at a massive release party in Sunset City, but the contaminated beverage transforms consumers into violent mutants called the OD. As a former FizzCo employee trapped in the quarantined city, you must survive the mutant apocalypse alongside ragtag bands of survivors while battling FizzCo's robotic security forces and ruthless scavenger gangs. Using hyper-agility to grind rails, bounce off cars, and wall-run across the vibrant urban playground, you fight to expose FizzCo's corporate conspiracy and escape the city before it's obliterated to cover up the disaster.

title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy

hints.plot: After defying warnings and exploring the forbidden Misty Island, Daxter falls into a Dark Eco silo and is transformed from human into an ottsel—a hybrid of an otter and weasel. In their quest to find Gol Acheron, the Dark Eco sage who might reverse Daxter's transformation, Jak and Daxter discover the corrupted sage plans to use the elusive Light Eco to flood the world with Dark Eco. The duo must collect Power Cells and traverse diverse environments from beaches to snowy mountains to stop Gol's world-threatening plot, ultimately choosing between saving the world and returning Daxter to human form.

In the dying world of Sylvarant, the Chosen One Colette Brunel embarks on a Journey of World Regeneration to restore mana by unsealing four temples and reaching the Tower of Salvation. Accompanied by childhood friend Lloyd Irving and others, they discover their world coexists with Tethe'alla in a delicate balance—saving one world slowly drains the other. As they uncover the truth about the Desians, the sinister Cruxis organization, and the ancient conflict between angels and humans, the party must decide whether to follow the prophecy or forge a new path that saves both worlds without sacrifice.

After a night of heavy drinking, hungover red squirrel Conker awakens lost in an unfamiliar land and must find his way home to girlfriend Berri. Unknown to Conker, the idiotic Panther King's milk table has a broken leg, and his mad scientist Professor Von Kriplespac determines a red squirrel is the perfect replacement. As Conker navigates bizarre locations filled with eccentric characters—battling opera-singing feces, Nazi teddy bears called Tediz, and Alien parodies—he's hunted by the Panther King's minions who want to turn him into furniture while Kriplespac plots his own revenge against his tyrannical boss.

title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun

hints.plot: In 1615 during Japan's Edo period, the newly unified Shogun faces a mysterious warlord known only as Kage-sama who threatens the fragile peace. The Shogun tasks samurai Oshiro Mugen with uncovering Kage-sama's identity, leading Mugen to recruit four specialists—ninja Hayato, thief Yuki, kunoichi Aiko, and sharpshooter Takuma—to infiltrate enemy strongholds and eliminate threats.
