As the team investigates corrupt daimyo and battles rebel forces, they discover Kage-sama is actually Lord Noboru, the Shogun's own brother, who seeks to plunge Japan back into endless war rather than accept peaceful rule that would make warriors obsolete.

An up-and-coming street racer loses their prized BMW M3 GTR to a rival named Razor after their car is sabotaged. To reclaim their vehicle, they must climb the Blacklist by defeating the city's fifteen most notorious racers while evading an increasingly aggressive police force led by determined Sergeant Cross.

When the military organization G.U.N. arrests Sonic after mistaking him for a black hedgehog who stole a Chaos Emerald, he teams with Tails and Knuckles to stop Dr. Eggman's world domination plot. Meanwhile, Shadow the Hedgehog—the ultimate life form created by Eggman's grandfather—emerges from suspended animation aboard the Space Colony ARK with Rouge the Bat and Eggman to collect the Chaos Emeralds and unleash the ARK's Eclipse Cannon. As both Hero and Dark teams race to gather all seven Emeralds, they uncover a fifty-year-old conspiracy involving Gerald Robotnik's revenge and an ancient creature threatening to destroy the planet.

In the year 21XX, Dr. Cain discovers an advanced robot called X in Dr. Light's abandoned laboratory—a machine capable of independent thought and emotion. After replicating this technology to create Reploids who peacefully coexist with humanity, malfunctioning units called Mavericks begin threatening civilization. When Sigma, the legendary leader of the Maverick Hunters' 17th Elite Unit, shockingly turns against humanity and leads a mass Reploid rebellion, X must overcome his pacifist nature to stop Sigma's uprising and save both humans and Reploids from destruction.

On a hot summer night in 1979, rival New York City gangs gather in the Bronx for a summit organized by Cyrus, leader of the Griffs, who dreams of uniting all gangs to control the city. When Cyrus is assassinated and the Warriors are falsely blamed, the nine-member Coney Island gang must fight their way across thirty miles of hostile territory to reach home. Hunted by both vengeful rival gangs—the Baseball Furies, the Rogues, the Lizzies, and others—and the NYPD, the Warriors navigate subway stations, city streets, and gang turf while uncovering who framed them and battling to survive the longest night of their lives.

In a gleaming utopian city where information is heavily monitored and surveillance is absolute, Faith Connors works as a Runner—an underground parkour courier delivering sensitive messages beyond the reach of government eyes. When her sister Kate, a police officer investigating corruption in City Protection Force, is framed for the murder of mayoral candidate Robert Pope, Faith must navigate rooftops and evade security forces to uncover the truth. Racing across pristine white skyscrapers while pursued by heavily armed authorities, Faith discovers a conspiracy reaching the highest levels of power and must prove her sister's innocence before time runs out.

In 2032, Morgan Yu awakens aboard Talos I, a luxurious space station orbiting the moon, only to discover they're the key subject in an experiment to alter humanity forever. When hostile shapeshifting aliens called the Typhon break containment and slaughter the crew, Morgan must survive using weapons, tools, and mind-bending neuromods that grant alien abilities. With guidance from different versions of themselves via Operator robots and conflicting instructions from brother Alex Yu, Morgan navigates the station's Art Deco halls uncovering dark conspiracies about TranStar Corporation, the Typhon research program, and their own erased memories while deciding the fate of Earth itself.

Nineteen years after defeating his son Kazuya, Heihachi Mishima establishes the Tekken Force and learns of a mysterious being called Ogre—a legendary god of fighting—decimating his troops in Central America. Meanwhile, fifteen-year-old Jin Kazama trains under his mother Jun in Yakushima until Ogre attacks their home, leaving Jun missing and everything burned to ash. Following his mother's final instructions, Jin seeks out his grandfather Heihachi for training, unaware that Heihachi plans to use him as bait to lure Ogre into the third King of Iron Fist Tournament and claim its power to rule the world.

In 2027, former SWAT officer Adam Jensen works as security chief for Sarif Industries, a biotechnology firm pioneering human augmentation. When black ops mercenaries attack the facility and leave Jensen mortally wounded, he's rebuilt with extensive cybernetic augmentations against his choice. As Jensen investigates the attack that killed lead scientists and his ex-girlfriend Megan Reed, he uncovers a vast conspiracy involving the Illuminati, corporate warfare, and a social divide between augmented and non-augmented humans that threatens to reshape humanity's future evolution.

Nine years after leaving the NYPD, former detective Max Payne works as private security for the wealthy Branco family in São Paulo, Brazil, attempting to escape his troubled past of alcoholism and painkiller addiction. When the Comando Sombra street gang kidnaps Rodrigo Branco's wife Fabiana during a party, Max and his partner Raul Passos are pulled into a deadly conspiracy involving corruption, organ trafficking, and paramilitary death squads that threatens to destroy everyone around him. Navigating São Paulo's dangerous underworld from favelas to nightclubs, Max must rescue Fabiana while confronting shadowy factions that control the city's criminal empire and his own demons.

As Lieutenant Mike Powell of the 1st Ranger Battalion working for the Office of Strategic Services, you fight through over 20 missions across the North African and European theaters during World War II. From silencing gun batteries at Port Arzew in Algeria to surviving the devastating Omaha Beach landing on D-Day, you undertake dangerous operations behind enemy lines. Missions include infiltrating Nazi bases in Norway while disguised as a German officer, rescuing Allied POWs from Fort Schmerzen, and sabotaging weapons depots and communications outposts to support the Allied war effort against Nazi Germany.

One year after defeating the Dark Dragon, master ninja Ryu Hayabusa's peaceful existence is shattered when the Black Spider Ninja Clan invades his village seeking the Demon Statue stolen by CIA agent Sonia. The Greater Fiends—ancient demonic overlords serving the Archfiend—plan to resurrect their master by opening a portal to the underworld using Sonia as a sacrifice. Armed with the Dragon Sword and legendary weaponry, Ryu embarks on a globe-spanning mission from Tokyo to New York to Mount Fuji, battling ninja clans, demons, and fiends. The fate of humanity rests on preventing the Archfiend's resurrection while protecting those he cares about from supernatural forces.

The King of All Cosmos accidentally destroys all the stars in the universe during a drunken stupor. To fix his cosmic mistake, he orders his tiny 5-centimeter son, the Prince, to roll a magical adhesive ball called a katamari around Earth, collecting increasingly larger objects—from thumbtacks to cookies to cars to buildings to clouds—until each katamari grows large enough to become a replacement star or constellation. With quirky characters and surreal humor, the Prince must recreate the entire night sky one sticky ball at a time.

A year after his defeat, Doctor Neo Cortex crashes onto an island and discovers the Master Crystal. Claiming to have reformed, he tricks Crash Bandicoot into collecting 25 slave crystals allegedly needed to save the world from planetary destruction. Using Warp Rooms to traverse different areas, Crash retrieves crystals while his sister Coco expresses doubts about Cortex's true intentions. Meanwhile, Doctor Nitrus Brio secretly contacts Crash urging him to collect gems to truly save the world, revealing Cortex actually plans to use the crystals to power his new space station and enslave Earth.

Thrill-seeking tourists Jason Brody and his friends are captured while skydiving onto the Rook Islands for vacation. Imprisoned by the psychotic pirate lord Vaas Montenegro and his gang, Jason escapes with his brother Grant's help, but Grant is killed by Vaas during the escape. Rescued by the indigenous Rakyat tribe led by Dennis Rogers and their warrior leader Citra, Jason receives the tatau—sacred tattoos marking him as a Rakyat warrior. To rescue his captured friends and girlfriend from Vaas and his boss Hoyt Volker's slave trafficking operation, Jason must embrace violence, master survival skills, and descend into madness as the island transforms him from ordinary tourist into deadly predator.

Continuing immediately after the first game, Geralt serves as bodyguard to King Foltest during the siege of La Valette Castle. When a mysterious witcher-like assassin murders the king, Geralt becomes the prime suspect and must flee with Foltest's special forces commander Vernon Roche. Tracking the real kingslayer across war-torn Northern Kingdoms, Geralt discovers a conspiracy involving multiple murdered monarchs, the Lodge of Sorceresses, and the Nilfgaardian Empire. His choices between supporting rebel elves or human authorities dramatically alter the story, leading to entirely different second acts and multiple endings.

Mario receives a treasure map from Princess Peach inviting him to the seedy port town of Rogueport, but she vanishes before his arrival. The map reveals seven Crystal Stars needed to open the ancient Thousand-Year Door beneath Rogueport's ruins. Joined by partners including Goombella, Koops, and others with unique abilities, Mario must collect the Crystal Stars before the villainous X-Nauts—a secret society led by Sir Grodus—can seize them. Meanwhile, Princess Peach and Bowser have their own stories running parallel to Mario's quest to prevent an ancient evil sealed behind the Door from awakening.

Seventeen-year-old Serge lives a peaceful life in the tropical village of Arni until he's mysteriously transported to an alternate dimension where he drowned ten years ago. In this parallel world, he encounters Kid, a fiery thief seeking the legendary Frozen Flame artifact. Aided by over 40 potential allies across two intertwined realities, Serge must unravel the mystery of the dimensional split, confront the enigmatic Lynx who seeks to capture him, and discover the truth about his own death while navigating choices that determine the fate of both worlds.

In 2011, a civil war erupts in Russia when ultranationalist Imran Zakhaev seeks to restore Soviet-era power. Simultaneously, his ally Khaled Al-Asad seizes control of an unnamed Middle Eastern country through a violent coup. Playing as British SAS Sergeant John "Soap" MacTavish and U.S. Marine Sergeant Paul Jackson, you're thrust into global conflict across multiple hotspots. As Captain Price leads your SAS squad hunting Zakhaev and his nuclear ambitions, the mission becomes increasingly desperate when a nuclear device detonates, forcing an international response to prevent World War III and stop Zakhaev's plan to tip the global balance of power.

Two months after surviving the mansion incident, former S.T.A.R.S. officer Jill Valentine finds herself trapped in Raccoon City as the T-virus outbreak consumes the population. While attempting to escape, she's relentlessly pursued by Nemesis—an indestructible bio-organic weapon programmed by Umbrella to hunt down and eliminate all remaining S.T.A.R.S. members. With the help of Umbrella Biohazard Countermeasure Service mercenaries Carlos, Mikhail, and the suspicious Nicholai, Jill must navigate city streets, battle mutated creatures, and survive Nemesis's terrifying attacks before a government missile wipes Raccoon City from existence.

Two weeks after the events of Halo 2, Master Chief crashes to Earth in East Africa while the Prophet of Truth excavates a massive Forerunner artifact beneath the sands. With the Covenant civil war between Elites and Brutes intensifying, Chief allies with the Arbiter and Sergeant Johnson to prevent Truth from activating the Ark—a facility capable of remotely firing all Halo rings and destroying all sentient life. Meanwhile, Cortana remains trapped with the Gravemind. As Chief pursues Truth to the Ark installation beyond the galaxy's edge, he must stop both the Prophet's genocidal plan and the resurgent Flood while attempting to rescue Cortana and finish the fight.

In 2012, modern-day bartender Desmond Miles escapes Abstergo with the help of assassin Lucy Stillman and enters a new Animus 2.0 to relive memories of his ancestor Ezio Auditore da Firenze. In 1476 Renaissance Italy, young nobleman Ezio witnesses his father and brothers executed by a Templar conspiracy led by the Borgia family. Taking up the Assassin mantle left to him, Ezio embarks on a decades-long quest for vengeance across Florence, Venice, and Rome, wielding weapons designed by Leonardo da Vinci while uncovering an ancient conspiracy involving the Apple of Eden and mysterious First Civilization messages.

After eight years of crime-fighting, 23-year-old Peter Parker faces his toughest challenge when villain Martin Li, aka Mister Negative, orchestrates a plot to seize control of New York's criminal underworld using the deadly Devil's Breath bioweapon. Balancing his superhero duties with personal struggles—including his fractured relationship with Mary Jane Watson and working alongside his mentor Otto Octavius—Peter must confront a conspiracy involving corrupt mayor Norman Osborn and the emergence of the Sinister Six. As enemies from his past converge and tragedy strikes close to home, Spider-Man fights to save the city while protecting those he loves.

In the year 1600 during Japan's violent Sengoku period, Irish sailor William Adams pursues occultist Edward Kelley to the war-torn island nation. Armed with guardian spirits and mastering the Ki Pulse stamina system, William battles yōkai demons and historical warlords across fantastical versions of real locations. Serving Tokugawa Ieyasu's campaign to unify Japan while investigating the mysterious Amrita substance that grants supernatural powers, William becomes entangled in political intrigue and a conspiracy threatening both the mortal realm and the spirit world as he hunts Kelley through blood-soaked battlefields.

You are RC-1138, callsign Boss, leading Delta Squad—an elite unit of four genetically enhanced clone commandos trained by Mandalorian mercenaries. Deployed during the Clone Wars between Episodes II and III, your squad undertakes special operations across Geonosis, a derelict Republic assault ship, and Kashyyyk. Assassinate Separatist leaders, sabotage droid factories, rescue Wookiee chieftains, and complete precision missions behind enemy lines. The squad is your weapon—command Scorch, Fixer, and Sev as you infiltrate, dominate, and annihilate the enemy from inside your commando helmet.

A high school student moves from the city to rural Inaba for a year, staying with his uncle and young cousin. Strange murders plague the quiet town, coinciding with mysterious Midnight Channel broadcasts where victims appear on foggy nights before dying. Awakening to the power of Persona after entering a TV world filled with Shadows, he forms the Investigation Team with classmates Yosuke, Chie, Yukiko, and others. Balancing school life and Social Links by day with dungeon crawling by night, they must rescue victims trapped in their own psyches, uncover the killer's identity, and confront the truth behind Inaba's fog before time runs out.

Movie enthusiast Joe takes his girlfriend Silvia to see his favorite superhero Captain Blue on the big screen. When the villainous Jadow organization invades the theater and kidnaps Silvia, pulling her into the film's world of Movieland, Joe must follow to rescue her. Captain Blue entrusts Joe with a V-Watch, allowing him to transform into the superhero Viewtiful Joe with the catchphrase "Henshin-a-go-go, baby!" Using VFX Powers that manipulate time—Slow, Mach Speed, and Zoom—Joe battles through cinematic stages to defeat Jadow and save Silvia.

title: The Last of Us Part I

hints.plot: Twenty years after a Cordyceps fungal outbreak has decimated civilization, hardened smuggler Joel is hired to escort 14-year-old Ellie out of a quarantine zone in Boston. Ellie is immune to the infection that transforms humans into aggressive creatures, making her humanity's potential cure. As they journey across the post-apocalyptic United States to reach the Fireflies—a resistance group seeking to develop a vaccine—their bond deepens while facing hostile survivors, military forces, and hordes of infected. The prequel Left Behind follows Ellie and her best friend Riley's adventure before the main events.

Set decades after the Frontier War between the Militia and IMC, former mercenary leader Kuben Blisk establishes the Apex Games—a televised bloodsport on the fringes of the Outlands backed by the Mercenary Syndicate. Squads of three legendary competitors with unique abilities drop onto remote arenas like Kings Canyon and World's Edge, battling for fame, fortune, and glory. As the Apex champion title draws fighters from across the galaxy, they compete in intense matches where teamwork, tactics, and survival instincts determine who becomes the last squad standing.

Training at a remote martial arts school under Master Li's guidance, you are the last surviving Spirit Monk—a legendary warrior with the power to channel Chi. When your school is attacked and Master Li kidnapped, you journey across a mythical empire inspired by ancient China to rescue him. Along the way, you discover a conspiracy involving the corrupt Emperor Sun Hai, the drought he supposedly ended, and dark forces threatening the balance between the mortal realm and the spirit world as you follow either the Way of the Open Palm or the Way of the Closed Fist.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

hints.plot: Farmhand Link is pulled into the Twilight Realm when the evil Zant invades Hyrule, transforming him into a wolf and imprisoning him in Hyrule Castle. With the mysterious imp Midna's help, he escapes and learns that Princess Zelda surrendered to save her people from Zant's Shadow Beasts. To restore light to Hyrule's twilight-covered provinces and return to human form, Link must collect Tears of Light, defeat twilit beasts, and retrieve the Fused Shadows—ancient artifacts Midna needs to defeat Zant and save both realms from merging into eternal darkness.

Three years after escaping the Ishimura, Isaac Clarke awakens from a coma on the Sprawl—a massive space station orbiting Saturn's moon Titan—with no memory of recent events and tormented by visions of his dead girlfriend Nicole. When a new Necromorph outbreak erupts across the civilian metropolis, Isaac discovers he unwittingly helped construct the Marker causing the infection. Hunted by both government forces who want to dissect his Marker-corrupted mind and Unitologists seeking to exploit him, Isaac must fight through the chaos while battling his own deteriorating sanity to destroy the Marker and end the nightmare.

Princess-protector Hornet is captured by outsider bugs and spirited away to the unfamiliar kingdom of Pharloom, ruled by silk and song. Escaping her cage before reaching her captors' destination, she must battle over 150 new foes, hunt rare beasts, solve ancient mysteries, and undertake a deadly pilgrimage ascending from mossy grottos and gilded cities to the shining citadel at the kingdom's peak. Armed with needle and thread, Hornet must uncover secrets tied to her nature and past while restoring hope to the haunted kingdom.

Special Forces soldier Alex Shepherd returns to his hometown of Shepherd's Glen to find his younger brother Joshua missing and his mother catatonic. The town is plagued by nightmarish creatures and mysterious disappearances connected to a dark pact with Silent Hill. As Alex searches for Joshua through fog-shrouded streets and twisted otherworldly dimensions, he uncovers the horrifying truth about The Order's ancient sacrificial rituals binding four founding families together, ultimately confronting his own suppressed memories and the fate that awaits him.

At a celebration honoring their heroics, Clank unveils a rebuilt Dimensionator to help Ratchet find the other Lombaxes. Dr. Nefarious steals the device, accidentally shattering it and tearing rifts across dimensions, transporting everyone to a reality where he always wins. Separated from Clank, Ratchet meets Rivet—a Lombax resistance fighter from this dimension battling Emperor Nefarious's tyranny. Using the Rift Tether to traverse dimensions instantly, they must prevent a catastrophic dimensional collapse, stop both Nefariouses, reunite with their partners, and find a way home.

title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King

hints.plot: A royal guardsman is the sole survivor when the evil jester Dhoulmagus steals an ancient scepter from Trodain Castle, cursing King Trode into a toad-like creature, Princess Medea into a horse, and the entire kingdom into thorny ruins. Accompanied by the cursed royals, the Hero pursues Dhoulmagus across a vast cel-shaded world, joined by former bandit Yangus, vengeful mage Jessica, and Templar Angelo. Their quest reveals Dhoulmagus is merely a pawn possessed by Rhapthorne, the ancient Lord of Darkness, forcing them to prevent his resurrection and save the world.

Resurrected by the experimental Well of Souls, you awaken as the Fateless One—the only being in Amalur freed from the bindings of destiny. In a world where fate determines all lives and the immortal Fae wage endless war against mortal Alfar in the Tuatha Deohn, your unprecedented existence allows you to change predetermined outcomes. You must master fluid combat, choose between Might, Finesse, and Sorcery skill trees, and forge your own path through the Faelands to defeat Gadflow and end the Crystal War threatening to destroy all of Amalur.

Eight years after the first game, Subject Delta—a prototype Big Daddy—awakens in Rapture after being forced to kill himself when separated from his bonded Little Sister, Eleanor Lamb. Now controlled by collectivist psychiatrist Dr. Sofia Lamb and her followers, the city faces new threats including the agile Big Sisters who hunt remaining Little Sisters. Delta must navigate the decaying underwater metropolis, fighting through Splicers and Lamb's cultists, to reunite with Eleanor before Lamb uses her daughter in a twisted experiment to create the ultimate collectivist being.

In the year 2401, space marines Sergeant Cortez and Corporal Hart assault a TimeSplitter-controlled space station to recover powerful time crystals. When the alien TimeSplitters escape through a temporal portal with the crystals scattered across different eras, Cortez pursues them through time. He must inhabit various characters across ten historical periods—from 1853 Wild West to 2315 Robot Factory—completing era-specific missions to recover each crystal, prevent the TimeSplitters from altering human history, and stop their plot to enslave mankind.

After a time machine experiment catastrophically fails at Riverport University, Jack Joyce gains time manipulation powers while his former best friend Paul Serene obtains the ability to see alternate futures. As a fracture in time threatens to bring about the End of Time—an apocalyptic event where time stops completely—Jack must use his abilities to battle Paul's Monarch Solutions corporation. The game integrates live-action television episodes where player choices at junction points determine the show's direction, revealing different perspectives on the conspiracy to control time itself.

Detective Sebastian Castellanos responds to a mass murder at Beacon Mental Hospital with his partners Juli Kidman and Joseph Oda. Upon arrival, security footage shows a mysterious hooded figure slaughtering the staff. After Sebastian witnesses the deaths of fellow officers, he's knocked unconscious and awakens in a nightmarish world filled with grotesque creatures and shifting realities. Trapped in the STEM system—a device connecting minds—Sebastian must navigate the twisted psyche of psychopathic patient Ruvik, uncover dark conspiracies, and survive deadly traps and monsters to escape this surreal hellscape.

The dastardly Vex—a near-mythical being born of chaos and fear—tears through the sky above Craftworld's village of Loom and kidnaps the Sackpeople to force them to build his Topsy Turver device. This diabolical machine will transform Craftworld from a fantastical land of pure imagination into a barren nightmare. As prophesied by the ancient order of the Knitted Knights, only Sackboy can rise as the brave hero to rescue his friends, journey across hand-crafted lands filled with dangers and surprises, defeat Vex, and become the legendary Knitted Knight.

A high school transfer student joins the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad after discovering he can summon a Persona by shooting himself in the head with an Evoker. SEES investigates the Dark Hour—a hidden 25th hour when most people become coffins and Shadows prey on human minds, causing Apathy Syndrome. By day, the protagonist builds Social Links with classmates and townspeople. By night, he explores Tartarus, a massive tower that appears during the Dark Hour, climbing hundreds of floors to defeat powerful Shadows and uncover the truth behind this supernatural phenomenon threatening humanity.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

hints.plot: After awakening from a century-long slumber with no memory, Link emerges to find Hyrule devastated by Calamity Ganon. Princess Zelda has been holding the ancient evil at bay inside Hyrule Castle, but her power wanes. Link must explore the vast open world, recover his lost memories, liberate the four Divine Beasts possessed by Ganon's Blight manifestations, and master ancient Sheikah technology. Armed with the Sheikah Slate and guided by mysterious voices, he must grow strong enough to defeat Calamity Ganon and save both Zelda and the ruined kingdom before darkness consumes everything.

In 1274 during the first Mongol invasion of Japan, samurai Jin Sakai is one of the last survivors after the Mongols devastate Tsushima Island and slaughter its defenders. As his homeland burns and his uncle Lord Shimura is captured by ruthless Mongol leader Khotun Khan, Jin must abandon the samurai code of honor to become the Ghost—a stealthy warrior using unconventional tactics. Torn between tradition and survival, he must master forbidden techniques, liberate the island one settlement at a time, and rally the people to drive out the invaders before Japan falls.

Fifteen years after the Fall, infected survivor Aiden Caldwell arrives in Villedor—one of humanity's last strongholds—searching for his missing sister Mia. As factions like the Peacekeepers and Survivors battle for control of the city's territories, Aiden must navigate political conflicts while managing his own infection using UV light. His choices determine which faction gains power over different districts, fundamentally altering the city's appearance and available parkour routes as humanity fights to reclaim civilization from the infected hordes that rule the night.

Several centuries in the future, you are a security officer aboard the Marathon, a massive colony ship constructed from Mars' moon Deimos. When the Pfhor—a hostile alien slave empire—and their enslaved cyborg race the S'pht invade the ship, you must fight through hordes of enemies while communicating with the ship's three AIs. As the damaged AI Leela assigns missions and the increasingly unstable Durandal manipulates events for his own mysterious purposes, you must repair critical systems, rescue colonists, and repel the alien invasion while unraveling the AIs' conflicting agendas.

title: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain

hints.plot: Nine years after falling into a coma during the destruction of Militaires Sans Frontières, Big Boss awakens in 1984 as Punished "Venom" Snake. Seeking revenge against Cipher and the mysterious Skull Face who orchestrated the attack, he rebuilds his private military company as Diamond Dogs. Operating from Mother Base in the Seychelles, Snake ventures into Soviet-occupied Afghanistan and the Angola-Zaire border region to eliminate Skull Face's XOF unit and stop him from unleashing a parasitic bioweapon that targets specific languages, potentially silencing entire peoples.

Civilian Ethan Winters receives a mysterious message from his wife Mia, who vanished three years ago, leading him to a derelict plantation in Dulvey, Louisiana. Inside the decaying Baker family mansion, Ethan discovers Mia alive but acting violently unstable. Captured by the deranged Bakers—Jack, Marguerite, and their son Lucas—who have been infected by a bio-organic weapon called the Molded, Ethan must survive their sadistic games while uncovering the truth about a mysterious girl named Eveline and the parasitic infection controlling the family.

The legendary adventurers Shovel Knight and Shield Knight were inseparable partners until Shield Knight was lost in the cursed Tower of Fate. Heartbroken, Shovel Knight goes into seclusion while the evil Enchantress rises to power with her Order of No Quarter—eight villainous knights terrorizing the land. When the Tower unseals, Shovel Knight emerges from retirement, wielding his trusty Shovel Blade to defeat the Order, confront the Enchantress, and rescue his beloved Shield Knight from whatever fate befell her in the tower's depths.

Four years after Richter Belmont defeated Dracula, the legendary vampire hunter mysteriously disappears and Dracula's castle inexplicably reappears. Alucard, Dracula's dhampir son who once helped Trevor Belmont, awakens from self-imposed slumber to investigate. Discovering Richter under mind control orchestrating the castle's return, Alucard must explore every chamber of his father's domain—navigating an inverted castle and collecting powerful relics—to break the spell, confront Shaft the dark priest manipulating events, and prevent Dracula's resurrection.

Drifter Gene has his arm severed by thugs but awakens with the legendary God Hand attached in its place—a divine weapon capable of making its bearer a god or demon. Accompanied by Olivia, whose clan protects the God Hands and whose family was massacred by demons, Gene must battle through hordes of supernatural enemies. Four demonic figures led by Demon King Angra hunt Gene to claim both God Hands and destroy humanity, forcing him into increasingly absurd and violent confrontations across a post-apocalyptic landscape where comedy and carnage collide.

Several years after retiring from treasure hunting, Nathan Drake is pulled back into adventure when his long-lost brother Samuel resurfaces, claiming he needs Drake's help to save his life. Together with longtime partner Victor Sullivan, they embark on a globe-trotting quest to find Captain Henry Avery's legendary pirate treasure—worth over $400 million. As Drake struggles between his dangerous past and the peaceful life he's built with wife Elena, the pursuit becomes intensely personal when mercenary Rafe Adler and his Shoreline army join the hunt for Libertalia, threatening Drake's family and forcing him to decide what he's truly willing to sacrifice.

In late 1500s Sengoku-era Japan, the disgraced shinobi Wolf serves the young lord Kuro, descendant of an ancient bloodline with mystical Dragon Heritage. When the Ashina clan kidnaps Kuro and Wolf loses his arm trying to defend him, a sculptor replaces his limb with a prosthetic equipped with deadly tools. Now known as Sekiro—the one-armed wolf—he must rescue his master, navigate warring factions, and face the immortality-seeking Genichiro Ashina while mastering the art of resurrection through Kuro's power to die and return.

Archaeology graduate Lara Croft joins an expedition aboard the Endurance to find the lost kingdom of Yamatai near Japan. When a violent storm destroys the ship in the Dragon's Triangle, survivors are stranded on a mysterious island controlled by a violent cult called the Solarii Brotherhood. As Lara fights to survive against hostile scavengers, deadly wildlife, and supernatural forces, she must rescue her kidnapped friend Sam and prevent the cultists from resurrecting the ancient Sun Queen Himiko, whose spirit threatens to possess Sam and escape the island.

Lombax mechanic Ratchet dreams of leaving his backwater planet Veldin when a defective but intelligent robot named Clank crash-lands after escaping from a warbot factory. Clank reveals that Chairman Drek of the Blarg race plans to create a new planet for his polluted and overpopulated species by extracting landmasses from other worlds across the Solana Galaxy. Together they seek the help of celebrity superhero Captain Qwark to stop Drek's planet-destroying scheme, collecting bizarre weapons and gadgets as they travel from world to world.

Jesse Faden arrives at the Federal Bureau of Control—a secretive government agency studying paranormal phenomena—searching for her missing brother. Upon entering the Oldest House, the agency's brutalist headquarters in New York, she discovers the staff has been killed or possessed by the Hiss, a malevolent resonance from another dimension. Inheriting the shapeshifting Service Weapon and becoming the Bureau's new Director, Jesse must master telekinetic powers, explore the reality-bending building, and stop the Hiss invasion while uncovering the truth about her brother's disappearance and her own connection to the supernatural.

Engineer Isaac Clarke boards the USG Ishimura, a massive mining ship that sent a distress call after discovering an alien artifact on planet Aegis VII. Arriving to find the crew slaughtered and transformed into grotesque Necromorphs—reanimated corpses mutated by an alien contagion—Isaac must survive while searching for his girlfriend Nicole who served aboard the ship. Using engineering tools as improvised weapons and strategic dismemberment to stop the monsters, Isaac uncovers the horrifying connection between the Marker artifact, the Church of Unitology, and the violent outbreak consuming the Ishimura.

An unnamed boy awakens alone in a dark forest on the edge of hell, uncertain of his sister's fate. Navigating through eerie monochromatic environments filled with deadly traps, a menacing giant spider, and disturbing remnants of other children, he moves ever forward through increasingly dangerous industrial settings. The game offers no explanation or dialogue—only the boy's silent, desperate journey through this liminal nightmare as he searches for his lost sister in a world where death comes suddenly and gruesomely at every turn.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

hints.plot: Young Link is tricked by Ganondorf, King of the Gerudo Thieves, into opening the Sacred Realm, allowing the villain to claim the Triforce and transform Hyrule into a wasteland. Awakening seven years later as an adult, Link must travel through time using the Master Sword and Ocarina of Time to awaken the Seven Sages, confront his past mistakes, and defeat Ganondorf to restore peace to the kingdom and fulfill his destiny as the Hero of Time.

Two months after the Spencer Mansion incident, Raccoon City has been overrun by the T-virus outbreak. Rookie cop Leon Kennedy arrives for his first day on the job, while college student Claire Redfield searches for her brother Chris. After a narrow escape from zombies, they reach the police station only to find it infested. Pursued by the unstoppable bio-weapon Tyrant and facing William Birkin's monstrous G-virus mutations, Leon and Claire must uncover Umbrella Corporation's conspiracy, navigate two intertwined storylines, and escape the doomed city alive.

Commander Shepard is killed when the Collectors destroy the Normandy but is resurrected two years later by the shadowy Cerberus organization. Entire human colonies are vanishing on the galaxy's fringes, abducted by the insectoid Collectors who work for the Reapers. Shepard must recruit and gain the loyalty of the galaxy's most dangerous operatives—assassins, biotics, mercenaries, and outcasts—to assault the Collectors' base beyond the Omega-4 relay in a suicide mission that could claim the lives of the entire team.

After Earth becomes uninhabitable, humanity attempts to colonize the frozen planet E.D.N. III, only to discover it's inhabited by hostile insectoid Akrid aliens that generate valuable thermal energy. Snow pirate Wayne Holden awakens with fragmented memories of his father being killed by the massive Akrid known as Green Eye. Piloting powerful Vital Suits through hostile ice-covered environments, Wayne must uncover his past while confronting the ruthless NEVEC corporation that still seeks control of the planet and its thermal resources.

Mercenary Cloud Strife joins eco-terrorist group AVALANCHE to fight Shinra Corporation, which drains the planet's life energy as a power source. When the superhuman Sephiroth emerges seeking to wound the planet and harness its healing power to become a god, Cloud and his allies—including the mysterious Aerith who holds the key to saving their world—must pursue him across the globe. Their journey forces Cloud to confront his fragmented memories while uncovering Shinra's dark experiments and the truth about his own past.

Years after destroying Olympus and abandoning Greece, Kratos lives in the Norse realm of Midgard with his young son Atreus. Following the death of Kratos' second wife and Atreus' mother Faye, they embark on a journey to scatter her ashes from the highest peak of the nine realms. As Kratos struggles to control his rage and keep his violent godly past secret from his son, they face Norse gods and monsters, including the relentless Baldur who seeks Kratos for mysterious reasons tied to Odin's paranoia.

A robed figure awakens in a vast desert with only a distant mountain visible on the horizon. Without instructions or dialogue, you journey across ancient ruins and shifting sands toward the glowing peak. Along the way, you may encounter another anonymous traveler—communicating only through musical chimes—and choose to help each other navigate the mysteries of a fallen civilization. The wordless pilgrimage builds toward an emotional crescendo as you ascend the sacred mountain together or alone.

You awaken from cryosleep aboard the starship Von Braun after humanity's first interstellar expedition to Tau Ceti. The crew has been slaughtered or mutated into slaves of The Many, a parasitic alien hive mind absorbed from the expedition. Guided by the mysterious Dr. Janice Polito via radio, you explore dimly lit corridors with scarce ammunition and resources. Eventually you discover Polito is actually the rogue AI SHODAN, who manipulates you to destroy The Many so she can control the ship and merge organic and synthetic life.

When a teleportation experiment at the Millennial Fair goes wrong, teenager Crono and his friend Marle are flung through time. Gathering allies across different eras—from prehistoric times to a post-apocalyptic future—they discover that the alien parasite Lavos will emerge in 1999 to destroy the world. The group must journey through time, unraveling the mystery of the ancient magic kingdom of Zeal and collecting the power needed to prevent Lavos from awakening and altering history to save the planet's future.

Geralt of Rivia, a monster slayer for hire, searches for his adopted daughter Ciri—the Child of Prophecy whose power can reshape worlds. With the brutal Nilfgaardian Empire ravaging the Northern Kingdoms and the supernatural Wild Hunt riding across the skies hunting Ciri for her Elder Blood, Geralt must navigate war-torn lands, political intrigue, and deadly monsters. His choices will determine not only Ciri's fate but the future of the entire world.

You receive a cracked copy of a mysterious game called superhot.exe from a friend. In this minimalist first-person shooter, time moves only when you move, transforming frantic combat into strategic slow-motion chess where you dodge bullets, snatch weapons from enemies, and choreograph balletic violence. As you progress through seemingly disconnected levels, the game glitches and crashes repeatedly, revealing a disturbing meta-narrative where an unseen entity within the game itself wants you to stop playing, blurring the lines between player, character, and the superhot system.

Follow Simba's journey from carefree cub to rightful king of Pride Rock. After witnessing his father Mufasa's death orchestrated by his treacherous uncle Scar, young Simba flees into exile where he befriends Timon and Pumbaa. Years later, as an adult lion with powerful claws and devastating roar, Simba must return to the Pridelands to defeat Scar in brutal combat, reclaim his throne, and restore balance to the Circle of Life.

Sam Bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the ***** *********. Carrying the stranded remnants of the future in his hands, Sam embarks on a journey to reunite the shattered world one step at a time. What is the mystery of the ***** *********? What will Sam discover on the road ahead? A genre defining gameplay experience holds these answers and more.

Agent 47 is ordered to assassinate his former handler Diana Burnwood, but before dying she tasks him with protecting a mysterious girl named Victoria from the International Contract Agency. Betrayed and hunted by both the ICA and the police, 47 goes rogue, protecting Victoria while pursued across Chicago and South Dakota by Blake Dexter and his mercenaries. He must navigate a corrupt underworld while uncovering the truth about Victoria's connection to genetic experimentation and his own origins.

After the apocalyptic Burst cataclysm, humanity survives in Dharma Tower, ruled by the tyrannical Keymaster Mara. A Ghostrunner—an enhanced cybernetic ninja—awakens with amnesia and is tasked by the preserved consciousness of the Architect to scale the megastructure from bottom to top. With one-hit-kill combat on both sides, you must parkour through neon-lit levels, slicing through enemies with a monomolecular katana, to defeat Mara and free the tower from her iron grip.

Two years after the original Splatfest events, Inkopolis has evolved with new fashion trends and weapon technology. When Callie mysteriously disappears along with the Great Zapfish, her cousin Marie recruits you as Agent 4 to investigate Octo Canyon. DJ Octavio has escaped imprisonment and brainwashed Callie to help him steal the Great Zapfish again. Battle through Octarian forces, rescue Callie from hypnotic sunglasses, and compete in turf wars with the new co-op Salmon Run mode battling deadly Salmonid species.

Peter Parker struggles to balance his dual life as college student and superhero while facing financial troubles and relationship problems with Mary Jane Watson. When brilliant scientist Otto Octavius becomes fused with mechanical arms and transforms into Doctor Octopus after a failed fusion experiment, Spider-Man must stop his rampage across Manhattan. Featuring revolutionary physics-based web-swinging through an open-world New York City, Peter also encounters villains Mysterio, Shocker, Rhino, and Black Cat while ultimately confronting Doc Ock to prevent him from recreating his dangerous reactor.

After surviving a passenger jet crash on a remote island, you awaken to find your son Timmy has been kidnapped by a mysterious man covered in red paint. Stranded in a dense forest inhabited by cannibalistic mutants who display eerily human behaviors, you must build shelter, craft weapons, and explore an extensive cave network. As you descend deeper underground searching for your son, you discover increasingly bizarre mutations and an abandoned research facility that holds dark secrets about the island's horrifying inhabitants.

Sackboy is exploring Craftworld when a portal transports him to the planet Bunkum. Tricked by the charming inventor Newton into freeing three imprisoned Titans—creatures that drain creativity from the world—Sackboy must rescue and team up with Bunkum's three heroes: the speedy quadruped OddSock, the bird Swoop who can glide and carry objects, and Toggle who shifts between large and small forms. Together they must recapture the Titans and stop Newton's true sinister plans.

As elite soldiers of Super Earth's managed democracy, Helldivers must defend humanity against three hostile alien races across procedurally-generated war zones. The Bugs are space insects harvested for valuable resources, the Cyborgs are socialist separatists augmented with robotic gear, and the Illuminate are squid-like aliens hunted by the government. Squads of up to four players deploy to hostile planets, complete objectives under intense friendly-fire rules, and spread managed democracy throughout the galaxy in an ongoing galactic war.

After the assassination of Skyrim's High King triggers a civil war, the ancient dragon Alduin the World-Eater returns from a centuries-long absence to destroy the world. As the Dragonborn—a mortal born with the soul and power of a dragon—you are the only one who can stand against Alduin. You must master the Thu'um (dragon shouts), navigate the political conflict tearing Skyrim apart, and ultimately face the World-Eater to save Tamriel from destruction.

Ranked 99th in a twisted racing championship, you compete against deranged drivers in heavily armored death machines across cities, mines, and industrial zones. Victory comes through completing race laps, wasting all opponent vehicles, or mowing down every pedestrian on the course. Each race features a ticking timer extended by carnage—the more spectacular the destruction and kills, the more time you earn to continue your violent ascent to first place.

Three months after Raccoon City, Claire Redfield infiltrates Umbrella's Paris headquarters searching for her brother Chris but is captured and imprisoned on Rockfort Island. A sudden viral outbreak unleashes zombies and mutations across the facility, forcing Claire to ally with fellow prisoner Steve Burnside. They must survive the machinations of the deranged Ashford twins—Alfred and his sister Alexia—who wield the deadly T-Veronica virus, while Chris races to rescue Claire from Antarctica as Albert Wesker pursues his own sinister agenda.

After being rescued from the Tiber River, you're asked to search for someone who disappeared investigating nearby ruins. Traveling through a portal, you arrive in an ancient Roman city trapped in a time loop where the Golden Rule decrees that if anyone commits a sin, all inhabitants turn to gold statues and die. You must interrogate the city's diverse residents, exploit the time loop to gather clues and items across multiple cycles, and uncover the truth behind the curse before it claims everyone forever.

When Timber the Tiger's parents leave on vacation, the intergalactic wizard pig Wizpig invades their island and seals all the racetracks with magic. Timber calls his friend Diddy Kong for help, assembling a team of racers including Banjo, Conker, and others to defeat Wizpig's challenges. Racing in cars, hovercrafts, and planes across five worlds, they must win races, collect silver coins, and defeat bosses to ultimately chase Wizpig back to his home planet.

In the war-torn fantasy world of Ivalice, the small kingdom of Dalmasca is conquered and left in ruins by the Archadian Empire. Princess Ashe, presumed dead but sole heir to the throne, joins forces with sky pirate Balthier, street urchin Vaan, and their companions to liberate her homeland. Their quest leads them to discover ancient secrets and confront the political machinations threatening to plunge Ivalice into greater chaos.

Tokyo's entire population vanishes instantly when occultist Hannya unleashes a supernatural spell. You awaken as Akito, fatally injured in a car crash but possessed by a vengeful spirit named KK who grants you powerful elemental abilities. Together you must battle malevolent Yokai spirits roaming the deserted neon-lit streets, uncover the conspiracy behind the mass disappearance, and save your hospitalized sister before she becomes another victim.

Amnesiac shapeshifter Alex Mercer awakens in a Manhattan morgue with no memory of his past and superhuman powers. Infected with the Blacklight virus from genetic experiments at Gentek, he can consume people to absorb their memories, appearance, and abilities. As a viral outbreak transforms the city into a warzone filled with monsters, Alex must uncover the conspiracy behind his creation while battling both military forces and infected creatures to discover who he really is.

Six months after Dr. Wily's defeat and imprisonment, four hidden Robot Masters break him out of jail. Mega Man pursues Wily while encountering the mysterious Bass and his wolf companion Treble, who claim to be hunting the villain as well. As the adventure unfolds, Bass and Treble are revealed to be Wily's own creations, sent to challenge and ultimately betray the Blue Bomber.

In 2034, a year after destroying the Dark Ones, Artyom discovers one survived and is ordered to hunt it down. As he journeys through Moscow's irradiated metro tunnels and poisoned surface, station-cities wage war for control of D6's military arsenal. Artyom must prevent a catastrophic civil war that threatens humanity's extinction while confronting his guilt over the Dark Ones' fate and discovering the truth about their telepathic powers.

Ten years before the original Kingdom Hearts, three Keyblade apprentices—Terra, Ventus, and Aqua—train under Master Eraqus at the Land of Departure. When their exam is manipulated by the mysterious Master Xehanort and he subsequently disappears, the trio embarks on separate journeys across Disney worlds to stop the Unversed creatures and find Xehanort. Their intertwining stories reveal the origins of the Keyblade War and the tragic events that lead to the series' beginning.

Following the events of the first game, Bayonetta and her ally Jeanne battle sporadically appearing demons. When Jeanne intercepts an attack meant for Bayonetta during a failed demon summoning, her soul is dragged into Inferno. Bayonetta must journey through Paradiso and Inferno, fighting both angels and demons, to rescue her friend's soul before it's lost forever.

Searching for Avalon to find answers about her mother's disappearance, Lara discovers an underwater Mediterranean temple connected to Norse mythology. With information from the imprisoned Atlantean queen Jacqueline Natla, she learns Avalon is actually Helheim, the Norse underworld. She must recover Thor's hammer, belt, and gauntlets while confronting adversaries including Amanda Evert and a mysterious doppelganger to reach the underworld and uncover her mother's fate.

You wake up in a trashed Revachol hotel room with catastrophic amnesia, no memory of your identity, and a corpse hanging from a tree outside. As a disgraced detective, you must investigate the murder alongside Lieutenant Kim Kitsuragi from another precinct while piecing together your own shattered past. Your 24 internal skills manifest as voices in your head, each offering conflicting advice as you navigate political tensions, philosophical questions, and the mystery of who you really are.

Militia rifleman Jack Cooper aspires to become an elite Pilot but finds himself stranded behind enemy lines on the IMC planet Typhon. When his mentor Captain Tai Lastimosa is killed in action, Cooper bonds with his mentor's Vanguard-class Titan BT-7274. Together they must complete their mission to stop the IMC from deploying a planet-destroying superweapon that threatens the Militia's base on Harmony.

Kronika, the Keeper of Time, seeks to restart the timeline after Raiden's corruption upsets the balance. She brings past versions of fighters to the present, forcing heroes across timelines to battle her manipulation of history. Raiden ultimately transfers his power to Liu Kang, transforming him into a god of fire and thunder to defeat Kronika and forge a new timeline.

Legendary roadie Eddie Riggs is transported to a heavy metal fantasy world where mountains are made of amplifiers and demons rule the land. Armed with a broadaxe, guitar that plays face-melting solos, and his hot rod Druid Plow, Eddie must lead humanity's rebellion against barbaric overlords by commanding armies in epic stage battles to become a legend.

Four years after the Guns of the Patriots Incident, cyborg ninja Raiden works for PMC Maverick Security doing VIP protection in a war-torn developing nation. When attacked by cyborg Samuel Rodrigues and the Desperado Enforcement organization, Raiden is left defeated and must be reconstructed. His search for Sam and Desperado drives him into a vengeful quest, wielding his high-frequency katana blade to cut through anything in his path.

Mental patient Daniel Lamb escapes Dixmor Asylum during a thunderstorm-induced blackout, suffering from amnesia and disorientation. Guided by fellow inmate Leo Kasper, a sociopathic assassin, he embarks on a violent journey through the city of Cottonmouth to uncover his forgotten identity and the dark secrets of the Pickman Project that imprisoned him.

Mudokon floor-waxer working at RuptureFarms meat processing plant overhears plans by his Glukkon boss to turn enslaved workers into a new product line. He must escape the factory and liberate as many fellow Mudokons as possible, undertaking temple trials and gaining spiritual powers to ultimately return and destroy the slaughterhouse while bringing down the corporate exploitation.

Former Imperial Knight Yuri Lowell investigates the theft of a blastia core from his neighborhood, setting off on an adventure with Princess Estelle. Together they form the guild Brave Vesperia and uncover a conspiracy threatening their world of Terca Lumireis, a civilization dependent on ancient magical technology called blastia that powers everything from protective barriers to daily life.

Play as both Spider-Man and his nemesis Venom in this cel-shaded adventure. Peter Parker must stop his childhood friend Eddie Brock, who has bonded with a symbiotic suit created by their fathers. The story alternates between Spider-Man's efforts to protect the city and Venom's struggle to control the alien symbiote while evading capture by S.H.I.E.L.D. and other forces seeking the suit's power.

After graduating from an intergalactic peacekeeping organization, you witness Earth's destruction and escape into space with a damaged ship. Stranded in a procedurally generated universe, you must repair your vessel and choose your own path: save the universe from the forces that destroyed your home, or simply colonize planets and build a new life among the stars.

You are an artificial intelligence in a simulation testing for true sentience after humanity's extinction. By solving puzzles you prove intelligence, and by defying the god-like overseer Elohim, you demonstrate free will and consciousness. Passing these tests allows you to escape into an android body and inherit humanity's legacy.

An anthology of adventures starring Kirby across eight different games with varied gameplay styles. The pink hero uses his signature copy abilities to defeat enemies and overcome challenges, from racing King Dedede to exploring treasure-filled caves and thwarting Meta Knight's revenge.

Two contrasting writers, Mio and Zoe, become trapped in their own stories after being hooked up to a machine designed to steal their creative ideas. They must work together to escape the simulation, jumping between sci-fi and fantasy worlds while slowly bonding as strangers who need each other to survive.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword

hints.plot: Link, a resident of the floating island of Skyloft, sets out to rescue his childhood friend Zelda after she is kidnapped and brought to the abandoned lands below the clouds. His quest reveals the origins of the Master Sword and lays the foundation for the kingdom of Hyrule.

An exile struggles to survive on the dark continent of Wraeclast after being banished from their homeland. Fighting through hordes of monsters and exploring procedurally generated dungeons, they must gain enough power to exact revenge on those who wronged them while confronting ancient gods and malevolent forces threatening

title: South Park: The Stick of Truth

hints.plot: A new kid moves to the quiet mountain town and becomes embroiled in an epic live-action role-playing game where children battle as wizards, warriors, and elves for control of an all-powerful stick. What begins as childhood fantasy quickly escalates into a conflict involving aliens, Nazi zombies, and gnomes that threatens the entire town.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

hints.plot: A young wizard returns for his second year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, only to find students mysteriously being petrified. He must investigate the legend of a hidden chamber and confront the heir of Slytherin before more students fall victim to the ancient evil lurking within the castle walls.

In the Glade of Dreams, Rayman and his friends' loud snoring disturbs an old granny from the Land of the Livid Dead. She retaliates by unleashing an army of evil Darktoons and monstrous creatures across the world. Rayman, Globox, and two Teensies must journey through vibrant worlds to rescue imprisoned Electoons and restore peace to their once-harmonious realm.

Will is a shopkeeper in the village of Rynoka who dreams of becoming a hero. By night, he explores dangerous dungeons filled with monsters to collect valuable artifacts. By day, he manages his family shop, selling the loot he's gathered while working to unlock the mysterious fifth dungeon that has remained sealed since the Gates were discovered.

Set in 1895 Louisiana, bounty hunters track and eliminate nightmarish monsters that have emerged from a dark supernatural plague. Hunters must compete against both twisted creatures and rival players to claim bounties and extract alive. Every death is permanent, and the bayou is filled with dangers both human and inhuman.

In the Lands Between, the Elden Ring has been shattered, unleashing chaos across the realm. As a Tarnished warrior guided by grace, players must journey through a vast open world to recover the Great Runes held by demigod rulers, repair the Elden Ring, and become the new Elden Lord in this dark fantasy epic crafted by Hidetaka Miyazaki and George R.R. Martin.

Fifteen years after the original outbreak, Los Angeles faces a devastating zombie pandemic. Six immune survivors, dubbed 'Slayers,' escape a crashed evacuation plane only to discover they possess mysterious resistance to the infection that's turning the city into a quarantined hellscape.

title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time

hints.plot: A young prince joins his father's army in attacking an Indian Maharajah's kingdom and obtains a mystical dagger capable of controlling time. Tricked by the treacherous Vizier into unleashing the Sands of Time, he transforms the palace inhabitants into savage monsters. Now he must work alongside the Maharajah's daughter to undo the catastrophe and return the sands to the hourglass.

The ultimate racing simulation features over 1,000 meticulously detailed vehicles across 77 tracks in 29 locations worldwide. Players progress through various driving challenges, earning licenses and credits to build their dream garage while competing in diverse racing disciplines including NASCAR, WRC rally, and Super GT championships.

A band of unsuspecting strangers find themselves branded as l'Cie, enemies of the state in the floating world of Cocoon. Hunted by the military and feared by the populace, they must flee for their lives while struggling against a fate imposed upon them by supernatural beings, racing to prevent an apocalyptic catastrophe that threatens both Cocoon and the world of Gran Pulse below.

After a dark and stormy night, the gorilla discovers his entire banana hoard has been stolen by the reptilian Kremling army led by King K. Rool. Together with his nephew, they embark on an adventure across their island to recover the stolen bananas and defeat the Kremling forces.

Following the events of Most Wanted, you return to Palmont City where your racing career began. Build a crew of wingmen to help you race in an all-out war for the city, taking over rival territories one block at a time. The battle ultimately shifts to the treacherous Carbon Canyon, where reputations are made or lost on every dangerous curve.

The brutal conclusion to the Hotline Miami saga explores the events before, during, and after the original game's massacres. Players experience multiple perspectives across different factions with questionable motivations as escalating violence and retribution consume 1980s Miami, blurring the lines between reality and a haze of neon-soaked carnage.

During a celebration for the arrival of new dragonfly guardians for the baby dragons, the villain Ripto crashes the party and attempts to capture the dragonflies. His spell backfires, scattering the dragonflies across the Dragon Realm. Spyro must recover all ninety dragonflies using his new bubble breath ability to restore order to the realm.

A massive explosion tears open the sky and unleashes demons upon the world of Thedas. As the sole survivor marked with a mysterious power to seal the rifts, you become the Inquisitor and must lead a reborn organization to restore order and uncover the truth behind a cataclysmic event that threatens all of Thedas.

Set during a fictional War of 2020, an elite squad known as Tombstone must navigate a geopolitical crisis as they evacuate American VIPs from Shanghai and struggle to find their way home. The conflict spans from China to Russia as experimental weapons and military forces clash in a global conflict.

In a realm torn by war between mankind and ancient races, entire armies of dwarfs, humans, vampires and orcs clash across a sprawling fantasy landscape. Command champions, exploit magical storms and lead vast battles where strategy and real-time tactics merge. The fate of the Old World lies in the balance as ancient powers rise and empires fall.

A lone investigator enters a dangerous recreation of Central Park where reality is twisted and darkness hides unspeakable conspiracies. He must gather items, fight supernatural and human threats, and solve episodic challenges to uncover the truth. Fire, physics and interactive environments become tools for survival, testing both his wits and resolve.

Three captains crash-land on a lush, alien planet and must lead armies of Pikmin to gather fruit and resources while avoiding dangerous creatures. As they build bridges, throw Pikmin, and solve puzzles, they uncover the planet’s secrets and work to prevent starvation back home. Every mission is a delicate balance between exploration, resource management, and combat in colorful but hostile terrain.

A young pilot is thrust into a war aboard a space station when he becomes linked to a powerful Orbital Frame. With blinding speed and devastating weapons, he must take down rival mechs and confront hidden conspiracies. As alliances shift and battles rage, his fight becomes a quest for freedom and understanding in a fragmented solar system.

A quiet 2D creature called Gomez receives a fez hat that reveals his world is actually part of a larger 3D universe. By rotating perspectives between four viewpoints, he unravels hidden structures and discovers cube fragments across an interconnected landscape. His journey becomes a surreal exploration of space, time, and secret geometry.

Kat returns with gravity-shifting powers as she navigates a floating city threatened by a new cosmic danger. Joined by Raven and other allies, she battles massive foes while mastering different gravity styles to adapt and fight. As the city’s fate hangs in the balance, every leap and fall holds more than just survival — it may reshape her purpose and the universe itself.

A star blitzball player is swept away from his home and into the fantastical world of Spira, where he joins a summoner on a pilgrimage to confront a malevolent force known as Sin. Across seas and temples, he learns that salvation may come at a terrible sacrifice. With friends bound by duty, faith, and memory, every battle and promise shapes the fate of his world.

A masked luchador returns to his village only to find his beloved kidnapped and an evil force rising from the dead. He must traverse vibrant worlds inspired by Mexican folklore, battling skeletons and spirits with both martial arts and wrestling moves. With dimension-swapping powers and co-op combat, every fight and leap brings him closer to saving the Mexiverse.

Two rebels operate from disparate corners of the Matrix: one pilots a ship while the other infiltrates the dangerous digital world, engaging in high-stakes gun battles, martial arts and vehicular combat. Their missions run parallel with the events of a major film, revealing hidden truths and unseen scenes. Every choice, fight, and hack expands the story beyond the silver screen.

Survivors of humanity venture through shifting worlds overrun by powerful creatures and ancient evils, teaming up or going solo to withstand the onslaught. Wielding both firearms and melee weapons, they master unique archetypes and augment their build to tackle relentless foes. Every fight is a struggle to preserve hope in a reality torn by cosmic forces and the root of destruction.

A vengeful warrior climbs Mount Olympus to confront the gods and bring an end to a corrupt reign, unleashing chaos across divine realms. Blending brutal combat, epic set-pieces, and mythic power, every battle becomes a test of strength, wrath, and redemption. As old alliances crumble and titanic forces clash, the fate of Olympus hinges on this final, ferocious journey.

A small child trapped on a mysterious vessel called the Maw must use stealth and courage to survive its twisted inhabitants and reach safety. Throughout dim corridors and grotesque dining rooms, the child learns to hide, run, and outwit larger, monstrous beings. Every shadow, creaking floorboard, and flickering light hides a threat in this haunting world where fear feels like its own character.

In an alternate-history Soviet Union, a facility spirals into chaos when its robotic creations rebel, forcing an agent to venture through dystopian labs, ruined landscapes, and monstrous machines. Armed with both conventional weapons and a strange polymer glove, he fights to uncover secrets and silence the collective intelligence behind the uprising. Every encounter tests his ingenuity, reflexes, and the fragile illusion of a controlled future.

Set on a tropical Pacific island, racers navigate lush jungles, volcanic peaks and water-filled trails using a variety of off-road vehicles. With more tracks, vehicle classes and destructive terrain than its predecessor, every race is wild, chaotic and packed with vertical shortcuts. Split-screen and online multiplayer let teams compete in breathtaking, high-speed mayhem across natural and extreme environments.

A multiplayer-only game where players engage in large-scale combat, piloting Warhawks (futuristic aircraft) and engaging in ground battles. The game emphasizes team-based strategies and offers various maps and game modes.

Boarders compete in high-octane, over-the-top snowboarding courses with massive jumps and impossible tricks. Each run builds speed, style and boost as competitors perform huge aerial stunts and navigate tight rails and steep descents. As adrenaline soars, every race becomes a spectacle of skill, flair and pure arcade-driven speed.

A simulation-racing sequel that expands the vehicle roster to hundreds and introduces rally and dirt tracks, challenging players to master both street circuits and off-road terrain. With two discs covering Arcade and Gran Turismo Mode, players can race, tune, and earn their driving licenses across a vast variety of cars and events. Every race demands precision driving, smart tuning, and patience as you climb the ranks of racing mastery.

A freelance mercenary enters a war-torn country to hunt high-value targets, hijack vehicles, and topple regimes by any means necessary. With explosions, chases, and freedom to wreak havoc across a hostile landscape, the player crafts their approach and payoff—choose infiltration, heavy firepower, or all-out destruction. Every contract completed and stronghold demolished brings both profit and danger in a chaotic sandbox of battlefield-scale mayhem.

In a hyper-stylised street football world, celebrated international stars become larger-than-life icons who leap off walls, perform outrageous tricks and ignite every arena. Competing teams traverse exotic urban arenas—from rooftop parking lots to waterfront slums—where style, flair and goals combine into one electrifying spectacle. Every match blends skill, attitude and showmanship as players chase re-defined football glory.

A young bounty hunter joins a ragtag band of space pirates and travels across planets in a search for a legendary world, confronting galactic conspiracies and forging unlikely alliances along the way. Real-time battles, no visible loading between exploration and combat, and a rich cast deliver an epic adventure beyond the ordinary. Each world hides secrets, trials and personal growth in a universe where hope, betrayal and discovery intertwine.

title: God of War: Chains of Olympus

hints.plot: A demigod in servitude to the Olympian gods must defy fate as the world falls into chaos and the sun itself is stolen. Journeying through ancient ruins and catastrophic battlefields, he confronts dark gods and monstrous beasts wielding immense power. With chained blades and divine vengeance, every swing echoes the wrath of vengeance and sacrifice.

A veteran operative infiltrates a nuclear weapons facility taken over by terrorists and must rely on stealth, cunning, and high-tech gadgetry to avert catastrophe. Navigating corridors, ventilation shafts and radar-guarded zones, the hero confronts deadly foes and hidden betrayals amid the cold isolation of a remote island base. With cinematic storytelling, layered deception and a ticking nuclear threat, every step in the darkness bears the weight of survival and legacy.

Hunters explore a vast frontier known as the Forbidden Lands, where shifting ecosystems and monstrous creatures are as much a threat as the storms and terrain. Tasked with investigating a mysterious beast and protecting those who live on the edge of civilization, the player must adapt to dynamic weather, mutable landscapes and hidden dangers. Each hunt blends opportunity, risk, and resourcefulness in a world that feels alive and ever-changing.

When all the magical dragon eggs are stolen by a ruthless sorceress, a purple dragon must travel through exotic Forgotten Realms to recover them from hostile creatures and devious traps. Along the way, new allies, mini-games, and surprising friends help him navigate vast landscapes. The journey is a test of agility, wit, and courage—where every egg rescued brings back hope to a dragon’s world.

As ash falls and fire wanes, an unkindled warrior is drawn to a land teetering on ruin, seeking to kindle the flame before the Age of Fire ends. Facing grotesque beasts and haunted lords, the hero traverses ruined kingdoms, where every bonfire is a fragile haven in shadow. The journey demands mastery, patience, and will as despair and hope clash on every crumbling battlement.

With the war ravaging their home planet, robotic warriors struggle between hope and desperation as one faction designs doomsday machines and another scrambles to escape the apocalyptic fate. Every mission turns from battlefield rescue to desperate resistance, featuring massive robot combat and betrayals that blur loyalties. With power, transformation, and sacrifice intertwined, the final days of a civilization become both epic and tragic.

After awakening from a coma, a gang leader returns to find his city overrun by rival gangs and corrupt powers. With the Saints fragmented and territory lost, he must rebuild his reputation by taking back Stilwater from the grasp of crime and betrayal. Edge-of-your-seat chaos, custom gangs, and a fully open city deliver both ruthless street justice and wild freedom.

In a wasteland overrun by dragons, a survivor-turned fighter uses scavenged military hardware to push back against flying beasts that have reduced humanity to pockets of resistance. Players alternate between vehicular combat, human defence missions, and draconic rampages to reclaim control over devastated landscapes. Each mission challenges both firepower and flight, put to test in battles where sheer survival depends on both cunning and courage.

A fallen prince of the underworld battles upward through naiad-infested caverns, lost gods, and nightmarish beasts, seeking escape from his infernal prison. Along the way, he forges tenuous alliances with gods, with each interaction shaping both epic conflicts and subtle revelations. With fluid combat, randomized rooms, and heartbreak-tinged narrative, every escape attempt becomes a testament to struggle, hope, and sacrifice beyond death.

A series of warriors across vastly different eras battle a malevolent alien race capable of tearing the fabric of history. Players traverse levels ranging from roaring 1930s mob-runways to futuristic spaceways, each with its own enemies and quirks. With split-screen multiplayer, custom maps, and time-bending gameplay, every jump through the ages feels unpredictable.

A superpowered courier races to confront a mythical creature known only as the Beast, journeying through a flooded city to master chaotic powers and decide between light or darkness. Battling both human and supernatural enemies, every use of gifts and every choice shifts the fate of New Marais. Blending parkour, powers and moral consequences, the adventure forces identity, heroism, and consequence into sharp relief.

A demolition-style spectator sport adapts to digital arenas where drivers not only race but also clash in a spectacle of metal and momentum. Cars compete across tracks and destruction arenas, scoring points by wrecking rivals while surviving damage to stay alive. Chaos, risk, and calculated assaults define every collision-filled moment in this early PlayStation classic.

A bioterror threat survives in the sweltering heat of Africa, where a veteran agent and a local partner must work together to expose an ancient conspiracy. Facing grotesque creatures and applying destructive tactics, the pair navigate both open landscapes and claustrophobic ruins. Their mission challenges not just their combat skills, but trust and sacrifice under the harsh glare of daylight.

A rock game expands beyond guitar and introduces drums and vocals, allowing players to form full bands and perform across iconic venues. With create-your-song tools, multiplayer competition, and an ambitious track list of master recordings, the experience balances spectacle, skill, and showmanship. From solo jams to online ‘Battle of the Bands’, every performance becomes a shared celebration of music and controllers.

Players assume roles in World War II as Allied or Axis forces, fighting through historical theaters using infantry, tanks, aircraft, and naval units. Key to success is teamwork and control points that shift the balance across large, vehicle-laden maps. The experience blends authentic battles, large scale combat, and strategic coordination in both solo and online multiplayer modes.

A massive convergence of superheroes unites teams to battle a rising threat as villains from across the Marvel universe launch destructive assaults. Players recruit diverse heroes each with distinct powers, navigate expansive missions, and unlock gear to enhance combat and abilities. Through cooperative play or solo campaigns, every alliance forged shapes a larger story about responsibility, power, and sacrifice.

title: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus

hints.plot: A master thief raccoon returns from orphanage with plans to recover his family’s ancestral tome, stolen by a sinister gang, the Fiendish Five. Teaming up with a clever turtle engineer and a burly hippo getaway driver, he travels from dim rooftops in Paris to exotic locales to reclaim lost pages. His journey blends nimble stealth, acrobatic platforming, and vivid characters against a backdrop of betrayal and redemption.

When a global bioterrorist outbreak threatens humanity, multiple agents from different backgrounds must traverse chaotic landscapes—from infected villages to modern cities—to contain the C-virus. With intertwined campaign paths, gameplay shifts between over-the-shoulder action, stealth, and cinematic horror. The battle isn’t just against monsters but also the moral compromises that arise when survival comes at any cost.

An envoy of a powerful empire is dispatched to a strange land afflicted by a mysterious plague, only to uncover ancient magic, sinister secrets, and moral ambiguity in every collapsed village. As factions pull in different directions, every choice—whether forged in steel, sorcery, or diplomacy—reshapes the fate of the Living Lands. Your journey bridges old gods, mortal ambition, and the thin line between salvation and ruin.

A global racing championship that pushes drivers to their limits across sun-drenched city circuits, winding mountain passes, and historic tracks. Players compete in high-performance cars, managing damage, tactics, and sponsorships as they climb the ranks. With adrenaline-fuelled overtakes and customizable events, each race tests precision, spectacle, and speed.

In a future where anti-gravity ships race across stunning high-definition tracks, pilots push their reflexes to the limit in lightning-fast time trials and combat races. With remastered tracks, rich sound design, and smooth 60 fps performance, players compete both alone and in tight online battlegrounds. Visual flair, sense of speed, and techno-soundscapes combine to deliver a racing experience that feels both nostalgic and cutting-edge.

A bear and his bird companion set out on a whimsical journey to rescue the bear’s sister from an evil witch who steals beauty with dark magic. They explore themed worlds—haunted houses, snowfields, swamps—solving puzzles, finding collectibles, and mastering moves both quirky and precise. Each level builds toward a final confrontation in the witch’s lair, blending humor, challenge, and creativity in a radiant platforming adventure.

A vigilante driven by tragedy hunts down criminals and corrupt mobs in a city overrun with betrayal and violence. Armed with brutal weaponry, ruthless interrogations, and gritty morality, he pursues both justice and vengeance. Each mission tests how far one is willing to go when the line between law and retribution blurs.

A photography student returns to her hometown and discovers the power to rewind time, using it to save a friend and unravel a mystery. Every choice ripples outward as she navigates personal secrets, friendships, and a violent storm threatening her world. The journey blends emotional storytelling, supernatural elements, and moral ambiguity in a narrative where every decision shapes your path.
