A skilled federal agent is sent to a remote European village to rescue the president’s daughter, only to discover the locals are under a terrifying parasite’s control. Equipped with modern combat tools but immersed in horror and mystery, he must face grotesque enemies and unravel dark conspiracies. The journey blends resource management, intense set pieces, and psychological dread in a remote hostile environment.

Stranded on a desolate frontier planet, treasure hunters team up to seek out an alien vault rumored to house infinite riches. Battling wild fauna, bandits, and corrupt corporate forces, each Vault Hunter carves their own path across rugged terrain and underground ruins. With fast weapon-drops, over-the-top action, and co-op mayhem, survival depends on loot, strategy, and grit.

In a dystopian 1960s English setting, citizens are required to take a drug-called Joy that suppresses sorrow and truth. A group of individuals rejects this forced cheer and must survive by hiding, blending in, or escaping the city as they uncover a sinister conspiracy. The journey blends stealth, resource scavenging, and moral tensions in a world where conformity masks decay.

A hero relives pivotal moments from a legendary trilogy, mastering martial arts, supernatural powers, and epic gunplay across iconic film scenes. The journey weaves together alternative narrative paths and a climactic ending directed by the original storytellers. Each encounter blends cinematic spectacle with interactive combat in a vast simulation of destiny and choice.

A self-styled assassin thrusts into a war of rank and reputation with nothing but a beam katana and dreams of being the top killer. Missions span open-world suburbs and seedy after-hours locales, with boss duels, side hustles, and outrageous characters shaping every challenge. It’s a narrative born from chaos, competition, and a touch of absurdity as ambitions clash and blood flows freely.

In a future where Earth has retreated into wild nature after catastrophic conflict, a resourceful survivor must escort a tech-savvy fugitive across ravaged landscapes stalked by rogue machines. Bound by a device that forces cooperation, they rely on each other’s contrasting strengths to overcome treacherous terrain, bandit threats, and environmental puzzles. Their odyssey of survival, trust and reclaiming hope unfolds amid beauty and danger, as old world ruins reveal both menace and memory.

After journeying from cryosleep decades late, an unwitting colonist awakens amid corporate decay and conspiracies in a distant star system. With factions competing for dominance, alliances shift, and every decision—from dialogue to combat—shapes the outcome in this colony. Bold humor, twisted futurism, and moral choices combine to deliver a character-driven adventure where consent, loyalty, and survival intertwine.

An artifact shatters the fabric of reality, forcing multiple versions of a web-slinging hero from four dimensions to recover its fragments. From noir-tinged stealth to fast-paced futuristic combat, each universe presents its own style and unique challenge. Battling iconic foes across diverse worlds, the journey forces the hero to grapple with identity, power, and the weight of heroic responsibility.

A skater emerges from incarceration in a city where skateboarding has been outlawed and rebuilt, attempting to restore its vibrant scene. With challenges, contests, and dozens of tricks, they confront corporate suppression and zoned-out architecture designed to stifle all movement. Purpose-built momentum, creativity, and daring are required to turn the city back into a skater’s playground.

A young psychic agent fulfills lifelong dreams by joining a clandestine organization, only to discover its leader is compromised. Traveling through vivid mental landscapes and battling internal demons—both symbolic and literal—they must root out the corruption and save minds. It’s a journey of introspection, humor, and otherworldly powers where every trail through someone’s psyche reveals more about both villain and hero.

A hero leaves the familiar kingdom behind to travel through unfamiliar lands where gravity, water, and even the skies betray expectations. He traverses four diverse regions, piloting strange vehicles and rescuing a princess while battling alien invaders. Though simple by later standards, every level is a test of agility, timing, and creativity in adapting Mario’s classic platforming for a tiny, handheld world.

An elite counter-terrorism team descends on Las Vegas, where a terrorist siege threatens iconic landmarks. Players alternate between precision tactics and raw firefights, navigating urban chaos and high profile targets while commanding teammates in real time. With intense gunplay, cinematic flair, and destructible cover, every moment tests the balance of strategy and aggression.

Four survivors must battle through courses of ruined cityscapes and desolate countryside teeming with monstrous infected, relying on team coordination to survive. The game adapts the intensity and pacing of zombie attacks dynamically in response to the players’ progress to keep tension high. Every playthrough feels shaped by unpredictable moments of desperation, sacrifice, and raw adrenaline in this cooperative struggle for survival.

After returning home to find his beloved claimed by a dark force, a tormented warrior descends through imagined circles of punishment to battle infernal beasts and reclaim what was lost. Each circle reflects a sin, twisted into grotesque landscapes and relentless adversaries shaped by the sins they embody. With divine powers and weapons borne of desperation, the hero must confront not only external monsters, but his own guilt and redemption in a hellish pilgrimage.

Characters represent distinctive archetypes locked in perpetual combat over objectives, each bringing unique abilities to shift the flow of battle. Set across whimsical, stylized arenas, teamwork, class synergy, and map control define the outcome rather than brute force. Far more than a shooter, it’s a living, evolving competition powered by community creations, continual updates, and emergent moments of chaos.

After his wife’s death, an ex-criminal must navigate London’s underworld and evade both corrupt cops and crime bosses who want him silenced. Missions alternate between high-speed chases, gritty foot combat, and tense surveillance, with each perspective revealing more of a city wrapped in betrayal. The lack of health meters or minimaps heightens realism and forces every decision and confrontation to carry weight.

In a world overrun by subterranean monsters, survivors rally in the aftermath of past horrors to mount a desperate counteroffensive. They battle through collapsing landscapes, use cover-based tactics and brutal executions to reclaim their lost cities. Every alliance, sacrifice, and firefight drives the struggle for mankind’s survival amid the encroaching Locust horde.

An operative infiltrates a quarantined city beset by a zombie epidemic, using parkour and brutal crafting mechanics to survive during the day. But when night falls, the hunted become the prey as more lethal, mutated threats emerge to stalk the shadows. Every rooftop chase and improvised combat encounter reminds you that survival hinges on agility, resourcefulness, and the will to endure beyond dusk.

A band of intergalactic heroes unite to defend the universe’s last surviving star by battling relentless alien forces and dark conspiracies. Each hero wields unique abilities and progression paths in frenetic missions that shift between solo campaigns and competitive team clashes. The experience blends rich character customization, chaotic combat, and strategic hero selection in a bold, sci-fi shooter spectacle.

An elite agent infiltrates sprawling facilities, icy peaks, and orbiting installations to foil a criminal mastermind’s global weapon plot. Armed with high-tech gadgets, vehicular chases, and zero-gravity encounters, he fights across visually diverse terrains. Covert infiltration and high-octane combat intertwine in a cinematic campaign built for both solo operatives and team-based battles.

A supernatural assassin reclaims the throne from a malevolent usurper by infiltrating a decadent coastal city filled with occult secrets and oppressors. Players wield a unique arsenal of stealth powers and gadgets to shape each encounter—choosing between subtle infiltration or bold confrontation. Architecture and environment become allies or adversaries as every choice echoes through a richly detailed world built on consequence and creativity.

A renegade mercenary equipped with experimental cybernetic implants ventures into a neon-soaked megalopolis in search of a prototype that grants immortality. As alliances blur and corporate machinations shift, every choice determines whether survival means power, redemption, or ruin amid glittering decay. Open streets and dark alleys alike teem with opportunity and threats, where memory, identity, and humanity collide in a fractured future.

In a cyber-punk Paris of the near future, a memory hunter with a lost identity infiltrates neural networks to rewrite both others’ recollections and her own. Her journey unfolds amid neon-lit streets and digital nightmares, where each memory manipulated may reshape reality or betray the truth. The story blends fast-paced combat, customizable combos, and surreal memory-remixing into a haunting quest for self-discovery.

After being poisoned by their late patron, a pair of allies must race in a deadly championship, competing in armed vehicles across chaotic circuits for an antidote. Along the way, they dodge traps, unleash weaponized upgrades, and face fierce rivals in explosive, stylish combat. Every race is a survival spectacle where cunning, speed, and firepower determine who lives — or dies — behind the wheel.

A branded outcast wields branded powers and fights his way through demonic forces unleashed by a fallen god in a dark fantasy realm. As he traverses interconnected halls and forgotten cathedrals, every strategic swing and spell draws him closer to confronting ancient gods. The journey fuses righteous determination with brutal combat in a mythic struggle for redemption.

A survivor emerges from underground tunnels into a desolate world, seeking to rebuild his life aboard a steam locomotive while evading mutated monstrosities and human threats. Journeying across a fractured, post-apocalyptic landscape, he must make choices that echo through emergent factions and volatile environments. With atmospheric storytelling and evolving open levels, every decision shapes both survival and hope in a ravaged realm.

In a grim, steampunk city rife with corruption and supernatural influence, a master thief uses darkness and silence to his advantage. He navigates gothic cathedrals, watery aqueducts, and densely layered architecture to infiltrate and escape unseen. His mission blends clever non-lethal tactics, emergent AI reactions to light and sound, and immersive ambience into a pioneering stealth experience.

In a violent American frontier, a fortune-seeking ranch hand is framed for murder, prompting a relentless hunt by a tormented preacher. Their intertwined paths fuel a gritty duel of blood and vengeance across saloons, ghost towns, and dusty plains. With dynamic encounters and classic Western grit, every showdown tests resolve and righteousness in a world where justice is drawn at close range.

A restless soul is trapped in Purgatory and offered entry to Heaven if they eliminate Lucifer’s demonic army. Armed with tarot-enhanced weapons and supernatural power, the protagonist battles through gothic arenas overrun with monstrous foes. The experience blends explosive, arena-style combat with an eerie, mythic underworld setting.

title: The Last of Us Part II

hints.plot: Years after finding sanctuary, a survivor is drawn back into a brutal cycle of vengeance sparked by a catastrophic event. Traversing hostile environments and facing moral decay, they uncover and confront buried truths through physically and emotionally punishing encounters. The journey challenges ideas of forgiveness, empathy, and the weight of one's choices amid a world fractured by loss.

A ranger resurrected alongside a spectral wraith embarks on a revenge-fueled journey across a perilous Mordor, navigating orc clans, espionage, and betrayal. The world remembers: enemies adapt and rise through the ranks in response to player actions, forging uniquely personal vendettas. Blending visceral combat and mythology, every confrontation reshapes the shape of vengeance in this dark Middle-earth chronicle.

Warriors from across time converge in a reimagining of a legendary weapon-based tournament, where the edge of every blade foretells fate. Each combatant battles through stages rooted in mythology and turmoil, wielding power drawn from their inner convictions. The clash of steel, strategy, and story brings swordsmanship and soul into a timeless, dramatic contest.

A squad leader directs two infantry fire-teams through intense urban warfare in a fictional desert nation, using realistic tactics and battlefield communication instead of direct aiming. With emphasis on coordination and terrain advantage, commanders must outmaneuver terrorists through split-second decisions and terrain awareness. The result is a gritty, cinematic experience blending military simulation with emergent real-time strategy.

A skilled operative dives into frenetic gunplay and sword-wielding stunts amid stylized, horror-tinged action. Fluid acrobatics—slides, wall-runs, jumps—trigger cinematic slow-motion sequences where she dispatches enemies with flair and bloodied precision. Shot-through levels unfold like pulpy action films, each move designed to elevate the spectacle and intensity.

On a world made of living Titans drifting above endless clouds, a scavenger forms a bond with a sentient weapon. Together, they embark on a sprawling journey to reach a mythical paradise beyond the World Tree. Along the way, they forge alliances, uncover ancient legacies, and wield powers born of human-Blade symbiosis in an epic fight for survival.

A hardened soldier becomes humanity’s first weapon in a battle against a horrifying alien invasion spreading across post-war Britain. Armed with experimental weaponry and newfound resilience, he must sever the Chimera’s grip on the nation. Fast-paced firefights, tense environments, and widescreen cinematic flair define the struggle in this acclaimed PlayStation 3 launch title.

A terrified child flees into his dark basement to escape his fanatical mother, embarking on a nightmarish journey through ever-changing, monster-filled dungeons. Armed only with tears and strange power-grants, he adapts and evolves to survive. Each descent through the depths is unpredictable, blending grotesque encounters, hidden treasures, and brutal challenges in a twisted roguelike odyssey.

A mythic commander embarks on a quest across ancient lands where gods, monsters, and legendary heroes collide. Commanding civilizations such as Greeks, Egyptians, and Norse—each with unique mythological powers—players wage war through deity-bestowed miracles and strategic troop management. The journey blends epic feats, divine intervention, and tactical dominance amid a richly imagined ancient world.

In a post-nuclear Mojave Wasteland, a courier left for dead discovers a web of competing factions vying to control a desert metropolis built on the ruins of Las Vegas. Armed with alliances, reputation, and survival skills, they choose alliances or chart their own path through a world that rewards both power and pragmatism. Every decision reverberates across the landscape, reshaping the fate of the new frontier.

A young man discovers his demonic heritage and battles powerful enemies to protect humanity from infernal forces. As he learns to control his abilities, he confronts both personal and cosmic conflicts. The journey challenges him to master combat skills, unravel mysteries, and face formidable foes in a dark, urban world.

Players take control of a wide variety of realistic vehicles to compete in races across diverse tracks and environments. The game emphasizes precision driving, car customization, and competition against both AI and human opponents. Success requires mastering handling, strategy, and adapting to dynamic racing conditions.

A hero returns to a galactic war torn by new threats and shifting alliances, where enemies become unlikely allies and betrayal lurks around every corner. As battles rage across both familiar and alien battlefields, he must navigate moral complexities and fierce combat in a universe on the brink. Legendary weapons, vehicle combat, and an evolving online battlefield define his harrowing struggle for survival and legacy.

A hero from diverse origins joins an ancient order to battle a monstrous scourge gripping a fractured land. Survival hinges on uniting unlikely allies through strategy, tough moral choices, and tactical combat in a richly-realized fantasy setting. Each decision echoes across the realm as shadows of corruption threaten to consume every faction.

Stranded on a mysterious island teeming with prehistoric creatures, survivors must scavenge resources, craft tools, tame dinosaurs, and build shelters to endure the elements. Alliances form as tribes challenge and collaborate within a massive open world that blends survival instincts with emergent online conflicts. With relentless threats and untamed ecosystems, every day becomes a desperate struggle for dominance or coexistence in this hostile paradise.

A group of club bouncers springs into action when a special-forces team crashes through a roof to abduct a young girl. Their rescue mission unfolds across highly cinematic stages that mix dramatic cutscenes with beat-’em-up combat. Unique character perspectives and fast camera cuts shape an experimental action-movie experience.

title: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne

hints.plot: An embittered detective returns to the NYPD and falls into a fractured conspiracy while haunted by nightmares and reunited with a presumed-dead assassin. Between cinematic bullet-time gunfights and noir narration, alliances blur as they chase truths buried in tragedy. The narrative weaves a film-noir love story of fate, betrayal, and redemption set against a backdrop of gritty urban decay.

A soldier trapped in a WWI bunker must survive an ever-present, adaptive monster by scavenging resources, managing a generator, and planning escape routes. Each decision and improvisation alter the horror experience, blending emergent sandbox gameplay with tense stealth. With darkness as a weapon and tools as lifelines, survival hinges on quick wits in a claustrophobic nightmare.

You emerge as the sole survivor from underground vault isolation into a devastated, post-nuclear Boston, determined to reunite with family. As the world rebuilds around you, you must navigate warring factions, expand settlements, and make impactful choices in a dynamic open world. From scavenging ruins to crafting weapons and building communities, your journey shapes the fate of the Commonwealth.

A mafia don wielding an ancient supernatural power unleashes devastating ‘Darkness’ abilities in a visceral, graphic-noir shooter. Quests for vengeance and truth spiral into a brutal conspiracy as he confronts enemies both human and demonic. Quad-wielding chaos meets moral decay in a stylized horror tale of corruption, power, and fate.

A street racer navigates an expansive, open-world depiction of Los Angeles, competing in illegal races, customizing vehicles, and rising through underground ranks. With dynamic weather and day-night cycles, the city’s neighborhoods become your racetrack as rivals and the police challenge you at every turn. Player reputation, vehicle upgrades, and mastery of shortcuts define your journey to become the city's top driver.

Set in the fantasy world of Eora, the game follows a protagonist known as the Watcher, who has the ability to see souls and memories. The story unfolds in the Dyrwood region, where a mysterious phenomenon causes infants to be born without souls, leading to widespread panic and political unrest. As the Watcher, players explore ancient ruins, uncover hidden truths, and navigate complex moral choices that impact the fate of the world.

Two brothers, Cuphead and Mugman, must repay their debt to the devil by battling a series of challenging bosses across fantastical worlds, using their unique weapons and abilities in this challenging run-and-gun adventure.

Inaba, a quiet town in rural Japan, is shaken by a series of mysterious murders. As a transfer student, you and your friends discover a supernatural world within television screens. Balancing daily life with dungeon exploration, you must uncover the truth behind the murders and the enigmatic Midnight Channel.

Set in White Wolf Publishing's World of Darkness, the game follows a human who is killed and revived as a fledgling vampire. The game depicts the fledgling's journey through early 21st-century Los Angeles to uncover the truth behind a recently discovered relic that heralds the end of all vampires.

Set 20 years after the events of *XCOM: Enemy Unknown*, Earth has fallen under alien rule. As the commander of the resistance, players must rebuild XCOM, leading a guerrilla war against the alien occupation to reclaim Earth and restore humanity's freedom.

In this prequel to the Turok series, Tal'Set, a Native American warrior, battles Captain Tobias Bruckner in 1886 Texas. A rift opens, transporting Tal'Set to the Lost Lands, where he allies with the River Village to combat Lord Tyrannus and his reptilian forces, uncovering the origins of the Turok lineage.

Players take on the roles of colorful crewmates on a spaceship completing mundane tasks, while one or more impostors lurk among them. Crewmates must identify and vote out impostors before they sabotage the mission or eliminate everyone. The social gameplay hinges on communication, deceit, and deduction in isolated settings.

You lead a customizable hero through supernatural combat missions and social exploration among legendary heroes in a haunted abbey. Turn-based card‑driven battles require strategic choices as you build relationships and unlock abilities. As a demonic threat looms, your team must balance friendship and fury to stop a cosmic apocalypse.

A squad of elite soldiers is dispatched to reclaim a base overrun by alien‑mutated paradisiacal militia and monstrous creatures. As the mission unfolds, internal dissent and political cover‑ups mirror the moral fog of war. The mission apex reveals that the alien threat and government lies intertwine, forcing choices that redefine trust and duty.

A vampiric wraith seeks revenge on his former master across haunted realms, shifting between physical and spectral planes to solve puzzles, battle undead foes, and uncover dark secrets about destiny and betrayal.

A prince flees a time‑manipulating curse while hunted by a relentless incarnation of fate across a dark, dangerous island. He gains powerful sand‑based abilities and mastery of dual-wield combat to survive cultists, monsters, and fragmented environments. Through nonlinear exploration and brutal encounters, he confronts destiny amid emergent choices and game‑shaping decisions.

Characters traverse a fully explorable Springfield in a mission‑based driving game packed with humor, side‑quests, and collectibles. An alien conspiracy involving Buzz Cola and mysterious spy cameras unfolds through vehicle chases and on‑foot investigation. The style blends cartoon satire, sandbox gameplay, and episodic storytelling.

Agents trained by a secret civil defense unit are deployed to reclaim and restore a pandemic-ravaged New York City. They must scavenge, upgrade gear, and navigate a criminal underworld as factions vie for control. The Dark Zone forces decisions between cooperation and betrayal in a shared-open world mission.

A master thief reunites with allies to perform a daring global heist on a remote island. Between ship battles, disguises, and high-stakes stealth missions, they uncover their family’s hidden legacy. With branching narrative moments and unlockable mini-games, the adventure blends cinematic flair and cooperative gameplay.

A lone bounty hunter investigates a derelict space station orbiting a seemingly deserted planet, uncovering experiments with an alien substance called Phazon. As she explores lush biomes and hostile environments, she acquires new abilities and technologies to access deeper areas. The adventure combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and combat into a cohesive, atmospheric sci‑fi first‑person journey.

A skilled ninja travels to America to avenge his father by finding hidden statues that, when united, can unleash an ancient demonic power. Battling cultists, supernatural enemies, and elaborate platforming challenges, he follows clues across shadowed cities and remote jungles. Cinematic cutscenes punctuate the journey in this fast-paced side-scroller known for its visual storytelling and demanding gameplay.

A mercenary is sent to a conflict-torn African country to eliminate a notorious arms dealer. Battling malaria, shifting loyalties, and unpredictable violence, the struggle tests survival instincts. Players navigate a vast open world filled with factional politics, emergent trust and betrayal, and destructible environments.

A teenager returns to a sinister mist-shrouded town to uncover the truth about her origins and confront a cult that binds the town in nightmares. As reality fractures, hallucinatory horrors and puzzles warp perception and meaning. Solving cryptic clues and surviving grotesque encounters forces a journey into identity, fear, and a deep-rooted ritual legacy.

A seasoned soldier breaks away from her command to uncover a personal mystery and unravel a new threat to her home world. She traverses diverse environments—from frozen wastes to dense jungles—while discovering hidden secrets behind enemy forces. With a tactical squad at her side and multiple gameplay modes, she must rally allies across battlefronts to protect what remains.

A skilled hunter ventures into a lush, machine-infested wild to unravel the mysteries of her origin and the downfall of ancient civilizations. She explores diverse environments, scavenges technology, and battles colossal mechanical creatures. Her journey weaves together environmental storytelling, mythic lore, and high-stakes confrontation.

An FBI profiler investigates a series of ritualistic murders in a small Pacific Northwest town while the famed writer tries to escape a looping nightmare by rewriting reality. Their paths intertwine in a haunting psychological thriller that blends exploration, survival‑style combat, and meta‑narrative storytelling.

A refined football simulation offering a fast-paced, realistic experience with improved AI and licensed leagues. Players can master gameplay mechanics across single‑player and online multiplayer modes. With enhanced realism and competitive depth, it became a standout title in its series.

Players control powerful heroes in 5‑v‑5 magical combat, aiming to destroy the opponent’s ancient stronghold. With dynamic itemization, strategic teamwork, and evolving battlefield conditions, outcome hinges on coordination and skill. Over years of updates, the game has become a cornerstone of competitive esports and cooperative PvE experiences.

From microscopic organism to spacefaring civilization, players guide a species through evolution, tribal growth, warfare, and galactic exploration. Procedural generation and user-created content drive a limitless world where every choice shapes ecology, culture, and technology. A creative sandbox experience blending strategy, simulation, and emergent storytelling.

A dragon rider and his companion set out on a quest through a crumbling world dominated by ancient powers. Traversing diverse landscapes, they engage in tactical, semi‑real‑time combat and uncover a secretive technology. As they confront believers and ghosts of the past, their mission reveals the fate of a lost civilization.

A Vietnam veteran returns to a crime-riddled city to avenge his surrogate family, destabilizing rival mob factions as he builds his own empire. Through gritty missions, chaotic combat, and driving sequences, he fights to gain control in a corrupt urban underworld. His choices and alliances define both personal vengeance and the fate of the city.

A lone wanderer ventures into a forbidden land to revive a lost loved one by defeating massive colossi. Each battle is a puzzle of strategy and agility, set in an atmospheric and expansive world. The journey explores themes of sacrifice, solitude, and the consequences of defying fate.

A scientist fights to overthrow an alien regime controlling Earth by navigating dystopian cityscapes and confronting deadly enemies. Armed with advanced weapons and gadgets, he teams up with resistance fighters to dismantle oppressive forces. The story blends intense action with a compelling narrative of survival and rebellion.

A cast of beloved characters compete in fast-paced tennis matches across vibrant 3D courts. Players can choose from multiple gameplay modes, including tournaments, exhibitions, and quirky challenges like ring shot and piranha plant practice. With intuitive controls and lively arenas, it became a hallmark of social gaming on the console.

A modern warfare squad embarks on a mission through snowy peaks, dense jungles, and dusty villages to stop a towering super-weapon. With fully destructible environments powered by the Frostbite engine, battles are dynamic and tactical. High-octane multiplayer and a charismatic squad narrative define their desperate fight.

In a zombie‑infested open world, survivors must scavenge for resources, fortify a base, and build a community amid constant threats. Your leadership choices determine group morale and survival chances. As the undead menace grows, every decision has lasting consequences in this tense, emergent simulation.

A cursed warrior escapes a nightmarish asylum and embarks on a pilgrimage through a decaying kingdom. Challenging foes and labyrinthine environments demand careful strategy and resolve. Fragmented lore and cryptic clues urge exploration and perseverance against overwhelming odds.

Two martial‑arts brothers fight through gangs across a dystopian urban landscape to rescue a kidnapped loved one. They punch, kick, and swing weapons in cooperative combat, battling through alleys, factories, and rooftops. Their mission culminates in confronting the final gang leader to reclaim peace.

A hero returns to a world besieged by demonic forces, confronting hordes of evil as they chase a fallen star. Vengeance and redemption intertwine as they journey across ruined landscapes, gathering allies and powerful artifacts. Along the way, their actions shape the fate of Sanctuary in a clash of celestial and infernal destinies.

The latest tournament returns with interactive arenas, multilevel stages and environmental hazards. A deeper story mode unfolds involving power struggles and vengeance. Featuring a mix of veteran and new fighters, each bout tests skill, strategy and timing.

A hero journeys through a vividly realized 3D world to free his land from mechanical pirates who've enslaved its inhabitants. Utilizing acrobatic moves, combat, and puzzle-solving across diverse environments, he recovers his lost abilities and exposes a larger threat. His quest culminates in rescuing friends and restoring peace to an enchanted realm.

A resurrected noble emerges from his ruined stronghold to reclaim his empire with the help of mischievous minions. He conquers villages, battles heroes, and spreads corruption across the land. Player choices influence alignment and narrative outcomes amid dark humor and satirical fantasy tropes.

Set on a colonized Mars, a revolutionary demolitions expert joins a rebellion to overthrow a brutal occupying force. Using ingenuity and destructive weaponry, he dismantles strongholds and frees territories in a sprawling, destructible environment. As the insurgency grows, he confronts the costs of war and the power of resistance.

Players assume the role of a taxi driver racing against time to deliver passengers across a bustling city. Earning tips involves pulling off daring stunts and precision driving. The arcade-style gameplay emphasizes fast-paced action and high-score challenges.

A clandestine agent uncovers a global conspiracy after a mission gone wrong, forced to go rogue as he navigates espionage, lethal conflicts, and personal betrayals. His decisions shape relationships and outcomes as he fights to prevent a catastrophic event.

In a vast open-world city, you tackle high-speed races, stunt challenges, and chaotic pursuits using diverse vehicles. Explore the streets, unlock events, and dominate rival players through arcade-style driving and explosive crashes.

In a city built for street racing culture, a young driver enters an underground scene marked by tuner cars, drift and drag challenges, and deep customization. Free-roam across diverse urban districts, take on rival crews, and rise through the ranks in high-stakes competitions that blend speed, style, and strategy.

An amnesiac hedgehog with special powers joins a three‑way conflict between alien invaders, military forces, and a mad doctor, wielding weapons and vehicles in nonlinear missions that determine his loyalties and uncover the truth about his past.

A hero ventures into a magical castle and travels through paintings to rescue a princess from a fearsome menace. Along the way, he collects Power Stars by exploring varied worlds—leaping, flying, and solving platform-based challenges in pioneering 3D gameplay.

Returning to her ancestral family home, the last Finch explores interconnected vignettes detailing each relative's final moments. Each vignette uses unique mechanics that reveal emotional layers and surreal truths. Through exploration and discovery, the mystery of the family’s tragic legacy unfolds.

You control rocket-powered cars in fast-paced arena soccer matches. Teams of up to eight compete to drive a ball into the opponent’s net using acrobatic stunts, strategic positioning, and explosive speed. With cross-platform play, customizable vehicles, and high-octane gameplay, it revolutionized competitive esports since launch.

You lead a burgeoning empire on a campaign spanning Europe, North Africa, and the Near East, managing diplomacy, economy, and army movement on a grand strategy map. When armies clash, battles unfold in real-time with thousands of soldiers, allowing strategic tactics to determine victory. As factions rise and fall, you shape the future of Rome through conquest and political savvy.

title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

hints.plot: On the brink of galactic war four millennia before the Empire, you must master mysterious powers and lead a custom band of allies to confront a growing Sith menace. Choices matter as you navigate iconic Star Wars worlds, shaping your destiny and the fate of the Republic.

A young woman bound to a supernatural entity uses her growing powers to navigate a nonlinear journey across many years. Along the way, she confronts profound mysteries, dangerous situations, and emotional scars while uncovering hidden truths about herself and those who influence her fate.

A young aspiring pirate arrives in a bustling Caribbean port to prove himself through a series of challenges. Along the way, he uncovers comic mysteries, confronts a legendary ghost pirate, and navigates clever dialogue puzzles to rescue a governor and discover the island’s hidden secret.

You awaken on a remote island covered in hundreds of interconnected puzzles. As you explore and solve line‑drawing challenges, you slowly uncover visual patterns and environmental clues that reveal hidden truths about the island and yourself.

Set in 2161, a fractured United States is divided between the Atlantic Alliance and the Pacificans following ecological disasters. Playing as Sergeant Jet Brody, a member of the Atlantic forces, you deploy futuristic weapons capable of deforming terrain to battle in strategic skirmishes and uncover devastating secrets behind the conflict.

An elite Delta Force team is sent into a sandstorm-ravaged Dubai to investigate a distress signal, but as battles escalate they must confront the horrors of war and their own morality, enduring extreme sand-triggered combat and making decisions that blur the line between duty and devastation.

In a bleak sci‑fi future, humanity sends elite operatives to colonize a hostile planet called Enoch. Betrayed and exposed to a deadly anomaly, one of these Outriders discovers superhuman powers. Teaming up with others, they fight to reclaim Earth’s hope amid fierce battles, visceral gun‑play, and deep RPG‑style progression.

An operative is dropped into a sprawling island nation ruled by a dictator. Armed with a grappling hook, parachute, and an arsenal of weapons and vehicles, he must ignite chaos to spark revolution and liberate the people of Panau.

Set 15 years after the events of the original film, the game follows Amanda Ripley as she investigates the disappearance of her mother, Ellen Ripley, aboard the space station Sevastopol. The station is in disarray due to years of corporate negligence and the threat of a rampant alien creature. The game emphasizes stealth and survival horror gameplay, requiring the player to avoid, outsmart, and fight various enemies with equipment such as firearms, a motion tracker, stun baton, and a flamethrower.

Commanding a soldier enhanced with advanced abilities, you lead the final stand against a colossal alien threat, rallying allies across worlds. Your choices carry immense weight—shaping the fate of characters, civilizations and even Earth itself. As the war reaches its climax, cooperation and sacrifice become pivotal in determining how the galaxy endures.
A nano-augmented agent is sent on a mission to stop a bioterrorist attack, only to uncover a sprawling global conspiracy that forces him to question who he can trust and what the future holds.

title: Final Fantasy Tactics: The War of the Lions

hints.plot: A young noble cadet is drawn into a widescale civil conflict in a richly detailed kingdom, where battlefield tactics, shifting allegiances and political intrigue test his loyalties and shape his destiny as he uncovers corruption and betrayal.

Returning to her family’s house after a year abroad, a young woman finds it eerily empty, with no sign of her parents or sister. As she explores the quiet, rain-soaked home, she pieces together a story told through notes, journals, and forgotten belongings. What unfolds is a deeply personal journey of love, identity, and the things we leave unsaid.

Miriam is an orphan afflicted by an alchemist's curse, which is slowly turning her skin into crystal. To stop the curse, Miriam must explore a demon-filled castle and locate its summoner, Gebel, who has suffered from the curse for a long time.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Chaos Theory

hints.plot: As global tensions rise and cyber warfare threatens world stability, an elite operative is sent deep behind enemy lines to stop a cascading international crisis. Armed with cutting-edge tech and unmatched stealth skills, he uncovers a conspiracy that could spark open war. In the shadows, every silent move and split-second choice could mean the difference between peace and chaos.

In the underground world of street fighting, a rising brawler gets caught in a brutal turf war between hip-hop legends and ruthless crime bosses. As respect, loyalty, and control are fought for in gritty back-alley arenas, every punch brings the fighter closer to dominance—or downfall. Style, strength, and swagger determine who rules the streets.

After waking up in an abandoned underwater facility, a man searches for answers amid flickering lights, malfunctioning machines, and eerie silence. As he uncovers the truth about a failed experiment and humanity’s last remnants, he’s forced to question what it means to be alive. In the depths of isolation, identity, and consciousness collide in a chilling descent into existential horror.

After waking up in an abandoned underwater facility, a man searches for answers amid flickering lights, malfunctioning machines, and eerie silence. As he uncovers the truth about a failed experiment and humanity’s last remnants, he’s forced to question what it means to be alive. In the depths of isolation, identity, and consciousness collide in a chilling descent into existential horror.

In a war-torn sky where borders blur and loyalties shift, an ace pilot becomes a key player in a high-stakes conflict between rival nations. As cutting-edge aircraft clash at supersonic speeds, the pilot uncovers conspiracies and confronts the cost of war from above. Every mission tests skill, resolve, and the fine line between hero and weapon.

In a near-future world ravaged by climate disasters and collapsing nations, stateless soldiers known as No-Pats fight for survival and influence. As global superpowers clash over dwindling resources, massive battles erupt across dynamic, ever-changing environments. With advanced technology and shifting alliances, warfare becomes unpredictable—and victory is anything but guaranteed.

In a near-future world ravaged by climate disasters and collapsing nations, stateless soldiers known as No-Pats fight for survival and influence. As global superpowers clash over dwindling resources, massive battles erupt across dynamic, ever-changing environments. With advanced technology and shifting alliances, warfare becomes unpredictable—and victory is anything but guaranteed.

After awakening on a mysterious planet at the edge of the galaxy, an explorer begins a vast journey across countless worlds, each procedurally generated and filled with alien life, resources, and secrets. With a damaged ship and fading memories, they uncover ancient technologies and cosmic mysteries tied to a distant, enigmatic force. The universe is boundless, and the path forward is shaped by curiosity, survival, and the will to discover.

A TV crew investigating a cursed Japanese village becomes trapped in a nightmarish cycle of time, haunted by undead villagers and a dark ritual. As reality fractures, the characters must survive shifting timelines and uncover the village’s grim secrets. Only by understanding the curse—and each other—can they hope to escape the horror that binds them.

The evil Gnasty Gnorc has turned all the dragons in the Dragon Lands into crystal. He has also stolen the dragons' gems by locking them up in chests or turning them into soldiers for his army. But he forgot about one little dragon: Spyro. Now Spyro has to travel through the dragon kingdom and free all the dragons from their crystal prison, recover the dragons' gems and defeat Gnasty Gnorc.

In a world where certain fighters can transform into powerful beast forms, a new tournament draws warriors with dark pasts and hidden agendas. As alliances form and rivalries ignite, each combatant battles not only for victory but for answers about a shadowy organization manipulating them. Beneath the clash of claws and fists lies a deeper struggle for identity, freedom, and survival.

A lost cat navigates a decaying cybercity inhabited by robots, machines, and hidden dangers, searching for a way back to the surface. Alongside a small drone companion, it uncovers secrets buried beneath neon-lit alleys and forgotten technology. In a world without humans, survival depends on curiosity, agility, and uncovering the truth behind what was left behind.

A hardened mercenary takes on covert missions around the globe to stop a dangerous terrorist organization from unleashing weapons of mass destruction. With brutal realism and a wide arsenal, he infiltrates enemy strongholds and eliminates threats with precision. Every mission is a deadly race against time, where success means preventing global catastrophe.

In a world devastated by an alien invasion, a former soldier embarks on a desperate journey across a ruined America to deliver a weapon that could end the war. Haunted by loss and burdened with responsibility, he battles the monstrous Chimera and the crumbling remnants of humanity. As the odds grow darker, his mission becomes the last hope for human survival.

A Vietnam veteran returns home to find his brother murdered by a violent biker gang. Fueled by rage, he sets out on a brutal path of revenge, tearing through anyone who stands in his way. In a world of crime, betrayal, and chaos, his mission becomes a relentless ride for justice—or payback.

Spanning decades of galactic conflict, a soldier from an elite Imperial unit begins to question her allegiance after the fall of the Empire. Her journey weaves through key moments in a vast war, crossing paths with iconic heroes and villains. Whether fighting on the ground, in space, or as legendary characters, every battle helps shape the fate of the galaxy.

Every hundred years, a huge comet flies by in the skies above the Mushroom Kingdom. One year, that comet filled the entire sky, and from it fell a stream of shooting stars. The Toads scooped up the Star Bits and brought them to the castle, where they were reborn as a great Power Star. It was a happy time in the Mushroom Kingdom. Then one night Mario received a letter...

After the death of his father, a young Triad member arrives in a crime-ridden city to deliver a family heirloom and uncover the truth behind the murder. Caught between loyalty, betrayal, and the violent world of organized crime, he climbs the ranks while navigating corrupt cops and rival gangs. In a city that never stops moving, survival means doing whatever it takes.

Set in ancient Japan, the plot revolves around a new main protagonist, Jubei Yagyu, who is on a quest of revenge as he battles a demon army led by Nobunaga Oda, a sinister warlord who eliminated the Yagyu clan. Across his quest, Jubei learns of his oni heritage which grants him powers to slay the demons and meets new allies who also wish to defeat Nobunaga.

In a sprawling city built for skaters, you rise from wipeouts to legend by building a skateboarding empire. With a focus on creativity, precision, and physics-based tricks, every stair set, rail, and ramp becomes a canvas. Whether solo or with a crew, it’s all about style, flow, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible on four wheels.

A young boy named Raz sneaks into a secret training camp for psychic spies, determined to become one himself. As he explores the minds of others—each a strange, imaginative world—he uncovers a sinister plot threatening both the campers and their sanity. With quirky humor and heart, Raz must master his powers to save the day and prove he's meant to be a true Psychonaut.

An immortal man named Kaim has lived for a thousand years, but remembers almost none of it. As a looming magical catastrophe threatens the world, he embarks on a journey to recover his lost memories and stop the destruction. Alongside others burdened by the same curse, he confronts both ancient grief and present danger, discovering the pain and beauty of a life that never ends.

A surreal, interactive experience unfolds as you guide a mysterious creature through a dreamlike world filled with abstract imagery and cryptic events. Blending art, music, and hidden symbolism, it invites you to manipulate time and perspective to uncover its story. It's not about victory or defeat, but interpretation—an exploration of light, shadow, and the unknown.

A master riskbreaker named Ashley Riot is sent to investigate a cult and the mysterious city of Leá Monde, where ancient magic and political intrigue collide. As he delves deeper, memories blur and reality fractures, revealing a haunting past and a web of manipulation. Caught between truth and illusion, Ashley must uncover his role in a conflict that threatens to consume both body and soul.

As an aspiring young thug, your mission in this video game is to perform odd jobs for the mob, picking up points along the way by committing random crimes ranging from auto theft to hit-and-runs to murder.

In a future where humanity's last safe city stands beneath a mysterious celestial being called the Traveler, Guardians rise to defend it from alien threats and ancient darkness. As one of these resurrected warriors, you wield powerful abilities and high-tech weapons to explore distant worlds and reclaim lost knowledge. The fight spans galaxies, where legends are forged in the light—and tested in the shadows.

Humanity is on the brink of extinction as demonic forces consume Earth, and only the Doom Slayer stands in their way. Armed with brutal weapons and unmatched fury, he tears through hellish armies across dimensions to stop the invasion at its source. With ancient secrets and cosmic threats unfolding, his relentless war becomes a battle for the very soul of the universe.

In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by feral, infected creatures, a drifter and former outlaw named Deacon rides through the ruins of society on his motorcycle. Haunted by loss and driven by love, he searches for hope, answers, and a reason to keep going. Along the way, he faces hostile survivors, harsh environments, and the ever-present threat of the horde.

In a high-octane world of street racing, speed alone isn't enough—aggression and wreckage rule the road. Drivers earn rewards by taking out rivals, causing massive crashes, and chaining risky moves at breakneck speeds. Every race is a chaotic, adrenaline-fueled battle for dominance, where style and destruction go hand in hand.

A young woman named Madeline climbs a treacherous mountain, confronting both physical obstacles and her own inner struggles. As she ascends, the journey becomes a metaphor for anxiety, self-doubt, and growth. With each fall and triumph, she learns to accept all parts of herself and find strength in persistence.

A man survives a plane crash and discovers a hidden underwater city built on the ideals of freedom and science, now decaying into chaos. As he explores its eerie halls, he battles mutated inhabitants and uncovers dark secrets behind the city's fall. Guided by a mysterious voice, he must decide who to trust in a world where nothing is as it seems.

In a distant future where humanity has fled to the moon, androids are sent to Earth to fight a war against alien machines that have taken over the planet. As 2B, a combat android, and her allies battle through the ruins, they begin to question their purpose, the nature of their enemies, and what it truly means to be alive. Beneath the conflict lies a haunting cycle of identity, loss, and the search for meaning in a world long abandoned.

Two elite mercenaries, longtime partners trained for tactical teamwork, are drawn into global conflicts orchestrated by corrupt powers. Using coordinated combat, customizable weapons, and synchronized strategies, they take on missions others wouldn’t survive. As betrayal hits close to home, they must rely on trust and firepower to uncover the truth and bring down those who used them.

Two violent criminals, Kane and Lynch, reunite in Shanghai for a weapons deal that quickly spirals into chaos. As they try to survive a city-wide manhunt, their brutal path leaves destruction and betrayal in its wake. With the line between right and wrong long erased, they push forward through bloodshed, desperation, and a bond forged in violence.
The doctors trustfull test apes have escaped and it's up to you to get out there and retrieve all of them.

A U.S. Coast Guard officer boards a drifting Russian whaling ship in stormy waters, only to find the crew either dead or mutated by a horrific parasite. As he searches for survivors and answers, he uncovers a deadly bioweapon experiment gone wrong. Battling the elements and monstrosities aboard the ship, he must escape before the nightmare consumes him too.

In a high-speed, neon-lit racing league, drivers compete using not just skill, but power-ups that turn every race into a chaotic battleground. As challengers rise through the ranks, they unlock faster cars, tougher opponents, and deadly new tools. Victory depends on mastering both speed and strategy in this electrified fight for the finish line.

Trapped in a lawless prison district run by Gotham’s worst criminals, Batman must uncover the secret behind a deadly plot orchestrated by Hugo Strange. As he faces off against iconic foes and navigates shifting alliances, he races against time to stop a sinister plan that threatens his life and the entire city. With danger around every corner, he must rely on his skills, intellect, and moral code to bring justice to the chaos.

A young girl enters a haunted mansion in search of her missing brother, only to find it filled with restless spirits bound by a dark ritual. Armed with the Camera Obscura, she must photograph the ghosts to weaken and banish them. As she uncovers the tragic history behind the curse, she realizes that facing the past is the only way to survive.

A human child falls into an underground world inhabited by monsters, where every encounter can end in battle—or mercy. As they journey through strange and heartfelt places, their choices shape not only their fate but the fate of everyone they meet. In a world where violence isn’t the only path, understanding and kindness may be the key to changing everything.

A young woman named Kat awakens with no memory and discovers she can manipulate gravity with the help of a mysterious cat. Using her newfound powers, she protects a floating city from monstrous creatures and strange gravitational anomalies. As she uncovers hidden truths about her past and the city's fate, Kat must defy gravity itself to save the world around her.

The island of Banoi is a lush, tropical paradise in the South Pacific where its flagship Royal Palms Resort serves as the ultimate getaway for vacationers with money to burn. However, all good things must soon come to an end - and the picturesque resort falls into madness, carnage and chaos after a mysterious and contagious zombie outbreak claims its once peaceful atmosphere. Cut off from the rest of the world, only four individuals who strangely find themselves immune to zombification have the power to protect the remaining survivors from the horrors of the island, to discover what's really going on and find a way to escape before their own fatal ends.

After crash-landing on an alien ocean planet, a lone survivor must explore the vast underwater world to find resources, craft equipment, and uncover the fate of those who came before. As they dive deeper into the depths, they encounter breathtaking beauty—and terrifying dangers. Survival means mastering the ocean’s secrets and facing what lurks in the dark below.

Ancient warriors known as the Tenno awaken from centuries of cryosleep to find a solar system ruled by corrupt factions and hostile forces. Clad in powerful biomechanical suits called Warframes, they embark on missions across planets to fight oppression and uncover their forgotten past. Guided by a mysterious figure, they must master their abilities and survive in a constantly evolving war.

Sam Fisher, a covert operative for a secret government agency, is sent on dangerous missions to prevent global threats. Using stealth, gadgets, and lethal precision, he infiltrates enemy territory, gathers intelligence, and eliminates targets without leaving a trace. In a world of shadows and shifting loyalties, success depends on staying unseen and striking before anyone knows he was there.

A special forces soldier equipped with a high-tech nanosuit is sent to a remote island to investigate a mysterious alien presence and a North Korean military threat. As the situation escalates, he faces not only human enemies but an alien force capable of reshaping the battlefield. With superhuman strength, speed, and stealth, he must adapt to survive and stop an invasion that could engulf the world.

Amid a continent torn by war and ancient rivalries, three alliances clash for control of a powerful throne, while a darker threat looms from beyond. As a soul-shriven hero freed from the clutches of a Daedric Prince, you forge your own path—joining factions, exploring vast lands, and uncovering lost histories. Whether through blades, magic, or diplomacy, your actions shape the fate of Tamriel in an ever-evolving world.

A thief named Zidane kidnaps a princess, only to discover she wanted to escape her royal life all along. Joined by a diverse group of allies, they uncover a plot that threatens their entire world, diving into themes of identity, purpose, and mortality. As destinies intertwine and truths are revealed, they must stand together to confront an ancient force bent on destruction.

A battle-hardened Ultramarine returns to the frontlines as the galaxy faces a new, overwhelming threat from the Tyranids. With relentless enemies swarming entire worlds, he leads a brutal charge through war-torn battlefields, wielding bolter and chainsword with deadly precision. As chaos deepens, he must stand as humanity’s shield against extinction, no matter the cost.

Nariko, a warrior of a doomed clan, wields the legendary ******** ***** to defend her people from a ruthless invading king. The sword grants immense power, but slowly drains the life of its wielder. As her strength fades, Nariko battles overwhelming odds, uncovering her destiny and embracing sacrifice to protect those she loves.

Gabe Logan, an elite agent, is tasked with stopping a deadly bioweapon known as Syphon Filter from falling into the wrong hands. As he uncovers a global conspiracy, he faces rogue agents, terrorists, and corrupt officials. With time running out, he must track the virus, expose the truth, and prevent a catastrophe.

A lone vampire hunter enters the dark halls of a cursed castle to defeat Count Dracula, who has risen to spread terror across the land. Armed with a holy whip and limited tools, he battles through legions of monsters, traps, and the undead. With skill and perseverance, he fights to end the vampire lord’s reign and bring peace to a haunted world.

A boy flees through a bleak, oppressive world filled with shadowy figures and disturbing experiments. As he navigates eerie landscapes and avoids capture, he uncovers a dark facility conducting mind-control and horrific research. With no dialogue or clear guidance, his journey spirals into surreal, haunting revelations—leading to a finale both shocking and mysterious.

Detective Tequila Yuen returns to the streets of Hong Kong after a fellow officer goes missing, only to uncover a war between rival crime syndicates. Caught in a storm of betrayal and violence, he uses his unmatched gunplay and slow-motion acrobatics to take down enemies and get to the truth. As the body count rises, Tequila must fight through chaos to save his family and restore justice.

In a world ravaged by a fungal outbreak that’s turned much of humanity into monsters, a hardened survivor named Joel is tasked with escorting a young girl, Ellie, across a devastated America. What begins as a simple job becomes a harrowing journey of trust, sacrifice, and survival. As they face both the infected and the cruelty of other survivors, their bond grows—and Joel must decide how far he’ll go to protect her.

A boy named Sora is separated from his friends when their world is consumed by darkness. Armed with a magical weapon called the Keyblade, he travels across a variety of worlds inspired by classic tales, battling shadowy creatures and forming alliances with iconic characters. As he searches for his lost friends, he uncovers a deeper conflict between light and darkness that could decide the fate of all worlds.

Two strangers, a young woman seeking answers about her mother and a journalist chasing a mysterious letter, are drawn to the quiet Irish village of Doolin. There, they discover a gateway to the Netherworld, a realm of spirits and myth. Exploring different realms and battling folkloric creatures, they uncover hidden truths about death, memory, and the stories we leave behind.

On a floating city called the Ark, built as a refuge from a flooded world, two factions clash over its future—Security fights to maintain order, while the Resistance seeks freedom from oppression. Players join one side in a fast-paced conflict, using parkour movement and customizable weapons to turn the tide. As the city teeters on the brink of collapse, every choice shapes the struggle for survival and control.

James Sunderland arrives in the fog-covered town of Silent Hill after receiving a letter from his deceased wife, urging him to meet her there. As he searches through the haunted streets and twisted realities, he encounters disturbing figures and other tormented souls. With each step, James is forced to confront his guilt, grief, and the dark truth buried within his own mind.

A stranger arrives on a mysterious island filled with strange machines, abandoned structures, and books that transport them to other worlds. With no guidance, they must explore, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a family torn apart by power and betrayal. Only by understanding the past can they unlock the secrets of the island and decide its fate.

A mysterious man receives cryptic phone calls instructing him to eliminate targets across Miami. Donning animal masks and wielding brutal weapons, he descends into a surreal, hyper-violent world filled with bloodshed and confusion. As the bodies pile up, he begins to question who’s behind the messages—and what’s real in the chaos.

A lone warrior enters the cursed kingdom of Boletaria, now overrun by demons after a forbidden ritual awakens an ancient, soul-devouring entity. Battling through ruined lands and grotesque foes, they seek to gain power by collecting souls and putting an end to the spreading madness. Every step forward is hard-earned, and only those who master patience and perseverance can hope to lift the fog and restore peace.

A death row inmate wakes up to find he’s been spared—only to be forced into a deadly game orchestrated by a sadistic director. Stalked through brutal urban environments, he must use stealth and violence to survive while cameras capture every gruesome act. As the line between survival and cruelty blurs, he realizes escape may cost more than just blood.

As the owner of a budding theme park empire, you design and manage every detail—from twisting coasters and thrilling rides to food stalls and staff schedules. Balancing fun with finances, you must keep guests happy while turning a profit. Success means growing your park into a beloved attraction, while failure leaves it a forgotten fairground.

Take part in the eternal struggle between two extraordinary assassins. Take on the role of Colt as you search for a way to put an end to a timeloop trapping Blackreef while being hunted by the island’s inhabitants. Use powerful weapons and abilities to take out eight key targets across the stunning and chaotic island before the day resets. Lurking in the shadows is rival assassin Julianna whose sole mission is to take Colt out and keep the loop going. Learn from each cycle, try new paths and approaches to break the loop once and for all.

An alien named Crypto-137 arrives on Earth in the 1950s to harvest human DNA and find his missing predecessor. Disguised as a human and armed with advanced weaponry, he wages chaos across towns and military bases, all while mocking human society. As the invasion escalates, Crypto uncovers conspiracies, clashes with government agents, and gets one step closer to total domination.

A lone fisherman arrives in a remote archipelago, taking on jobs to survive while uncovering strange, unsettling truths beneath the waters. As he upgrades his boat and explores deeper, he encounters eerie phenomena, hidden relics, and a growing sense of dread. With each catch and each nightfall, the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur.

In a world where superpowered individuals, called Conduits, are hunted, Delsin Rowe discovers his own abilities after a chance encounter. As he rebels against the oppressive government agency controlling Conduits, he absorbs new powers and must decide whether to be a hero or a villain. His choices shape the fate of Seattle and determine whether he will be its savior or its greatest threat.

A new team of Vault Hunters arrives on the chaotic planet of Pandora to stop the Calypso Twins, cult leaders seeking ultimate power. Traveling across multiple planets, they battle ruthless bandits, alien creatures, and a growing army of fanatics while uncovering the secrets of the Vaults. With an arsenal of outrageous weapons and the fate of the galaxy at stake, they must take down the twins before their power consumes everything.

In Little Italy in 1936, a young Aldo Trapani witnesses his father Johnny, a soldato in the Corleone family, being killed by the rival Barzini family. Don Vito Corleone comforts Aldo, telling him that when he is old enough and the time is right, he will have his revenge. Nine years later, in 1945, Aldo returns from World War II after serving in the U.S. Army. His mother Sarafina visits Vito during his daughter's wedding, telling him that Aldo has fallen in with a disreputable group of young thieves. Vito sends Luca Brasi to find Aldo and recruit him into the family.

In a dystopian future, miners on Mars live under the oppressive rule of the Ultor Corporation, forced to endure harsh conditions and brutal treatment. When a rebellion ignites, a worker named Parker joins the fight, using guerrilla tactics and powerful weapons to take down Ultor’s forces. As the battle escalates, he uncovers hidden secrets beneath the planet’s surface that could change the fate of Mars forever.

In the land of Albion, a young hero sets out on a quest for revenge against a tyrant who destroyed their childhood. As they grow in power, their choices shape their appearance, abilities, and the world around them—whether as a noble savior or a ruthless conqueror. With destiny in their hands, they must gather allies, master combat and magic, and ultimately decide the fate of Albion itself.

When the PlayStation 5 mothership is attacked by Astro’s long-standing galactic nemesis, scrambling its wires and scattering the crew throughout space, only Astro can make things right! Setting off on his biggest mission yet, he needs your help to rescue the stranded crew and rebuild the mothership.

America, 1899. The end of the wild west era has begun as lawmen hunt down the last remaining outlaw gangs. Those who will not surrender or succumb are killed. After a robbery goes badly wrong in the western town of Blackwater, Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are forced to flee. With federal agents and the best bounty hunters in the nation massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal and fight their way across the rugged heartland of America in order to survive. As deepening internal divisions threaten to tear the gang apart, Arthur must make a choice between his own ideals and loyalty to the gang who raised him.

Mario embarks on a globe-trotting adventure to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser’s wedding plans. With the help of Cappy, a living hat that grants him the ability to possess objects and enemies, he travels across diverse kingdoms to collect Power Moons and stop the ceremony. Along the way, he discovers hidden secrets, faces off against Bowser’s minions, and ultimately challenges his greatest rival in a battle across the stars.

Treasure hunter Nathan Drake is drawn into a dangerous quest for the legendary Cintamani Stone after uncovering a clue left by Marco Polo. His journey takes him across the globe, from war-torn cities to the icy peaks of the Himalayas, as he battles ruthless mercenaries and uncovers ancient secrets. With betrayal around every corner, Drake must rely on his wits, allies, and sheer determination to survive and claim the ultimate prize.

Booker DeWitt, a former Pinkerton agent, is sent to the floating city of Columbia to retrieve a mysterious girl named Elizabeth. As he navigates the city’s utopian facade, he uncovers dark secrets, violent civil unrest, and the truth about his own past. With reality-bending powers, he and Elizabeth must escape Columbia while unraveling a story of fate, redemption, and infinite possibilities.

A powerful witch named ********* awakens from a centuries-long slumber with no memory of her past. Battling angelic forces and uncovering hidden truths, she embarks on a journey to piece together her lost history and the fate of her kind. With time running out, she must embrace her full power to stop an ancient conspiracy that threatens the balance of the universe.

Jak is thrust into a dystopian city ruled by a tyrannical baron after being experimented on and infused with dark powers. With the help of his loyal friend Daxter and a growing rebellion, he fights to overthrow the oppressive regime while struggling to control his newfound abilities. As he uncovers secrets about his past and the city’s future, Jak must embrace his destiny to bring down the corrupt forces that seek to control him.

After awakening in a decaying research facility, Chell is forced to navigate deadly test chambers once again, guided by the malfunctioning AI, GLaDOS. With the help of Wheatley, a quirky robot, she attempts to escape, only to uncover deeper secrets about the facility’s past. As betrayals and power struggles unfold, Chell must outwit her foes and find a way to break free from the endless cycle of testing.

In a world shattered by a mysterious calamity, a young warrior known as the Kid navigates floating ruins to restore what was lost. Guided by the voice of a lone narrator, he battles strange creatures, uncovers the truth behind the disaster, and rebuilds the Bastion, a refuge with the power to reshape the world. In the end, he must choose between rewriting history or moving forward with what remains.

Harry Mason searches for his missing daughter after a car crash leaves him stranded in the eerie town of Silent Hill. As he navigates its fog-covered streets and nightmarish otherworld, he encounters disturbing creatures and unraveling mysteries tied to a dark cult. With reality shifting around him, Harry must uncover the truth behind the town’s horrors and find his daughter before it’s too late.

A highly skilled agent pilots the advanced Interceptor, a high-tech vehicle armed for combat, to stop a global terrorist organization. Racing through dangerous terrain, he battles enemy forces, uncovers a sinister conspiracy, and prevents a world-threatening catastrophe. With speed, firepower, and espionage, he must outmaneuver his enemies and complete his mission before it’s too late.

Aiden Pearce, a skilled hacker seeking revenge for a family tragedy, uses Chicago’s citywide surveillance system as his weapon. Manipulating traffic lights, security cameras, and personal data, he hunts those responsible while navigating a world of crime and corruption. As his quest for justice blurs the line between hero and vigilante, he must decide how far he’s willing to go to protect those he loves.

A cursed undead warrior arrives in the fallen kingdom of Drangleic, seeking a cure for their affliction. As they battle through ruined lands filled with lost souls, ancient kings, and monstrous foes, they uncover the cycle of light and dark that has doomed countless others before them. In the end, they must choose whether to embrace the inevitable fate of all kingdoms or attempt to break the cycle at a great cost.

A seemingly lighthearted school club turns into a psychological horror experience as a new member bonds with four unique girls. As the story progresses, reality begins to unravel, revealing disturbing secrets and breaking the fourth wall. What starts as a simple romance quickly spirals into a nightmarish journey of manipulation, obsession, and existential dread.

A man named Tim embarks on a journey through surreal, time-bending worlds to rescue a kidnapped princess. As he manipulates time to solve puzzles, he uncovers fragments of his past and the deeper meaning behind his quest. In the end, perception is challenged, revealing a story not of heroism, but of obsession and regret.

In the aftermath of nuclear war, humanity clings to survival in the tunnels of the Moscow Metro, where mutants and rival factions threaten their existence. Artyom, a young survivor, is sent on a dangerous journey to warn others of an impending threat. Battling both the horrors of the surface and the darkness within, he must navigate the ruins of civilization and decide the fate of the last remnants of mankind.

Set in the ninja-inspired land of Kamura Village, explore lush ecosystems and battle fearsome monsters to become the ultimate hunter. It’s been half a century since the last calamity struck, but a terrifying new monster has reared its head and threatens to plunge the land into chaos once again.

A small guardian spirit, Ori, is separated from their home after a great calamity drains the forest of its life. To restore balance, Ori embarks on a perilous journey, overcoming dangerous creatures and treacherous landscapes while uncovering the forest’s tragic past. With the help of newfound abilities and allies, they must rekindle the light and save their dying world.

When the UNSC can't track down their most valued asset (Spartan 117: The Master Chief), they send a highly trained ONI soldier (Agent Locke) to bring him back. Master Chief is in search for something very important and will allow nothing to stand in his way, while Agent Locke has vowed to uphold justice and hunt for the truth. As these two titans fight their way through Forerunner and Covenant forces, the fate of the universe hangs in the balance yet again.

A fearless adventurer descends into a vast, ever-changing underground filled with deadly traps, hostile creatures, and hidden treasures. With each run, they must navigate procedurally generated caves, uncover secrets, and adapt to unexpected dangers. Every decision counts, as death is permanent, and only skill, strategy, and a bit of luck will lead to survival and fortune.

title: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty

hints.plot: A special forces operative infiltrates a hijacked tanker to uncover a secret military project, only for the mission to take an unexpected turn. Years later, a new operative, Raiden, is sent to a massive offshore facility seized by terrorists threatening global catastrophe. As he unravels a web of deception, shadowy organizations, and hidden agendas, he must question who he can trust and what is real in a world of misinformation.

Colton White, a gunslinger seeking vengeance, uncovers a deadly conspiracy tied to his past in the untamed American West. As he hunts down those responsible, he becomes entangled in a battle over lost treasure, corruption, and survival. Facing outlaws, soldiers, and lawless frontier towns, he must fight to uncover the truth and carve out his own destiny.

Manny Calavera, a travel agent in the Land of the Dead, uncovers a corruption scheme that preys on lost souls. Determined to set things right, he embarks on a four-year journey through a noir-inspired underworld, facing gangsters, conspiracies, and supernatural dangers. With wit, charm, and a bit of luck, he must solve the mystery and help a deserving soul reach their final rest.

A young noble is thrust into a rebellion after discovering the corruption of the empire he once served. Gathering the 108 Stars of Destiny, he builds an army, forging alliances and leading battles to overthrow tyranny. As war rages, he must confront betrayal, uncover ancient mysteries, and determine the fate of the land.

A group of friends reunites at a remote mountain lodge, only to find themselves stalked by a deadly presence. As tensions rise and secrets unravel, their choices determine who survives the terrifying night. With danger lurking in every shadow, they must navigate fear, betrayal, and the unknown—where every decision could be their last.

In a whimsical, handcrafted world, a small, customizable hero embarks on a creative adventure filled with puzzles, platforming, and imagination. Along the way, they explore vibrant levels, overcome quirky challenges, and unlock new tools to shape their own unique worlds. With endless possibilities for creativity and collaboration, the journey is as much about making as it is about playing.

After taking the fall for a crime he didn’t commit, Kazuma Kiryu spends ten years in prison, only to return to a changed Kamurocho. His former allies have turned against him, his childhood friend has vanished, and a mysterious girl holds the key to a missing fortune. As betrayal and violence erupt around him, Kiryu must fight to uncover the truth and reclaim his honor in the yakuza underworld.

A single petal drifts on the wind, guided by the player through lush landscapes, bringing life and color to the world. As it soars across open fields and decaying cities, the journey unfolds as a peaceful yet emotional exploration of nature’s beauty and resilience. With no words or danger, the experience is one of discovery, transformation, and serenity.

A firefighter, sent to respond to a distress call at a high-tech research facility, discovers a nightmare beyond comprehension. The site is overrun with grotesque creatures and twisted experiments, the result of a secretive AI-driven project gone horribly wrong. As reality bends and horrors intensify, he must fight to survive, uncover the truth, and escape before the madness consumes him.

A rookie defense attorney, ******* ******, takes on seemingly impossible cases to prove his clients’ innocence. Armed with sharp wit, bold objections, and a keen eye for contradictions, he uncovers hidden truths in the courtroom. As he faces eccentric witnesses and ruthless prosecutors, he must unravel complex mysteries and fight for justice against all odds.

A young boy with horns is imprisoned in an ancient castle, condemned by his own people. There, he meets a mysterious girl, Yorda, who is pursued by shadowy forces. Together, they must navigate the castle’s puzzles and dangers, forging a silent bond as they seek freedom before darkness consumes them both.

In a dark, twisted city overrun by rogue puppets, a mysterious humanoid puppet awakens with a singular goal: to find his creator, Geppetto. As he battles monstrous automatons and uncovers a web of secrets, he must navigate a world filled with deception, choosing whether to embrace lies or the painful truth. With each choice shaping his fate, he fights to uncover his origins and determine what it means to be human.

A man awakens in a mysterious research facility with no memory of his past, only to discover he has powerful psychic abilities. As he escapes and pieces together his identity, he uncovers a conspiracy involving covert military experiments and a deadly mission gone wrong. With both enemies and his own past closing in, he must use his newfound powers to uncover the truth before it's too late.

A city is gripped by fear as the Origami Killer, a mysterious serial murderer, kidnaps another victim. Four strangers—a grieving father, a private detective, a journalist, and an FBI agent—become entangled in the case, each racing against time to uncover the truth.
