Their choices and actions shape the outcome, leading to multiple possible fates in this tense psychological thriller.

On his 21st birthday, mafia hit man Jackie Estacado is possessed by an ancient demonic force called *** ********. This further complicates his relationships with his mafia family, a corrupt police department and his childhood love Jenny.

A lone warrior arrives on a cursed island shrouded in darkness, seeking a legendary artifact that may restore peace. As they explore its labyrinthine depths, they face relentless monsters, deadly traps, and cryptic lore left by a lost civilization. With no guidance but their own determination, they must uncover the island’s secrets and survive its horrors to fulfill their quest.

A U.S. soldier investigating a Soviet island discovers a hidden experiment that has fractured time itself. Armed with a device that manipulates time, he battles mutated creatures and Soviet forces while uncovering a conspiracy that altered history. To prevent a catastrophic future, he must navigate shifting timelines and make a choice that will decide the fate of the world.

A mysterious outlander arrives on the island of Vvardenfell, unaware they are part of an ancient prophecy tied to the fate of *********. As they navigate political intrigue, warring factions, and a land plagued by disease and corruption, they uncover their true role in the struggle against a powerful, god-like enemy. With limitless choices shaping their journey, they must decide whether to embrace their destiny or forge their own path.

On a planet ravaged by war, hardened soldier Marcus Fenix is freed from prison to help humanity’s last stand against the monstrous Locust Horde. Leading a squad of elite soldiers, he battles through devastated cities and underground lairs to stop the relentless enemy. With the fate of mankind hanging by a thread, Marcus must uncover the Locust’s secrets and fight to prevent total annihilation.

Amaterasu, the sun goddess in the form of a white wolf, awakens to restore life and beauty to a world consumed by darkness. Armed with celestial brush techniques, she battles demons, solves puzzles, and aids those in need to break an ancient curse. As she journeys across the land, she must reclaim her lost power and defeat the evil threatening to plunge the world into eternal night.

An egotistical space alien by the name of Nitros Oxide comes to Earth and challenges Crash Bandicoot, his friends and foes to a racing competition before facing himself, threatening to turn the world into a concrete parking lot if he wins.

During the era of space exploration, a faction of humans colonized the planet Helghan. In order to survive in the harsh environment, these people mutated to the point of no longer remaining human. They developed a passionate hatred for mankind, and eventually formed the Helghast Empire, attacking the planet Vekta controlled by the Interplanetary Strategic Alliance (ISA). As Helghast soldiers invade the planet's perimeter, the ISA forces are trying to hold the ground and find a way to stop them.

As the head of a budding film studio, players build their empire from the silent era to the modern age of cinema. Managing actors, directors, and production crews, they must balance creativity with business to produce blockbuster hits while dealing with scandals and rival studios. Only those who master the art of filmmaking and studio management can create a lasting Hollywood legacy.

In a world divided between augmented humans and natural ones, Adam Jensen, a cybernetically enhanced agent, works to uncover a global conspiracy. Navigating a tense society on the brink of collapse, he infiltrates shadowy organizations, makes morally complex choices, and unearths the truth behind rising oppression and hidden manipulators. With his advanced abilities and tactical expertise, he must decide who to trust and how far he’s willing to go to change the future.

A young witch or wizard enters Hogwarts in the 1800s, discovering they possess a rare ability to harness ancient magic. As they navigate their studies, forge friendships, and duel dark forces, they uncover a hidden threat that could change the wizarding world forever. With danger lurking in the shadows, they must master their powers and decide the fate of this long-buried secret.

In a war-torn future controlled by powerful corporations, a mercenary pilot, known as a Raven, takes on high-risk missions using a customizable mech. As they navigate a web of corporate rivalries and hidden agendas, they uncover a deeper conflict threatening to destabilize the world. With each battle, the Raven must decide where their loyalty lies and whether they are merely a pawn or a force of change.

Henry Townshend finds himself trapped in his apartment, with no way out except a mysterious hole in his bathroom wall. Venturing into disturbing otherworldly realms, he uncovers a dark connection to a serial killer’s ritualistic murders. As the haunting presence grows stronger, Henry must unravel the mystery before his home—and his sanity—become his tomb.

Luigi and his friends check into a luxurious hotel, only to be trapped by ghosts in a sinister plot. Armed with his trusty Poltergust, Luigi must explore the haunted floors, solve puzzles, and battle mischievous spirits to rescue his friends. With each eerie encounter, he uncovers the hotel’s secrets and faces a final showdown with its ghostly mastermind.

A special forces team is sent to a mysterious facility after an entire city vanishes, only to find themselves trapped in a world overrun by deadly dinosaurs. As they search for survivors and a way back home, they uncover a secret experiment that led to the catastrophe. Racing against time, they must battle prehistoric threats and unravel the truth before they become extinct themselves.
In the year 1986, Tommy Vercetti is heavily indebted to his mafia superiors after a drug deal gone awry, but his dreams of taking over Vice City push him down a different path.

When their friend is kidnapped by a ruthless crime syndicate, a group of street fighters takes to the city to bring justice. Battling through gangs, corrupt officials, and powerful enforcers, they fight to dismantle the syndicate and rescue their ally. With fists, weapons, and teamwork, they wage war against crime to reclaim their city from the grip of chaos.

Sean Devlin, an Irish race car driver turned resistance fighter, seeks revenge against the Nazis occupying France. Using stealth, sabotage, and guerilla warfare, he dismantles enemy operations while aiding the French Resistance. As he strikes back against his enemies, he fights not just for personal vengeance but for the liberation of Paris itself.

Kratos, a ruthless Spartan warrior, is haunted by his past and seeks vengeance against Ares, the god who betrayed him. Guided by the gods of Olympus, he embarks on a perilous journey to find Pandora’s Box, the only weapon capable of killing a god. Battling mythical beasts and deadly foes, Kratos must confront his own darkness to claim his revenge and break free from his torment.

Henry, a blacksmith's son, is thrust into the chaos of a civil war after his village is destroyed by invading forces. Seeking revenge and a purpose, he trains in swordplay, diplomacy, and survival, navigating the harsh realities of medieval life. As he becomes entangled in noble conflicts and political intrigue, Henry must choose his path—whether as a warrior, a rogue, or a statesman—to shape the fate of the kingdom.

A traveler explores a mysterious solar system trapped in a time loop, uncovering the secrets of an ancient civilization. As the sun nears its final moments, they piece together clues hidden across distant planets to understand the cycle and their place in it. With each reset, they dive deeper into the mystery, racing against time to find the truth before everything resets once more.

A lone marine is sent through a mysterious portal to stop an ancient, malevolent entity threatening humanity. Battling through gothic dimensions filled with nightmarish creatures, he must locate runes of power to reach the heart of the evil. Armed with an arsenal of devastating weapons, he fights to survive and prevent the destruction of his world.

Wei Shen, an undercover cop, infiltrates the Hong Kong Triads to take down a powerful crime syndicate from within. As he rises through the ranks, he struggles to balance his duty as a cop with his loyalty to his newfound brothers in the gang. Caught between two worlds, Wei must navigate brutal combat, high-speed chases, and dangerous betrayals to complete his mission without losing himself.

In a medieval land torn by war, a noble lord must build and defend a thriving kingdom against rival factions. Balancing resource management, castle construction, and military strategy, they must withstand brutal sieges and expand their territory. Only through careful planning and tactical warfare can they unite the land and secure their legacy.

Investigative journalist Miles Upshur breaks into a remote psychiatric asylum after receiving a mysterious tip. Inside, he discovers horrifying experiments, bloodthirsty patients, and a supernatural force lurking in the shadows. Trapped and unarmed, Miles must uncover the asylum’s dark secrets while evading the monstrosities that hunt him.

A group of four survivors fights to escape a deadly zombie outbreak sweeping across the southern United States. Traveling through infested cities, swamps, and highways, they must work together to battle hordes of infected and powerful mutated creatures. With limited supplies and no safe haven, their only hope is to reach the next evacuation point—if they can survive long enough.

Across different eras of history, leaders rise to build mighty civilizations, expand their empires, and wage strategic wars. Players gather resources, advance through technological ages, and command armies in epic battles to dominate rivals. Through careful planning and tactical prowess, they shape the course of history and forge legendary empires.

Fox McCloud and his team of ace pilots are called to defend the Lylat System from the forces of Andross, a rogue scientist threatening galactic peace. Commanding the Arwing spacecraft, Fox leads daring missions across diverse planets, engaging in epic battles against Andross’s armies. With the fate of the galaxy at stake, Fox must confront his father’s legacy and face Andross in a final showdown.

Fox McCloud and his team of ace pilots are called to defend the Lylat System from the forces of Andross, a rogue scientist threatening galactic peace. Commanding the Arwing spacecraft, Fox leads daring missions across diverse planets, engaging in epic battles against Andross’s armies. With the fate of the galaxy at stake, Fox must confront his father’s legacy and face Andross in a final showdown.

Dante, a young demon hunter, is drawn into a deadly confrontation when his estranged twin brother, Vergil, opens a portal to the demon world. As the brothers clash over their conflicting ideals, Dante battles hordes of demons and powerful foes while discovering his own demonic heritage. In the end, he must embrace his true strength to stop Vergil’s plans and prevent the destruction of the human world.

John Tanner, a detective with a gift for high-speed driving, falls into a coma after a dangerous confrontation with a criminal mastermind, Jericho. While unconscious, Tanner finds himself in a surreal version of San Francisco where he can possess other drivers to stop Jericho’s schemes. Racing against time and reality, Tanner must use his unique ability to prevent a catastrophic plot and uncover the truth behind his condition.

Daniel awakens in a dark, foreboding castle with no memory of his past, guided only by a letter he wrote to himself. As he explores, he uncovers horrifying secrets about his actions and the ancient evil lurking within. Haunted by terrifying creatures and his own guilt, Daniel must solve puzzles and piece together his fragmented memories to survive the descent into madness.

A hacker awakens on a space station overtaken by SHODAN, a rogue AI that has turned the crew into cyborgs and mutants. As SHODAN plots to dominate Earth, the hacker must navigate the station’s dangers, solve intricate puzzles, and upgrade their abilities. The fate of humanity rests on their ability to outwit and destroy the malevolent AI.

title: Dark Messiah of Might and Magic

hints.plot: Sareth, a young apprentice trained in magic and combat, is sent to recover a powerful artifact known as the Skull of Shadows. As he delves into a world of betrayal, warring factions, and dark prophecy, he discovers his true destiny and the demonic influence tied to his bloodline. With choices that shape his fate, Sareth must decide whether to embrace heroism or succumb to darkness.

Ethan Thomas, a forensic investigator, is framed for murder while pursuing a serial killer in a decaying city. As he hunts for the truth, Ethan uncovers a sinister force driving people to madness and violence. Armed with improvised weapons and his instincts, he must survive brutal encounters and confront his own unraveling sanity to expose the dark conspiracy behind the chaos.

Corvo Attano, the bodyguard of an Empress, is framed for her murder and the kidnapping of her daughter. Stripped of his honor and imprisoned, he escapes with the help of a mysterious group and gains supernatural powers from a godlike entity called the Outsider. Armed with these abilities and a thirst for justice, Corvo must navigate a plague-ridden city, confront corrupt officials, and uncover the conspiracy that betrayed him—all while deciding whether to take a path of vengeance or mercy.

A lone Hunter arrives in the ancient city of Yharnam, seeking a cure for a mysterious ailment. The city is gripped by a nightmarish plague that transforms its inhabitants into monstrous beasts. Armed with trick weapons and guided by cryptic whispers, the Hunter must unravel Yharnam’s eldritch secrets, face grotesque horrors, and confront the truth about the cosmic forces behind the city's descent into madness.

Marius Titus, a Roman soldier, witnesses the brutal murder of his family and embarks on a journey of vengeance. Rising through the ranks of the Roman army, he fights in epic battles and uncovers a conspiracy threatening Rome itself. Guided by visions from the gods, Marius must balance his quest for justice with loyalty to his empire, ultimately facing his destiny in a climactic confrontation that blurs the line between hero and legend.

Samus Aran is sent to investigate a distress signal on a mysterious planet divided into two realms: light and dark. She discovers a dying alien species, the Luminoth, battling their dark counterparts, the Ing, who threaten to consume the planet entirely. Armed with advanced technology and her signature Power Suit, Samus must navigate the treacherous dual worlds, recover stolen energy, and confront a dark version of herself to save the planet and escape alive.

A mysterious traveler arrives in a remote village searching for their missing child. The village, shrouded in mist, is controlled by a powerful matriarch and her monstrous followers. As the traveler unravels dark secrets, they must confront terrifying creatures, uncover the truth about their child, and survive a harrowing battle for their own humanity.

During the Human/Skaarj war, the New Earth Government was formed. Mining was the primary method of financing the war, though was unpopular with the working class, who grew weary of the working conditions and the war. The humans were losing the war, and riots broke out. The Terran system was surrounded by Skaarj forces, but a government team destroyed their mothership, and the Skaarj withdrew. Afterward, mining incidents were on the increase, and efforts to deal with them were unsuccessful. The government then came up with the idea of giving the violence an outlet instead. "Consensual murder" was legalized in the year 2291, enabling people to fight to the death under organized conditions. Mining conglomerates worked with the government and organized leagues, which proved successful. One such company, the Liandri Mining Corporation, capitalized on the fights by tri-casting them; this proved to be more popular than the combat itself, their popularity increasing with brutality. By 2341, what is now called the "Tournament" became a professional sport more profitable than mining. Liandri Mining Corporation annually hosts the "Grand Tournament", the most popular event in the sport

Lo Wang is a bodyguard for Zilla Enterprises, which has control over every major industry in Japan. However, this has led to corruption. Master Zilla, the president of the Zilla Enterprise, is planning to conquer Japan using creatures from the "dark side". When he discovers this, Lo Wang quit his job as a bodyguard. Master Zilla realizes the threat that Lo Wang poses and sends his creatures to battle him
For Super Earth!

Set in the neon-lit streets of 1980s Japan, you step into the shoes of two hardened criminals navigating the dangerous world of organized crime. As tensions rise and loyalties are tested, you'll fight, brawl, and hustle your way through a city teeming with life, uncovering dark secrets and forging unexpected alliances. Balancing intense action with moments of heartfelt drama, this journey explores the complexities of honor, power, and survival in a world where every choice can have life-altering consequences.

In ******, the player controls one of two armed military commandos named Bill "Mad Dog" Rizer and Lance "Scorpion" Bean, who are sent on a mission to neutralize a terrorist group called the Red Falcon Organization that is planning to take over the Earth. Details of the game's setting varies between supplementary materials: the Japanese versions sets the game in the year 2633 on the fictional "Galuga archipelago" near New Zealand, whereas the manual for the American NES version sets the game during the present in an unnamed South American island. The American storyline also changes the identity of "Red Falcon" from being the name of a terrorist organization to the name of an alien entity.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, you emerge from an underground vault to a world ravaged by nuclear war. As you search for your missing father, you navigate through the ruins of civilization, making choices that shape your destiny and the fate of those around you. Survival requires cunning, resourcefulness, and the ability to decide between right and wrong in a world where the lines are blurred.

Stranded in a mysterious and unforgiving wilderness, you must gather resources, craft tools, and fend off strange creatures to survive. Every day is a fight against hunger, insanity, and the elements as you struggle to maintain your fragile grip on life. The world is as dark and eerie as it is unpredictable, where one wrong move could mean your demise. How long can you last before the wilderness claims you?

Set in the fictional Kingdom of Khanduras, located in the world of Sanctuary, ****** has the player take control of a lone hero battling to rid the world of ******, the Lord of Terror. Beneath the town of Tristram, the player journeys through sixteen dungeon levels, ultimately entering Hell itself in order to face ******.

In a sprawling, chaotic city turned prison, you step into the role of a legendary vigilante. Armed with cutting-edge gadgets and unmatched combat skills, you navigate dark alleys and towering rooftops, facing off against notorious criminals and uncovering a sinister conspiracy. Every corner of this open world teems with danger and mystery, demanding both stealth and strength as you fight to restore order.
Paris, 1789. You play as Arno Victor-Dorian, an assassin during the French Revolution. As the nation tears itself apart, Arno will expose the true powers behind the Revolution.

Step into the role of a city planner, where every decision shapes the growth of a bustling metropolis. Design neighborhoods, manage resources, and balance the needs of citizens as your urban creation evolves from a small town to a sprawling city. Handle challenges like traffic, pollution, and disasters while keeping the economy thriving and residents happy. The power to build and govern a vibrant city is in your hands.

The plot is set about 20 years after the events of the previous game where the ending revealed that Shinnok used the void after Shao Kahn's death to attack Earthrealm with his army of Netherrealm forces. Several characters work together to steal Shinnok's amulet and imprison him inside, but eventually Mileena hatches a plan to release Shinnok by bringing the amulet to Quan Chi who escaped when Shinnok was imprisoned. The gap in years is mainly used to introduce the new characters to the cast, such as Cassie, the daughter of Johnny Cage and Sonya Blade (who married and divorced), Kotal Kahn as the new emperor of the Outworld, and Takeda, the son of Kenshi.

Step into a world where the deck you build determines your fate as you navigate through a series of darkly comedic, yet perilous challenges. In this roguelike adventure, every decision matterswhether it's choosing the right cards, balancing risk and reward, or outwitting bizarre enemies. The setting is a surreal, ever-changing landscape filled with unexpected twists, where your strategic choices can lead to victory or hilarious disaster. With its unique blend of humor, strategy, and unpredictability, this journey offers a fresh and engaging take on the deck-building genre.

title: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch

hints.plot: A heart-warming tale of a young boy named Oliver, who embarks on a journey into a parallel world in an attempt to bring his mother back from the dead. Along the way, Oliver makes new friends and adopts many of the wonderful creatures that inhabit the world, raising them to battle other creatures on his behalf as he takes on formidable enemies.

The player character starts out in Pallet Town. When the player character tries to leave the town without a ******* of their own, they are stopped in the nick of time by Professor Oak, who invites them to his lab. There, he gives them a *******of their own and a Pokdex, telling them about his dream to make a complete guide on every ******* in the world. After the player character battles their rival and leaves the lab, they are entitled to win every Gym Badge, compete in the ******* League, and fulfill Oak's dream by catching every Pokmon.

Take on jobs and compete in races to prove yourself as you infiltrate and take down an international crime syndicate. As you win each race, youll go deeper into the underworld web that rules Tri-City and then tear it apart right under their noses. You make the calls, but dont break your cover: inside the car or out of it, one mistake here could be your last

Dig, Fight, Explore, Build: The very world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, fortune, and glory. Will you delve deep into cavernous expanses in search of treasure and raw materials with which to craft ever-evolving gear, machinery, and aesthetics? Perhaps you will choose instead to seek out ever-greater foes to test your mettle in combat? Maybe you will decide to construct your own city to house the host of mysterious allies you may encounter along your travels? In the World of *******, the choice is yours!

A first-person exploration game which ponders questions related to player agency, narrative pacing, escapism through gaming, objective-driven game design, authorial intent, and the conflict of interest between players and game creators.

400 years have passed since the vampire Kain damned the world in the original ***** ****, choosing to rule the world in damnation rather than die for its salvation. Now Kain, who once controlled the land of Nosgoth with his vampire armies, finds his brethren slain and his dark powers stripped by a mysterious figure. To reclaim his rule and exact his vengeance, Kain must dispatch armies of zealot soldiers and overcome legions of demons in order to uncover the ominous plot that threatens the land he seeks to conquer.

The Joker has hoaxed Superman into killing Lois Lane and the couple's unborn son, all the while destroying Metropolis. Overcome with grief and anger, Superman takes revenge against the Joker; killing him in cold blood in front of Batman. While he has confronted his tormentor, Superman still cannot overcome the guilt of what the Joker made him do. Quickly, he takes control of various nations across the planet and establishes a new world order as the High Councillor to achieve world "peace". The heroes of the earth are confronted with a choice; join Superman's Regime or ally with Batman's Insurgency. A war ensues between the forces, one which will threaten the very survival of mankind.

Step into the shoes of legendary skateboarders as you shred through iconic urban environments, performing gravity-defying tricks and combos. With tight controls and a killer soundtrack, this experience lets you master everything from basic ollies to complex flip tricks, all while navigating ramps, rails, and half-pipes. Whether you're aiming for high scores or exploring each level to uncover hidden secrets, the action is fast, fluid, and endlessly addictive. Take on challenges, unlock new gear, and perfect your style in a skateboarding experience that sets the standard for the genre.

In this turn-based strategy classic, you command a team of quirky, heavily-armed invertebrates in a battle of wits, precision, and firepower. Each round offers a chaotic mix of explosive weapons, ranging from bazookas to sheep bombs, as you try to outmaneuver and outshoot your opponents across destructible landscapes. The objective is simple: eliminate the enemy team by any means necessary, but the path to victory is filled with unexpected twists and comic mishaps. With its blend of tactical depth and humorous action, this game invites players to engage in endless battles with friends or against the AI, making every match a unique and unpredictable experience.

Set in the world of Thedas, players assume the role of Hawke, a human mage, rogue or warrior who arrives in the city of Kirkwall as a lowly refugee and becomes its legendary champion over a turbulent decade of political and social conflict.

In a vast, hauntingly beautiful world deep beneath the earth, you assume the role of a small but determined warrior exploring ancient, forgotten kingdoms. Armed with a simple yet powerful blade, you traverse treacherous landscapes, confront mysterious creatures, and unravel secrets hidden in the shadows. As you journey through this intricate maze of caverns, the atmosphere shifts from eerie silence to intense combat, demanding both skill and strategy. The story unfolds in fragments, inviting you to piece together the history of a fallen civilization and uncover the truth behind your own quest.

In this third-person action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord, and thanks to your bold yet questionable leadership, you have persuaded an oddball crew of unlikely heroes to join you. Some jerk (surely not you) has set off a chain of catastrophic events, and only you can hold the unpredictable Guardians together long enough to fight off total interplanetary meltdown.

Break the cycle of chaos on an always-changing alien planet where even death is no escape. After crash-landing on this shape-shifting world, Selene must search through the barren landscape of an ancient civilization for her escape. Isolated and alone, she finds herself fighting tooth and nail for survival. Again and again, shes defeated. Forced to restart her journey every time she dies.

Named after a real-world phenomenon where players brains are so engrossed that images of the iconic falling Tetrimino blocks linger in their vision, thoughts, and even dreams, ****** ****** amplifies this magical feeling of total immersion by surrounding you with fantastic, fully three-dimensional worlds that react and evolve based on how you play. Music, backgrounds, sounds, special effectseverything, down to the ****** pieces themselves, pulse, dance, shimmer, and explode in perfect sync with how youre playing.

******* and ***** return to planet Veldin, where theyve been called upon by the president of the galaxy to stop Dr. Nefarious as he plots to exterminate all organic life. Together with the Q-Force and Captain Qwark, ******* and ***** set off on another intergalactic quest to uncover the schemes of the sinister Dr. Nefarious and save the galaxy again!

Its 1930. After an inadvertent brush with the mafia, cabdriver Tommy Angelo is reluctantly thrust into the world of organized crime. Initially, he is uneasy about falling in with the Salieri family, but soon the rewards become too big to ignore. As he rises through the ranks, the paydays keep getting bigger, but the jobs get even dirtier. Tommy may ultimately earn the respect of the Salieris, but becoming a Made Man will leave him more conflicted than ever with the new life he has chosen.
Aliens have landed in futuristic Los Angeles and it's up to the **** to bring the pain and show them the door.
Darth Vader's secret apprentice, codenamed Starkiller, is trained in the Dark Side to defeat the enemies of the Empire, but must find his own path when his master betrays him.

Bring your favorite co-op partner and together step into the shoes of May and Cody. As the couple is going through a divorce, through unknown means their minds are transported into two dolls which their daughter, Rose, made to represent them. Now they must reluctantly find a way to get back into their bodies, a quest which takes them through the most wild, unexpected and fantastical journey imaginable.

Set in a post-apocalyptic era many decades after a nuclear war broke out and eliminated most of the world as we know it. America is turned into the Wasteland, a grim world full of ugly ghouls, powerful super mutants, mad robots and raiders, and various factions fighting for power. There are also many pre-war Vaults, some of which allowed their inhabitants to survive the war.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth

hints.plot: Control the legendary heroes, massive armies, and epic campaigns of Middle-earth based upon all three films of *** **** ** *** ***** trilogy. From waging all-out combat among the vast forces of good and evil to controlling your favorite heroes and characters to managing the troops and resources of your side, the fate of a living, breathing Middle-earth is in your hands.

Set in the distant future, where the deep-space travel is finally available to the humankind, colonies are established on distant planets. Interstellar Manufacturing Corporation began exploiting the colonists, mining the resources on the so-called Frontier planets. Many of the colonists join the resistance to fight back.

The main protagonist is a nameless boy, who is kept as a prisoner in cyclopean castle ruins and has to escape. While in captivity, the boys first task is to befriends his cellmate, a fantasy creature named Trico, who is a gigantic half-bird, half-cat hybrid that slightly reminds a hippogriff.

Brilliant scientist Dr. Light conceived the construction of fully-operational human-like experimental robots to perform specific everyday duties. Dr. Light, and his assistant Dr. Wily, encouraged by their very first near-human robot - **** *** - proceeded to develop six additional Humanoids, all programmed to perform prescribed rituals. But, with the exception of **** ***, all of Dr. Light's near-human robot experimentation went awry. Assistant Dr. Wily turned disloyal, re-programming Dr. Light's Humanoids, now bent on destroying opposition so Dr. Wily could control the world and its resources. Resisting re-programming, **** *** is chosen as the defender of the universe and its inhabitants. **** *** dares to single-handedly penetrate seven separate empires of Monsteropolis, eliminating the leaders and followers of these sovereignties
The game takes place in a planet inhabited by living bullets. You play as one of six adventurers trying entering a considerable fortress to find a gun that can destroy ones past.

Sora, Donald and Goofy awaken in Twilight Town. Bent on the quest to find Riku and King Mickey Mouse, the three begin their journey. However, they soon discover that while they have been asleep, the Heartless are back. Not only that, but new enemies also showed up during their absence. Sora, Donald and Goofy set off on a quest to rid the world of the Heartless once more, uncovering the many secrets that linger about Ansem and the mysterious Organization XIII.

In 1946, Albert Einstein finishes his time machine, dubbed the Chronosphere, and travels back in time to 1924, just after Adolf Hitler was released from prison in Landsberg. There, he creates a time paradox which erases the dictator from history, and returns to his starting point. With Nazi Germany removed from history, the Soviet Union is left unopposed as Joseph Stalin sees an opportunity to expand into Eastern Europe. In response, most of Europe ally against this new threat, and start a desperate war against the new aggressor.
Take the fight to evil Russian robots using a rocket-powered self-adapting battlesuit in this innovative third-person shooter from Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami.
The Divine is dead. The Void approaches. And the powers latent within you are soon to awaken. The battle for Divinity has begun. Choose wisely and trust sparingly; darkness lurks within every heart.

The year is 1946 and the Nazis are on the brink of winning World War II. In an effort to turn the tide in the allies favor, B.J. Blazkowicz must embark on an epic, two-part mission deep within Bavaria.

When the wife of the best-selling writer **** **** disappears on their vacation, his search turns up pages from a thriller he doesnt even remember writing. A Dark Presence stalks the small town of Bright Falls, pushing Wake to the brink of sanity in his fight to unravel the mystery and save his love.

******* takes place in modern-day Tokyo and follows a high school student known by the pseudonym Joker who transfers to a new school after he is falsely accused of assault, and put on probation. Over the course of a school year, he and other students awaken to a special power, becoming a group of secret vigilantes known as the Phantom Thieves of Hearts. They explore the Metaverse, a supernatural realm born from humanity's subconscious desires, to steal malevolent intent from the hearts of adults. As with previous games in the series, the party battles enemies known as Shadows using physical manifestations of their psyche known as Personas. The game incorporates role-playing and dungeon crawling elements alongside social simulation scenarios.

title: Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast

hints.plot: Several years have passed since Kyle avenged his father's death and saved the Valley of the Jedi from Jerec and his band of Dark Jedi. Allowing his Force powers to languish for fear of falling to the dark side, Kyle entrusted his lightsaber to Luke Skywalker, vowing never to use it again. But when a new and menacing threat to the galaxy emerges, Kyle knows he must reclaim his past in order to save his future

Bent on Humankind's extermination, a powerful fellowship of alien races known as the Covenant is wiping out Earth's fledgling interstellar empire. Climb into the boots of Master Chief, a biologically altered super-soldier, as you and the other surviving defenders of a devastated colony-world make a desperate attempt to lure the alien fleet away from earth. Shot down and marooned on the ancient ring-world Halo, you begin a guerilla-war against the Covenant. Fight for humanity against an alien onslaught as you race to uncover the mysteries of ****.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap

hints.plot: While at a festival with Princess Zelda, Link encounters a mysterious mage called Vaati who turns the princess to stone. Helpless to stop them, Link is asked by the king to meet with a race of tiny people known as the Minish, who may be able to help with their predicament. On his travels, Link teams up with a talking cap called Ezlo, who is able to shrink Link to the size of a Minish so that he can meet with them. With his newfound abilities, Link must save the kingdom from Vaati's menace.

Sam Bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the ***** *********. Carrying the stranded remnants of the future in his hands, Sam embarks on a journey to reunite the shattered world one step at a time. What is the mystery of the ***** *********? What will Sam discover on the road ahead? A genre defining gameplay experience holds these answers and more.

You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home? It won't be easy. Ever since Joja Corporation came to town, the old ways of life have all but disappeared. The community center, once the town's most vibrant hub of activity, now lies in shambles. But the valley seems full of opportunity. With a little dedication, you might just be the one to restore ******* ****** to greatness!

In December 2001, as New York City is enduring the tail end of the worst snow blizzard in the history of the city, *** *****, a renegade DEA agent and former NYPD detective, is standing at the top of a skyscraper with a sniper rifle in his hands, smiling, as police units arrive on the scene to arrest him. He then experiences flashbacks from three years ago and the last two days he experienced. Three years earlier, on August 22nd 1998, Max was working as a regular NYPD detective, having just finished his day's work. His longtime friend and DEA agent, Alex Balder, invites him to transfer into the DEA, but Max declines the offer, wanting to focus on his full-time life with his wife, Michelle, and their newborn daughter, Rose. As he returns to his house in New Jersey, he finds that a trio of junkies had broken into his house, all addicted on a brand new designer drug, Valkyr. Max receives a call from a mysterious woman who seems pleased at the trouble in the house and refuses to call for help. Max rushes to aid his family and kill the junkies, but is too late as he finds his wife shot dead, and his daughter slaughtered. After his family's funeral, Payne accepts Alex's offer, and transfers to the DEA at his own request to stop the spreading of the drugs.

**** tells the story of Tommy, a Cherokee garage mechanic stuck on a reservation going nowhere. Abducted along with his people to a menacing mothership orbiting Earth, he sets out to save himself and his girlfriend and eventually his planet.
